title: Marketing Manager - FIT Show
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager – FIT Show

We have an exciting opportunity for a Marketing Manager to join the team and lead the marketing strategy and campaign delivery for FIT Show. We are looking for an experienced exhibition marketer already operating at Marketing Manager level, with strong campaign management and stakeholder management.

FIT Show is the UK’s leading trade event for the window, door, flat glass, hardware and roofing industry, bringing together thousands of visitors and hundreds of exhibitors from across the sector. The event plays a key role within Montgomery Group’s portfolio and continues to grow both commercially and strategically.

Reporting into the Marketing Director, this role will be responsible for driving high-quality visitor attendance and exhibitor ROI through effective multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, website, social media, PPC, partnerships and content.

Collaboration is a key part of the role, working closely with marketing, sales, content, operations and data teams, alongside external partners and the wider industry, to deliver commercially successful campaigns and an outstanding event experience.

Key Responsibilities



- Plan, coordinate, implement & monitor marketing communication activities to ensure deadlines are met within budget and in-line with the event marketing goals.
- Achieve visitor acquisition targets for the event and brand.
- Work closely with the digital agency to maximise customer acquisition and lead generation through paid search, display and paid social campaigns.
- Manage and support junior members of the marketing team, helping develop skills, confidence and campaign delivery.
- Be responsible for evaluating campaigns and making future recommendations.
- Support website tracking to improve reporting and analysis abilities.
- Manage and optimise website content and user journeys to support visitor acquisition and conversion.
- Act as brand champion, ensuring adoption of best practice.
- Track industry and marketing developments, reporting findings to all stakeholders.
- Track and report regularly on campaign performance across digital, social, PPC/SEO, partnerships and visitor acquisition activity, identifying successes and opportunities for improvement.
- Manage and track agreed marketing spend for the brand.
- Maintain clear oversight of all campaign activity and delivery stages to ensure smooth and effective execution.
- Work closely with the Event Manager and wider event team to support campaign delivery, commercial objectives and strategic event growth.
- Work closely with the sales team to support exhibitor acquisition, retention and lead generation opportunities.
- Use campaign performance, audience insights and market data to continuously optimise marketing activity and drive commercial results.
- Work with Data Team to optimise the health and performance of both visitor and exhibitor databases, including new data builds, warm up campaigns and growth areas. 

Skills



- Previous B2B exhibition or event marketing experience is essential.
- A strong understanding of digital systems, best practices, and measurement tools.
- Comprehensive knowledge of how to use and write copy for digital platforms.
- Good experience of using digital platforms to build emails, website pages etc.
- Ability to deliver quality work in a fast paced, high-volume, deadline driven environment.
- Capable of managing a full campaign from start to finish.
- Confident in managing multiple projects under tight deadlines and accommodating rapid changes.
- Ability to multitask numerous projects throughout the event cycle.
- A team player that is happy to collaborate on projects with others.
- Great time management and organisational skills.
- Strong marketing experience working on a multifaceted campaign covering all elements of the marketing mix.
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
- Confident communicator in all mediums – written, face-to-face & on the phone.
- Keen eye for detail and strong copywriting skills.
- Strong Microsoft Office Skills required.
- Creatively minded with a passion for discovering new ways to approach the marketing requirements of the events.

Montgomery Group is a well-established, ethical, collaborative and empowering company. We are driven to maximise each and every employees’ potential through empowerment, collaboration and adopting a growth mindset resulting in high performing, tight knit teams who relish coming to work. We are performance led with a strong focus on growth. Importantly, we are purpose-driven, adhere to our values no matter what, and as a family business care about the people and communities that we serve. At Montgomery your achievements will be recognised and celebrated.

The central London, dog friendly offices are close to the bustle of Oxford Street & Marylebone High Street with access to the private gardens in Manchester Square . Hybrid working is offered to all applicants with a minimum of at least 3 days in the office, Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Flexibility will be required to suit the needs of the business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to diversity. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities, providing they meet the minimum requirements of the job role. Sadly, the office building is currently not wheelchair friendly.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager


A bit about us


We’re Hyve - organiser of the world’s fastest-growing and most forward-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies - helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth and connect with the people who matter most.


Our portfolio features some of the world’s leading events in sectors like ecommerce, healthcare, edtech, and fintech. We’re growing fast with an entrepreneurial culture that empowers big ideas and quick action, plus an ambitious acquisition strategy bringing exciting new events into our mix.


Alongside our market-leading events, we’re building tech and data-driven products that supercharge connections – from one-to-one meeting programs and curated table talks to year-round engagement platforms.


Whatever your role, you’ll join a global team redefining how industries connect, collaborate, and grow – working with some of the most talented people in the business. 


Think that sounds good? Wait until our talent acquisition team tells you about the culture.


A bit about you


First things first: whatever your background, beliefs or ambitions, there’s a culture of belonging at Hyve — and everyone is welcome. The question isn’t where you’ve come from, but where you want to go.


You’ll thrive here if you’re curious, collaborative and not afraid to challenge convention. We look for people who take pride in what they do, who are excited by change and always moving forward. The kind of people who stay open, keep learning, and look for better ways to make an impact.


Our shared behaviours guide how we work: we dare to do things differently, own our work, embrace collaboration, stay true to ourselves and others, and remember that optimism wins.


If that sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.


The bit about the role


Through Mining Indaba, our market-leading event, we connect the global mining community across the entire value chain—from exploration and investment to extraction, processing, technology and services. 
We create and facilitate game-changing business opportunities, partnerships and ideas that move the industry forward and support a more sustainable future for mining in Africa and around the world. 
Now we’re looking for a Marketing Manager to join the team.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for planning and executing the SPEX marketing strategy for Mining Indaba, supporting sponsorship and exhibition sales. This role involves the day-to-day management of targeted marketing campaigns, close collaboration with the SPEX and wider commercial teams, and handling key operational tasks to generate demand, build pipeline and support revenue growth. A proactive team player with a high-energy approach, strong commercial mindset and event marketing experience will thrive in this fast-paced environment.
As part of your job, you’ll be:

- Plan, manage, and implement targeted SPEX marketing campaigns to support sponsorship and exhibition sales
- Support SPEX revenue targets by generating qualified leads, building pipeline and delivering effective digital campaigns
- Assist in the development and creation of marketing materials and compelling content that communicate the value of exhibiting and sponsoring at Mining Indaba.
- Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics and optimize strategies to improve results. Support the SMM with insights on campaign outcomes, lead generation and KPIs.
- Manage day-to-day relationships with the SPEX team, wider internal stakeholders and external marketing agencies.


And here’s what we’re looking for from you: 



- You want to make a difference by doing things differently.
- If you think there’s a better way, you’re brave enough to give it a try.
- You embrace collaboration and make everyone feel welcome.
- Even in adversity, you manage to stay positive.
- You’re always looking out for new innovations and ways to do things better.


Ready to make some great experiences? Your Hyve adventure begins with one click-Apply now!

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager – Luxury Travel Brand, Manchester
Salary: Competitive


We are looking for an experienced and creative Marketing Manager to join an established luxury travel brand based in Manchester.


This is a fantastic opportunity for a marketing professional who is passionate about luxury travel, brand storytelling, PR and creative campaigns, and who enjoys working across a broad range of traditional marketing channels.


This is not a heavily digital-focused role. Instead, the position has a strong emphasis on brand, communications and offline marketing, including PR, events, brochures, direct marketing, press advertising and TV.


Requirements:

- Working closely with the wider commercial and creative teams, you will be responsible for developing and delivering marketing activity that brings the brand and its destinations to life.
- Developing and delivering the annual marketing plan in line with the wider brand and commercial strategy.
- Managing PR activity, working with agencies and media contacts to generate strong brand exposure.
- Planning and coordinating events, launches and promotional activity.
- Managing the production of high-quality brochures and printed marketing collateral, from concept through to delivery.
- Overseeing direct email campaigns and customer communications.
- Working on TV commercials, from briefing and creative development through to production and delivery.
- Supporting and coordinating TV programmes and filming opportunities to showcase the brand and its destinations.
- Managing press advertising campaigns, ensuring creative and messaging are aligned with the wider brand.
- Working closely with creative agencies, PR agencies, media partners and production companies.
- Managing marketing budgets and ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and within budget.
- Ensuring consistency of the brand across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
- Monitoring campaign performance and using insight to continually improve activity.


Responsibilities:

- We are looking for someone with a strong grounding in brand marketing and communications, ideally gained within luxury travel, hospitality, tourism, retail or another premium consumer environment.
- You will ideally have experience across several of the following: PR and media relations, events and brand activations, brochure and print production, direct marketing and email campaigns, TV advertising and production, TV programmes, filming or media partnerships, press advertising, agency management and/or campaign planning and execution
- You don't need to be a digital marketing specialist. We are particularly interested in someone who understands brand, storytelling and traditional marketing, and who can manage multiple creative projects from initial concept through to delivery.
- You'll be highly organised, commercially aware and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and external agencies.
- Just as importantly, you'll have a genuine eye for quality and understand what it takes to market a premium, aspirational brand.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Automation Consultants (AC) is a UK consultancy in Agile, DevOps and AI, with a fast-growing AI practice. We are an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner with more than 20 years of expertise, and we provide advice, hands-on project delivery and managed services to customers ranging from blue-chip companies and government departments to start-ups.


You will be our Marketing Manager and the most senior marketing person in the services business, reporting directly to the CEO and owning marketing for AC’s services business (consultancy and managed services): strategy, campaigns, content, events, budget and a small team.


The role has a high level of ownership: you will set direction, not just execute someone else’s plan, and you will have the freedom to try things, drop what does not work and build on what does. Both the subject matter and the methods prominently include AI, the force that is changing the face of technology and the economy today. AC is building an AI practice, and marketing that credibly is a job for someone who actually uses the tools, understands what they can and cannot do, and can explain it clearly to a sceptical technical buyer.


What you will do


Set the direction



- Shape AC’s marketing strategy alongside the CEO, aligned with the business plan, and turn it into multi-channel campaigns that win new customers and keep existing ones.
- Own the marketing budget and decide where it goes.


Make AC’s voice worth reading



- Run the content engine: opinion pieces, webinars, industry data, partnerships with other software companies, and social.
- Tell the story of AC’s AI practice in a way that is honest, specific and interesting to technical and business audiences alike.


Use AI as a working tool



- Use Claude Cowork (or a similar AI agent) every day to research, draft, analyse and automate routine work.
- Teach AI our brand voice, using style guides, example content and prompt libraries, so that output sounds like AC rather than like everyone else.
- Build small agentic workflows for repetitive work such as performance digests, campaign briefs and social drafts.
- Keep up with new models, tools and AI search behaviour, and bring what matters back to the business. We will provide the tools, training and time to experiment.


Lead and connect



- Lead and develop a small team of marketing specialists. If you have not managed people before, we will support you in learning to.
- Manage agencies, partners and media contacts, from brief to delivery.
- Work closely with Sales to build reporting that shows what is working, then act on what the numbers say.


Your Profile


You can write, you can think, and you are more interested in what AI makes possible than in how it has always been done. You have a few years of marketing behind you, so you know the fundamentals: how campaigns are planned, what good content looks like, how to read the numbers. What you may not have had is the room to use that knowledge as you see fit. You would rather run something than assist on it.


Essential

- A strong academic record: a good degree (2:1 or above), in any subject. Humanities, languages and social sciences are as welcome as business or marketing.
- Hands-on marketing experience, in-house, agency or freelance, in any sector, so that you are familiar with campaign planning, content, digital channels and measurement. You do not need to have held the title “Manager”, and you do not need to have marketed technology before.
- Excellent writing: clear, precise and persuasive, with the ability to make complex technical subjects understandable.
- Curiosity about AI and daily use of AI tools in your own work, going beyond simple chat. We will ask you to show us.
- Hands-on experience delivering campaigns across digital and social channels.
- The confidence to take ownership, make decisions and be accountable for results, with evidence of things you have made happen without being asked.


Helpful, but not required

- Experience of B2B or technology marketing.
- Experience of managing a budget or managing people.
- Experience with AI tooling beyond chat, such as Claude Cowork, n8n or Zapier, or evidence of building something with AI on your own initiative.
- Familiarity with the Atlassian or AWS ecosystems.
- Ideas you have not yet been allowed to try. Bring them.


Salary and benefits
£50,000 – £60,000 per annum, depending on experience.



- Hybrid working
- 33 days holiday (including bank holidays)
- Private Healthcare
- Dental insurance
- Enhanced Maternity & Paternity plans
- Dedicated ongoing training plan and budget
- Flexible working hours and environment
- Access to the Electric Car Scheme
- Automation Consultant’s Cycle to Work Scheme
- Pension Scheme
- Top Spec Machine and access to virtual test lab
- Onsite gym, showers, yoga lessons and more.
- Regular company-wide events, team social events


What you will get

- Real ownership. You report to the CEO, who will set goals with you and give you honest feedback, and then get out of the way. Marketing is yours to shape.
- Room to innovate. AI and automation are changing how marketing is done. We would rather you experimented with them here than read about other people doing it. Try things, measure them, keep what works.
- A front-row seat on AI. AC is building an AI practice, and you will work alongside the consultants who deliver it. Few marketing roles offer a closer view of the technology.
- Tools and training. Access to leading AI tools, a dedicated training plan and a personal training budget.
- A defined path. The role is designed to grow into Head of Marketing as the team and the business grow. We will agree what that looks like with you in the first months.
- A good place to work. AC is recognised as a UK Best Workplace, with around 60 people across the group, so you will know everyone and your work will be visible.

title: Marketing Manager (I&I Eastern Europe)
descriptionText:
At TÜV SÜD Group we are passionate about technology. Innovations impact our daily lives in countless ways, and we are dedicated to being a part of that progress. We test, we audit, we inspect, we advise. We never stop challenging ourselves for the safety of society and its people. We breathe technology, we strive for professional excellence, and we leave a mark. We take the future into our hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

As a Marketing Business Partner to the Industry & Infrastructure Division covering Eastern Europe, you will partner the local business to shape and deliver marketing strategies and campaigns that support the business priorities and growth. You develop and execute Marketing Plans that are tailored to the needs of the region or local business together with the Marketing Hub specialists, brand, business and sales. Acting as the market's counterpart of the Divisional Marketing Business Partners you ensure marketing activities are aligned with the divisional topics/strategy and tailored to the regional needs and priorities. You actively participate in global BP meetings to identify potential synergies and support to leverage cross-regional efficiencies within the Business Partner team. This role requires comprehensive marketing experience, strategic thinking, strong stakeholder management skills, and a mindset focused on effective and measurable marketing initiatives.

Key Duties And Responsibilities



- Partner the operational units through a customer and market-oriented approach.
- Align marketing initiatives with business priorities, revenue targets, and market expansion plans.
- Offer comprehensive advice on all marketing activities, develop and implement strategic marketing plans tailored to the regional business needs.
- Leverage market data, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to provide regional insights for the regional product marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans for Industry & Infrastructure services and solutions.
- Actively provide regional (customer) insights to be included into the global marketing strategy.
- Based on a value proposition and depending on the localisation level of a service, you adopt, adjust or develop a marketing, communication and content strategy for the target market(s), including buyer personas. For that you are aligned with the Divisional and other regional BPs.
- Depending on the localisation level of a service you adapt or develop regional marketing campaigns and collaboratively ensure the execution with the Marketing Hub specialists.
- Ensure that all regional campaigns are results-driven and lead to measurable business impact.
- Collaboratively track and analyse your marketing KPIs and regularly report on the effectiveness of the marketing campaigns, programs, and initiatives and ensure optimisation.
- Collect and leverage customer feedback to continuously enhance marketing efforts and ensure that the approach is responsive to customers’ needs and preferences in the regions.
- Collaborate and work closely with internal Marketing Hub teams, business, sales and other functions to ensure cohesive and effective marketing efforts.
- Work closely together with the other Marketing Business Partner’s globally to identify synergies and cross-regional efficiencies.

Essential Criteria



- Degree or equivalent qualification in marketing, business administration, communication or a comparable field of study, or experience in industry.
- Czech or Polish written and verbal communication skills are highly desirable
- Professional experience in strategic marketing, preferably in a B2B environment or agency work.
- Strong marketing skills in strategic marketing, omnichannel campaign planning, and content marketing.
- Knowledge of digital marketing principles, technologies, and analytics.
- Experience in complex B2B or technical service environments.
- Proven ability to work in an international business environment.
- Strong ability to manage stakeholders demands.
- Structured and solution-oriented approach to work with high-quality standards.
- Be confident, resourceful, self-motivated, team-oriented, flexible, adaptable and possess a high level of initiative.

Further Information

TÜV SÜD in the UK offers a competitive salary and benefits package that includes a minimum of 33 days holiday entitlement (for full-time employees, including public holidays), a contributory Group Personal Pension Plan and a non-contributory Group Life Assurance Scheme. We also offer various Salary Exchange/Sacrifice schemes (buying/selling holiday, cycle to work scheme, pensions), incentive schemes and comprehensive wellbeing support (Employee Assistance Programme, Dental Scheme and Occupational Health services). Dependent on their role, employees may also be eligible for hybrid/permanent homeworking, a Company Car/Car Allowance and Private Medical Insurance.

At TÜV SÜD Group, we have employees from more than 100 different countries collaborating together. People of different backgrounds, skills, and pursuing different life goals. Our strength comes from these countless and varied perspectives.

We are committed to be an inclusive and diverse workplace by welcoming people of all backgrounds. We want Diversity & Inclusion (D&I) to be a foundation of our company and create an environment where all our employees can trust they will be treated with respect, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic background, faith, beliefs, disabilities, age, sexual orientation, or identity. As such, our employees are expected to behave at all times in a manner consistent with TÜV SÜD Group Code of Ethics and Company values.

We firmly believe embedding D&I in the heart of what we do will inherently contribute to the success of TÜV SÜD Group. Click here to find out more about Diversity at TÜV SÜD Group.

title: Manager, Marketing & Eminence, Clients & Markets team
descriptionText:
Connect to your Industry
Imagine a role where your creativity meets real-world impact, shaping the future of a leading global professional services firm. Deloitte is thrilled to invite you to become a vital part of our Clients & Markets team, specifically within our new Marketing & Eminence team. We are a vibrant and diverse collective of skilled specialists across Marketing, Insight, Brand, and Channels, united by a shared mission: to create fantastic client experiences, drive measurable impact, and significantly contribute to the strategic growth of our UK business. If you're ready to make your mark and thrive in a collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.


Connect to your career at Deloitte 
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.


What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.


Connect to your opportunity
Reporting to a Marketing Senior Manager, you will play a key role in executing impactful marketing campaigns and initiatives that support Deloitte UK's business objectives. You will work closely with marketing colleagues across business and industry; business development colleagues; and the service line professionals to develop, execute and measure the effectiveness of the marketing strategy and plan for a service line.


Responsibilities include:

- Support the development and implementation of marketing plans for specific business lines, markets or industries.
- Collaborate closely with stakeholders across marketing (including other business lines and industries), business development, service line professionals, clients and markets teams and subject matter experts to make marketing activities impactful for our clients.
- Advise on the development of market propositions and execute plans for their promotion in the market via account teams.
- Manage the execution of marketing activities across various channels, including digital marketing, email marketing, content creation, events, and social media.
- Engage both business development teams and account teams to ensure marketing activities are relevant, timely, and sales enabling.
- Track and analyse marketing campaign performance, providing regular reports and insights to stakeholders. Use data to identify trends and make recommendations for future strategies.
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure cost-effective execution of activities
- Maintain a strong understanding of Deloitte's brand guidelines and ensure consistent application across all marketing materials.
- Stay up to date on industry trends, best practices, and emerging marketing technologies.
- Contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.


Connect to your skills and professional experience

- Proven experience as a highly performing Marketing Manager or in a similar role, ideally within professional services
- Ability to work with technical, non-marketing SMEs and the curiosity to develop a solid understanding of their business, market and offerings
- Strong understanding of marketing principles and best practices across multiple channels.
- Experience in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Excellent project management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Experience in managing budgets and tracking return on investment for marketing activities.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.


Connect to your business - Enabling Functions
Collaboration is central to everything we do at Deloitte. From IT to HR, marketing and more, our teams help to support the wider business in everything they do. Bringing your individual skills and specialist knowledge, you can make a far-reaching impact. Come join us.


Clients and Markets
We bring together capabilities and best practices from around the globe to deliver relationship development activities, marketing and corporate affairs, whilst our operations team is focused on ensuring we’re constantly improving what we do.


Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.


Connect with your colleagues
"Deloitte’s a large, complex and fast-paced organisation but it’s open to new ideas. Everyone is encouraged to show initiative and challenge the norm." - Lisa, Enabling Functions


Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in one of our UK offices with hybrid working.

Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. title: Marketing Manager, Commercial
descriptionText:
Agriconnect is the UK's largest multi-platform agricultural information business, connecting the people, businesses and communities shaping the future of agriculture.


Our brands reach across the UK's major agricultural sectors, including arable, dairy, livestock, agricultural machinery, finance and equipment. From trusted media brands and content to industry-leading events and commercial products, we connect audiences and businesses in ways that create real value.


Agriconnect is part of Arc Network, a global B2B events, data and media platform backed by investment funds managed by EagleTree Capital. Arc operates more than 150 events each year across HR technology, agriculture and food, financial services and investing, and education technology, with more than 350 colleagues across the UK, US, Netherlands and Singapore.


Location: London/Preston 
Working Pattern: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent


The Opportunity
We're looking for a commercially minded Marketing Manager, Commercial to play a key role in driving growth across Agriconnect's portfolio of five events and commercial products.


This is a broad marketing role combining strategy, demand generation, digital marketing, data and sales enablement. You'll work closely with Sales and teams across the wider business to create integrated campaigns that generate high-quality leads, support sponsorship and exhibition sales, strengthen client relationships and contribute directly to commercial revenue.


You'll have real ownership of the commercial marketing agenda, with the opportunity to use data, insight and creative campaigns to identify, engage and convert new audiences.


What You'll Do


Commercial Marketing & Campaigns

- Own the commercial marketing strategy across Agriconnect's events, media brands and commercial products.
- Develop integrated campaigns across email, social media, SEO, PPC, partnerships and content.
- Lead the commercial social media and PPC strategy, including managing external agencies.
- Work with Content, Design and Digital teams to develop engaging campaign assets.
- Manage marketing budgets and optimise activity to maximise ROI.
- Identify new opportunities to grow audiences, generate demand and support commercial growth.


Lead Generation & Sales Enablement

- Develop targeted lead generation campaigns that create meaningful commercial opportunities.
- Deliver and nurture MQLs and SQLs in partnership with Sales.
- Work with Sales to improve lead quality, conversion and client retention.
- Develop lead nurture and marketing automation programmes.
- Build campaigns that support both new business acquisition and existing client relationships.


Data & Audience Growth

- Own the commercial data acquisition and database growth strategy.
- Identify target sectors, organisations and decision-makers to build high-value prospect audiences.
- Work with Sales, Data and CRM teams to identify gaps and improve data quality.
- Use events, content, digital campaigns, partnerships and social media to acquire new contacts and consented data.
- Develop segmentation and audience strategies to support targeted lead generation, nurture and account-based campaigns.
- Monitor database growth, engagement and conversion to demonstrate commercial value.


Insight & Performance

- Track campaign ROI, pipeline contribution, CPL, MQLs, SQLs and conversion rates.
- Use data and insight to optimise campaigns and inform future activity.
- Stay informed on market trends, competitor activity and opportunities across the agricultural and B2B landscape.
- Maintain strong CRM data quality and governance.

- Act as a key marketing partner to the Commercial Sales team.
- Collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Events, Editorial, Digital and Data.
- Manage relationships with external agencies and strategic partners.
- Attend Agriconnect and relevant industry events as required.

- Experience in B2B marketing, particularly demand generation, lead generation or sales enablement.
- Experience developing and delivering integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
- Experience managing PPC, paid social and external agencies.
- Strong understanding of CRM and marketing automation.

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of the commercial marketing agenda within a growing international B2B business. You'll work across a diverse portfolio of brands and products, influence strategy and see a tangible commercial impact from your work.

Working within Haymarket (Live Events)

Haymarket Business Media's Live Events team delivers a diverse portfolio of market-leading awards, conferences and industry events across Haymarket Media Communications and Haymarket Professional brands. Bringing together professional communities through high-quality live experiences, the team plays an important role in strengthening audience engagement, supporting commercial growth and enhancing the reputation of Haymarket's brands.

Working as part of the wider marketing function, the Marketing Manager takes ownership of the marketing strategy and delivery for an assigned portfolio of live events, developing integrated campaigns that drive audience engagement, delegate registrations, award entries and commercial performance across brands including Campaign, PR Week, Third Sector, Windpower and Planning. - Understanding of event marketing and the B2B media, publishing or events environment.

- Confident working with marketing platforms, CRM systems and digital channels.

title: Marketing Manager (Hybrid working)
descriptionText:
Your mission

Automation Consultants (AC) is a UK consultancy in Agile, DevOps and AI, with a fast-growing AI practice. We are an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner with more than 20 years of expertise, and we provide advice, hands-on project delivery and managed services to customers ranging from blue-chip companies and government departments to start-ups.

You will be our Marketing Manager and the most senior marketing person in the services business, reporting directly to the CEO and owning marketing for AC’s services business (consultancy and managed services): strategy, campaigns, content, events, budget and a small team.

The role has a high level of ownership: you will set direction, not just execute someone else’s plan, and you will have the freedom to try things, drop what does not work and build on what does. Both the subject matter and the methods prominently include AI, the force that is changing the face of technology and the economy today. AC is building an AI practice, and marketing that credibly is a job for someone who actually uses the tools, understands what they can and cannot do, and can explain it clearly to a sceptical technical buyer.

What You Will Do

Set the direction



- Shape AC’s marketing strategy alongside the CEO, aligned with the business plan, and turn it into multi-channel campaigns that win new customers and keep existing ones.
- Own the marketing budget and decide where it goes.

Make AC’s voice worth reading



- Run the content engine: opinion pieces, webinars, industry data, partnerships with other software companies, and social.
- Tell the story of AC’s AI practice in a way that is honest, specific and interesting to technical and business audiences alike.

Use AI as a working tool



- Use Claude Cowork (or a similar AI agent) every day to research, draft, analyse and automate routine work.
- Teach AI our brand voice, using style guides, example content and prompt libraries, so that output sounds like AC rather than like everyone else.
- Build small agentic workflows for repetitive work such as performance digests, campaign briefs and social drafts.
- Keep up with new models, tools and AI search behaviour, and bring what matters back to the business. We will provide the tools, training and time to experiment.

Lead and connect



- Lead and develop a small team of marketing specialists. If you have not managed people before, we will support you in learning to.
- Manage agencies, partners and media contacts, from brief to delivery.
- Work closely with Sales to build reporting that shows what is working, then act on what the numbers say.

Your profile

You can write, you can think, and you are more interested in what AI makes possible than in how it has always been done. title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager


Location: Battersea Power Station, London
Salary: £45,000–£55,000
Reporting to: Head of Brand
Working pattern: Office-first


We are not here to blend in.


R4 Advertising is building a different kind of advertising business.
Our Trade. Plan. Activate. model is challenging the established economics of media. We trade transparently, plan intelligently and return the commercial value generated through media to our clients.


The proposition is working. We are winning major clients, expanding our London operation and building a business with serious national and international ambitions.
Now we need a Marketing Manager capable of making sure the market knows it.


The role
This is a hands-on role for a proven marketer who can combine commercial thinking, technology, content and execution.


You will work alongside our Head of Brand and content creators to build a marketing operation that gets R4 noticed, generates qualified demand and supports our continued growth.
You will manage a marketing budget exceeding £500,000 and take ownership of the systems, campaigns and day-to-day activity behind the R4 brand.


One day you could be building an integrated demand-generation campaign. The next, improving a HubSpot workflow, briefing content, updating the website, preparing an award entry or analysing whether our investment is creating genuine commercial opportunities.
You will need to think clearly, communicate brilliantly and execute relentlessly.


What you will own

- Deliver R4’s marketing strategy alongside the Head of Brand.
- Manage and optimise an annual marketing budget exceeding £500,000.
- Build integrated campaigns that generate awareness, engagement, MQLs and qualified commercial opportunities.
- Own the day-to-day operation of HubSpot, including campaigns, workflows, automation, segmentation, lead scoring and reporting.
- Manage integrations between HubSpot, our website and wider marketing technology.
- Maintain and improve the R4 website, including content, landing pages, conversion journeys and campaign tracking.
- Create a clear and measurable journey from first engagement through to MQL, SQL, opportunity and revenue.
- Work closely with the new business team to ensure marketing activity supports priority accounts and commercial targets.
- Build account-based marketing campaigns for the brands and sectors we want to work with.
- Coordinate the output of our Head of Brand, content creator and external partners.
- Turn R4’s client work, campaign results, people and thinking into content the industry wants to see.
- Help develop R4 Labs into a credible industry platform that puts our clients and their campaigns at the heart of the conversation.
- Manage our marketing calendar across content, campaigns, partnerships, events, PR and industry opportunities.
- Identify and coordinate speaking opportunities, roundtables and events.
- Write compelling agency, campaign and effectiveness award entries.
- Produce dashboards covering budget, channel performance, MQLs, pipeline contribution, conversion and return on investment.
- Keep projects moving, standards high and every commitment accounted for.


What we are looking for


We want a marketer with evidence, not simply enthusiasm.


You will need:



- Proven experience delivering successful B2B marketing campaigns.
- Strong working knowledge of HubSpot, including workflows, automation, lead management and reporting.
- Experience managing substantial marketing budgets with clear accountability for performance.
- Evidence of generating qualified leads and contributing to commercial pipeline.
- A strong understanding of marketing economics, including CAC, conversion, attribution and return on investment.
- Experience managing websites, landing pages and digital conversion journeys.
- The ability to turn a commercial proposition into sharp, relevant marketing.
- Excellent writing and presentation skills.
- The confidence and presence to represent R4 in meetings, pitches, panels and industry settings.
- Experience coordinating internal teams, agencies and external partners.
- Exceptional organisation and attention to detail.
- The judgement to prioritise what will make a commercial difference.
- A degree or equivalent evidence of professional and intellectual capability.




Experience within advertising, media, technology, professional services or another ambitious B2B business would be valuable. A strong understanding of the advertising industry would be even better.


The person


You are intelligent, commercially switched on and deeply curious.


You understand that attention matters, but attention without commercial impact is just noise.


You can see the bigger strategic picture without becoming detached from delivery. You are as comfortable discussing brand positioning as you are interrogating a dashboard, improving a workflow or challenging a campaign that is not performing.


You do not need to be managed through every task. You take ownership, communicate clearly and finish what you start.


You have high standards, strong opinions and enough self-awareness to listen when someone else has a better answer.


You are ambitious for yourself, but equally ambitious for the business and the people around you.
Most importantly, you want to do work that moves an industry rather than simply filling another marketing calendar.


Your first six months


Success will mean:



- A clear marketing plan connected directly to R4’s commercial ambitions.
- A properly structured and measurable HubSpot operation.
- Agreed definitions and reporting for MQLs, SQLs, opportunities and pipeline.
- A visible, consistent and distinctive content programme.
- Integrated campaigns targeting the brands R4 wants to win.
- A stronger website journey with clear conversion points.
- R4 Labs operating as a credible platform for our clients, campaigns and thinking.
- A structured programme of awards, events and speaking opportunities.
- Clear evidence of what marketing is generating for the business.


Why R4?
Because the foundations are already here.


The proposition is distinctive. The clients are significant. The ambition is real. And our growing London operation at Battersea Power Station gives us a platform from which to take on the market.


What we need now is a marketer with the intelligence, energy and commercial discipline to turn that opportunity into momentum.


This is not a maintenance role.


It is an opportunity to help build the marketing machine behind one of the industry’s most ambitious challenger brands.


If that sounds like the kind of responsibility you have been waiting for, we want to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
We’re working with an established and growing multi-site consumer retail business to appoint an experienced Marketing Manager into a key position within its head office team. This is a broad brand, retail and omnichannel marketing role, suited to somebody who understands how to grow a business across both physical stores and ecommerce.


About the Role


This is an opportunity for a commercially minded Marketing Manager who enjoys combining strategy with hands-on delivery. You’ll take ownership of the wider marketing approach, working closely with senior leadership, ecommerce and operational teams to build a consistent brand and drive customer acquisition, store footfall, online conversion, retention and repeat business.


Importantly, this is not simply a digital or paid-media position. The physical retail estate is a central part of the role. You’ll need to understand what drives customers into stores, how different locations and customer catchments require different approaches, and how online and offline marketing can work together to create measurable commercial growth.


The Role


You’ll take responsibility for developing and delivering a clear, KPI-led marketing strategy across the business. Responsibilities will include:



- Developing the overall marketing strategy and campaign calendar across physical retail and ecommerce
- Translating commercial objectives into clear, measurable marketing plans
- Developing strategies to increase in-store footfall, store sales and online conversion
- Creating localised marketing campaigns across a multi-site retail estate
- Working closely with operational and store teams to understand customers, individual locations and local opportunities
- Connecting online and offline activity, including local promotions, customer communications and omnichannel initiatives
- Developing a consistent brand identity, tone of voice and customer experience across stores and digital channels
- Overseeing content across website, email, social media and in-store marketing materials
- Working closely with ecommerce colleagues across SEO, social, email, CRM, onsite merchandising and organic visibility
- Developing CRM, customer retention and loyalty activity to increase repeat business
- Using customer, store and performance data to identify commercial growth opportunities
- Setting meaningful KPIs across traffic, footfall, conversion, retention and ROI
- Reporting results and recommendations to senior leadership
- Managing the marketing budget with a strong focus on commercial return
- Reviewing campaigns to understand what worked, what didn’t and how future activity should improve
- Visiting locations across the estate where required to understand customer behaviour and ensure campaigns are being effectively delivered
- Building strong relationships across the business, from senior leadership through to operational and store teams


About You


We’re looking for somebody with:



- Around 5+ years’ experience at Marketing Manager, Senior Marketing Manager or comparable level
- Strong experience within B2C consumer marketing
- Ideally, experience within a multi-site retail business where physical stores are a significant part of the customer journey
- Demonstrable experience developing marketing activity that has increased store footfall, customer visits or physical retail sales
- Experience connecting physical retail and ecommerce as part of an omnichannel strategy
- Strong brand marketing experience, with the ability to create consistency across multiple locations and channels
- Good knowledge of SEO, social media, email marketing and CRM
- Experience developing CRM, retention, loyalty or repeat-purchase activity
- Strong understanding of customer journeys across both online and offline touchpoints
- Experience using analytics and performance data to make marketing decisions
- Confidence setting and reporting against commercial KPIs
- Strong understanding of marketing ROI and budget management
- The ability to communicate effectively with everybody from store teams through to directors
- A proactive, self-starting approach combined with the ability to bring other people with you
- A willingness to remain hands-on with execution, rather than simply delegating activity
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to periodically visit locations across the wider estate


Paid-media experience is useful, but is not essential. The focus is on building a strong brand and commercially effective marketing approach across the complete customer journey. This matches Jason's revised requirements much better: SEO, social, email and CRM remain important, while paid media is expressly secondary.


Experience within a regulated, age-restricted, advertising-restricted or sensitivity-adjacent consumer sector would be particularly advantageous.


The Opportunity


You’ll be joining an established consumer business with a significant physical retail presence alongside a successful ecommerce operation.


There is genuine scope to influence how marketing is approached rather than simply inheriting an existing calendar. You’ll have regular exposure to senior decision-makers and the autonomy to introduce ideas, improve existing activity and build a more structured, measurable and joined-up approach to marketing.


This would particularly suit somebody who has worked within multi-site retail and understands that successful marketing doesn’t stop at generating website traffic. You should be equally interested in what is happening in individual stores, what drives customers through the door and how brand, CRM, ecommerce and local marketing can work together to increase revenue.


The position is £50,000 per annum and based full-time at the company’s head office in Rotherham, with periodic travel to locations across the estate.


If you’re a commercially focused Marketing Manager with genuine experience across physical retail and digital channels, we’d be keen to hear from you.

title: Brand & Digital Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Job Title: Brand & Digital Marketing Manager – Gorenje
Department: Marketing
Contract Type: Full time, permanent
Location: London, travel to Leeds office once a week


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Brand & Digital Marketing Manager to lead the development and launch of Gorenje in the UK market.


With Gorenje SDA products planned to launch in the UK, this is an exciting opportunity to build the brand's UK presence from the ground up. You will support our emerging retail channels, including TikTok Shop, Affiliate Marketing, Direct-to-Consumer (D2C), and other new digital routes to market.


You will take ownership of all Gorenje related brand and digital marketing activities, working closely with UK commercial teams, European and global stakeholders, agencies, retail partners, and other external partners.


Main Responsibilities:
Brand Strategy & UK Launch

- Develop and execute the UK brand strategy for Gorenje, aligned with the wider European and global brand direction.
- Lead the brand and marketing preparation for the UK launch of Gorenje products.
- Establish a clear UK brand positioning, proposition, target consumer, messaging, and communication strategy.
- Develop an integrated go-to-market marketing plan covering pre-launch, launch, and post-launch activities.
- Build brand awareness, consideration, and engagement within Gorenje's target UK consumer segments though digital marketing.
- Ensure a consistent brand identity, tone of voice, and consumer proposition across all UK touchpoints.
- Monitor consumer trends, competitor activity, category developments, and emerging digital behaviours to identify opportunities for the brand.


Digital Marketing & Consumer Acquisition

- Develop and manage Gorenje's UK digital marketing strategy, with a strong focus on driving awareness, traffic, engagement, and consumer acquisition.
- Plan and execute digital campaigns across paid social, paid search, display, video, SEO, CRM/email, influencer marketing, and other relevant digital channels.
- Develop and manage the Gorenje UK website to deliver a best in class user experience.
- Manage digital media investment and continuously optimise campaigns based on performance and ROI.
- Use consumer insights, digital analytics, and campaign data to improve targeting, engagement, and conversion.


Social Media, Content & Influencer Marketing

- Develop and manage Gorenje's UK social media and content strategy.
- Build an engaging content calendar covering product launches, brand storytelling, lifestyle content, campaigns, and key commercial periods.
- Develop a strong social media presence for Gorenje in the UK, with particular focus on Tiktok and Meta platforms relevant to the target consumer.
- Develop marketing activity that supports traffic and sales through TikTok Shop, Affiliate Marketing, Amazon, D2C, and other emerging channels.
- Identify opportunities to work with creators, influencers, KOLs, and other content partners to build awareness and consideration.
- Work closely with the sales team to align creator and content activity with TikTok Shop and Affiliate Marketing opportunities.
- Manage the localisation and creation of marketing assets, ensuring European and global content is relevant and effective for UK consumers.
- Ensure all content consistently reflects Gorenje's brand positioning, visual identity, and tone of voice.


Emerging Channel Marketing

- Work in close partnership with the Emerging Channel & Operations Manager to develop integrated marketing and commercial plans across Gorenje's key routes to market.
- Develop marketing campaigns and content to support TikTok Shop, Affiliate Marketing, Amazon, D2C, and other emerging retail channels.
- Align marketing calendars with product launches, promotions, channel campaigns, and key trading periods.
- Support the development of channel-specific content, creative assets, product storytelling, and consumer propositions.
- Use channel performance and consumer data to identify opportunities to improve traffic, engagement, conversion, and sales.
- Test and develop new digital marketing approaches and platforms as Gorenje's UK business grows.


D2C & Digital Consumer Experience

- Support the development of Gorenje's UK digital consumer journey and D2C presence.
- Ensure brand content, product information, campaign materials, and digital assets are engaging, consistent, and up to date.
- Work with the Emerging Channel & Operations Manager and relevant internal teams to optimise the consumer journey from brand discovery through to purchase.
- Develop digital content and campaigns designed to drive qualified traffic to Gorenje's sales channels.
- Analyse website and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve consumer engagement and conversion.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Build a strong working partnership with the sales team, ensuring marketing and commercial plans are closely aligned.
- Work closely with Product teams to understand product propositions, USPs, launch timings, and target audiences.
- Collaborate with European and global Gorenje teams to ensure UK activity aligns with wider brand strategy while remaining relevant to the UK market.
- Manage relationships with creative, media, PR, digital, influencer, and other external agencies and partners.
- Work cross-functionally with Ecommerce, Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and other relevant teams to support the successful development of the Gorenje business.


Budget & Performance Management

- Manage the Gorenje UK marketing budget, ensuring investment is allocated effectively across channels and campaigns.
- Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for brand and digital marketing activity.
- Monitor and report on brand awareness, traffic, engagement, consumer acquisition, campaign performance, and return on marketing investment.
- Work with the Emerging Channel & Operations Manager to understand the relationship between marketing investment, channel traffic, conversion, and sales performance.
- Use data and consumer insights to continuously optimise marketing activity and investment.
- Provide regular performance updates, analysis, and recommendations to senior management and relevant stakeholders.


Requirements

- Strong experience in Brand Marketing and Digital Marketing, ideally within a consumer-facing business.
- Demonstrable experience developing and executing integrated brand and digital marketing strategies.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including paid social, paid search, SEO, content, CRM, social media, and influencer marketing.
- Strong understanding of the relationship between digital marketing, consumer acquisition, ecommerce, and sales conversion.
- Experience managing marketing agencies, campaigns, budgets, and multiple stakeholders.
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect marketing activity to traffic, conversion, and revenue.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using data and insights to evaluate and optimise marketing performance.
- Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-moving and developing environment.
- Experience with social commerce, TikTok, influencer/creator marketing, D2C, or affiliate-driven ecommerce is desirable.


Benefits include, but are not limited to:

- Competitive salary with bonus scheme
- Pension contributions
- 25 days of holiday plus UK Bank Holidays
- Long service awards
- Salary sacrifice schemes
- Discounts on Hisense products
- Access to a shopping discount portal
- Restaurant and café discounts at our Leeds office

The brand offers a wide range of home appliances that combine distinctive European design, smart technology, and practical functionality to meet the needs of modern consumers.


Part of the Hisense Group, Gorenje has an established presence across Europe and international markets and continues to build on more than 75 years of experience in the home appliance industry.

Working at Schleich. Make your mark.


Consumer Marketing Manager - North (all genders)

- Implement and continuously optimize marketing strategies to strengthen brand awareness, accelerate consumer acquisition, and support sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
- Develop and execute regional marketing plans in alignment with global objectives and local market needs.
- Collaborate with Trade Marketing and Sales teams to ensure flawless execution of retail media plans, product launches, promotional campaigns, and permanent POS solutions.
- Support the implementation of winning marketing plans at key accounts in close partnership with local sales teams and key stakeholders.

- Partner closely with global marketing teams to ensure local market insights are reflected in strategic planning and execution.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and Legal to ensure alignment with company processes and priorities.
- Lead, develop, and support team members to ensure effective collaboration and achievement of business objectives.
- Own and manage the consumer marketing budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and maximum return on investment.
- Drive media planning, performance tracking, AAR (After Action Review), ROI analysis, and reporting of marketing activities.
- Coordinate local social media activities and ensure alignment with overall brand and communication strategies.
- Generate and leverage consumer, customer, and market insights to identify opportunities and support data-driven decision-making.


Your story so far:

-  You have an educational background in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration or similar
- You have experience of working in a multinational, matrixed organization in the consumer goods industry, desirable in a global FMCG or entertainment/fashion company
- You have 3-5 y experience and loves working hands on and directly with agencies and partners
- You have a proven track record in developing and successfully executing marketing strategies and plans as well as building up and maintaining partnerships with external marketing agencies
-  You have an entrepreneurial spirit, and you are hungry for opportunities and for developing ways to exploit them
-  You are, entrepreneurial, enthusiastic and passionate about brands and products

title: Manager, Product Marketing
descriptionText:
Who We Are

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

The PGA TOUR 2K Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing. We are responsible for building data-driven marketing strategies that reach and engage fans with value-rich experiences that drive revenue growth, brand health, and loyalty. We aim to connect fans around the world to the most engaging golf platform: our franchise.

As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will be responsible for helping deliver full-funnel marketing campaigns, in partnership with internal and external partners, to drive player satisfaction and commercial success. From Seasonal Live-Service executions, to multi-faceted partnership campaigns, to targeted in-game promotions, you will ideate on product feature messaging and strategies, lead in-game creative development, oversee tactical execution plans, and leverage new and emerging technologies to best serve our players. This is a role that never stands still, and where no two days are the same.

To be successful in this role, you will need to be a true product marketing expert that understands every facet of our game and how they serve our current and prospective players. Within the integrated marketing team, it is your responsibility to be the product’s source of truth to help inform go-to-market strategies through a strong, collaborative mindset and data-driven insight. An existing passion for, or a willingness to learn about, the sport of golf is key: the PGA TOUR 2K franchise is the most authentic representation of the sport, and success in this role is determined by our ability to demonstrate that to our players.

What You Will Do



- Manage comprehensive end-to-end marketing campaigns across our full live-services machine. From title-level level marketing planning, to Seasonal creative executions, to Free-to-Play activations, to real-life sporting event tie-ins. You will often manage multiple campaigns concurrently.
- Authentically represent player needs by knowing our game in and out, through a deep understanding and appreciation for player insights and analytics, as well as time spent in the game testing out features and flows to best represent ways we highlight product value and live services content. 
- Own our in-game lifecycle strategy: architecting messaging and offer constructs that move our players through the optimal player experience. Leverage campaign learnings and insights to optimize evergreen messaging and intervention timings. 
- Lead and execute high-profile brand partnerships, influencer tie-ins, and promotional activations; you will work with internal Partnerships and Product teams to help establish how our licensed partners come to life in-game, then build marketing campaigns to drive awareness and engagement with their branded content. 
- Build and maintain high-trust relationships across our Business Unit and our shared service teams to ensure zero friction in the execution of integrated global campaigns. 

What Will Make You A Great Fit

Product Passion & Literacy: You're as comfortable in a product roadmap conversation as a campaign brief kick off call. You know how to establish, define and represent marketing priorities to influence product decisions and create content that authentically resonates with our players.

Operational Rigor: You can hold multiple campaigns, live and upcoming, in harmony without losing precision on any one of them—meeting internal and external deadlines to execute flawlessly.

Content & Channel Fluency: You can partner with multiple cross-functional teams to orchestrate a multi-touchpoint tactical execution, understanding the nuance between owned, earned and paid channels to maximise acquisition and engagement.

Partnership & Licensing Acumen: You know how to run activations that integrate licenses, licensors and/or talent from concept through to legal sign-off, balancing creative ambition with third-party and IP priorities and obligations.

Cross-Functional Influence: You build trust quickly with key stakeholders across the Business Unit, shared services teams, and our development studio. You will operate as the connective tissue that keeps teams moving in the same direction towards execution.

Qualifications



- Proven experience in product marketing, live-service campaign management, or lifecycle marketing experience within gaming or digital entertainment.
- Extensive knowledge or interest in sports verticals, ideally golf.
- Passion to deliver thoughtfully integrated campaigns players can resonate with, that showcase the product as a means to drive awareness, acquisition and retention.
- Deep understanding of how to measure and report on marketing performance across owned and operated, earned, and paid channels.
- Strong ability to interpret data and learnings to influence real-time decision making.
- Familiarity with PC & console gaming marketing (PlayStation, Xbox. Steam) a plus.

Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

At TÜV SÜD Group we are passionate about technology. Innovations impact our daily lives in countless ways, and we are dedicated to being a part of that progress. We test, we audit, we inspect, we advise. We never stop challenging ourselves for the safety of society and its people. We breathe technology, we strive for professional excellence, and we leave a mark. We take the future into our hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

Role Overview

As a Marketing Manager Commercial Products (COM) for Europe, you partner mainly with the operational Business Unit COM in European countries (mainly UK) to adopt and/or establish marketing strategies to achieve the regional business goals. Acting as the market's counterpart of the Divisional Marketing BPs you ensure marketing activities are aligned with the divisional topics/strategy and tailored to the regional needs and priorities. You actively participate in global meetings to identify potential synergies and support to leverage cross-regional efficiencies within the team. Depending on the localisation level of solutions you adopt, adjust or develop and execute Marketing Plans that are tailored to the needs of the region or local business together with the Marketing Hub specialists, brand, business and sales. This role requires strategic thinking, strong stakeholder management skills to navigate the matrix environment, and a mindset focused on marketing excellence by developing effective, target-oriented solutions.

Main Responsibilities Incl. Deliverables



- Strategic Marketing: Partner the operational units through an outside-in (customer-oriented) approach. Align marketing initiatives with business priorities, revenue targets, and market expansion plans. Offer comprehensive advice on all marketing activities, develop and implement strategic marketing plans tailored to the regional business needs.
- Market insights: You leverage market data, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to provide regional insights for the regional product marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans. You actively provide regional (customer) insights to be included into the global marketing strategy.
- Content Strategy: Based on a value proposition and depending on the localisation level of a service, you adopt, adjust or develop a marketing, communication and content strategy for the target market(s), including buyer personas. For that you are aligned with the Divisional and other regional BPs.
- Market Activation: Depending on the localisation level of a service you adopt, adjust or design regional marketing campaigns and collaboratively ensure the execution with the Marketing Hub specialists.
- Performance Monitoring and Analysis: Ensure that all regional campaigns are results-driven and lead to measurable business impact. Collaboratively track and analyse your marketing KPIs and regularly report on the effectiveness of the marketing campaigns, programs, and initiatives and ensure optimisation. Collect and leverage customer feedback to continuously enhance marketing efforts and ensure that the approach is responsive to customers’ needs and preferences in the regions.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate and work closely with internal Marketing Hub teams, business, sales and other functions to ensure cohesive and effective marketing efforts. Work closely together with the other BPs globally to identify synergies and cross-regional efficiencies.

- Proven ability to work in an international business environment
- Strong ability to manage stakeholders demands.

- You are commercially astute and enjoy transforming insight into action.

- You are proactive, accountable and willing to challenge constructively to achieve the best outcomes.

· Collaboratively work with the marketing agency to deliver strategy and help them design activities to meet the purpose successfully
· Brief and deliver consistency of creative and messaging across all channels
· Manage relationship with the agency for campaign progress checks, stock verification, and scope of work setup
· Acquire final reports and provide data analysis feedback to stakeholders.


4. Digital & Content Marketing

· Support SEO article creation via HQ AI tools
· Support consumer review campaigns: identify new models, budget & voucher code discussions, and campaign operation & management


5. Partnership & Promotion
· Set up the partnership strategy and plan for the year
· Collaborate with brand partners on activations that allow us to maximise brand exposure and gain new potential customers
· Manage relationship with partners and liaise with the internal team and partners’ team to work together

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Addepar is seeking a passionate and data-driven Manager, Performance Marketing EMEA/APAC to drive our brand awareness and market expansion across the regions. This is an exciting opportunity for a marketing strategist to build and implement a regional marketing strategy that fuels Addepar's continued growth. This leader will be responsible for developing and driving a comprehensive marketing strategy tailored for the EMEA and APAC regions. This position will drive all digital, paid, and traditional marketing for the regions, and play a key role in shaping Addepar's brand image and market presence.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do



- Develop and drive a data-driven marketing strategy aligned with global business objectives, tailored to regional needs
- Own the development and execution of localised marketing campaigns across all channels (digital, content, etc.) to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and pipeline growth.
- Develop and maintain relationships with Sales leadership across EMEA and APAC 
- Collaborate closely with regional sales, client management, services and partner teams to understand market needs, develop effective marketing programs, and achieve shared goals
- Track, measure and report on the success of marketing campaigns and programs, and provide data-driven insights to optimise performance
- Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activity in the EMEA and APAC wealth management technology spaces

Who You Are



- Extensive experience in B2B financial services marketing, with a consistent track record of success in driving growth within the financial technology or wealth management industry
- Strong understanding of the EMEA and APAC marketing landscape having demonstrable experience establishing brands in the region
- Ability to translate marketing goals into measurable return on investment and contribute to the achievement of overall business objectives
- Deep expertise in digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, content marketing, social media, etc.)
- Ability to collaborate with global teams
- Fluency in English, with additional European languages a plus

Our Values 



- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
- Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
- Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
- Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
- Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
