title: Manager, Marketing & Eminence, Clients & Markets team
descriptionText:
Connect to your Industry
Imagine a role where your creativity meets real-world impact, shaping the future of a leading global professional services firm. Deloitte is thrilled to invite you to become a vital part of our Clients & Markets team, specifically within our new Marketing & Eminence team. We are a vibrant and diverse collective of skilled specialists across Marketing, Insight, Brand, and Channels, united by a shared mission: to create fantastic client experiences, drive measurable impact, and significantly contribute to the strategic growth of our UK business. If you're ready to make your mark and thrive in a collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.


Connect to your career at Deloitte 
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.


What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.


Connect to your opportunity
Reporting to a Marketing Senior Manager, you will play a key role in executing impactful marketing campaigns and initiatives that support Deloitte UK's business objectives. You will work closely with marketing colleagues across business and industry; business development colleagues; and the service line professionals to develop, execute and measure the effectiveness of the marketing strategy and plan for a service line.


Responsibilities include:

- Support the development and implementation of marketing plans for specific business lines, markets or industries.
- Collaborate closely with stakeholders across marketing (including other business lines and industries), business development, service line professionals, clients and markets teams and subject matter experts to make marketing activities impactful for our clients.
- Advise on the development of market propositions and execute plans for their promotion in the market via account teams.
- Manage the execution of marketing activities across various channels, including digital marketing, email marketing, content creation, events, and social media.
- Engage both business development teams and account teams to ensure marketing activities are relevant, timely, and sales enabling.
- Track and analyse marketing campaign performance, providing regular reports and insights to stakeholders. Use data to identify trends and make recommendations for future strategies.
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure cost-effective execution of activities
- Maintain a strong understanding of Deloitte's brand guidelines and ensure consistent application across all marketing materials.
- Stay up to date on industry trends, best practices, and emerging marketing technologies.
- Contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.


Connect to your skills and professional experience

- Proven experience as a highly performing Marketing Manager or in a similar role, ideally within professional services
- Ability to work with technical, non-marketing SMEs and the curiosity to develop a solid understanding of their business, market and offerings
- Strong understanding of marketing principles and best practices across multiple channels.
- Experience in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Excellent project management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Experience in managing budgets and tracking return on investment for marketing activities.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.


Connect to your business - Enabling Functions
Collaboration is central to everything we do at Deloitte. From IT to HR, marketing and more, our teams help to support the wider business in everything they do. Bringing your individual skills and specialist knowledge, you can make a far-reaching impact. Come join us.


Clients and Markets
We bring together capabilities and best practices from around the globe to deliver relationship development activities, marketing and corporate affairs, whilst our operations team is focused on ensuring we’re constantly improving what we do.


Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.


Connect with your colleagues
"Deloitte’s a large, complex and fast-paced organisation but it’s open to new ideas. Everyone is encouraged to show initiative and challenge the norm." - Lisa, Enabling Functions


Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in one of our UK offices with hybrid working.
At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.


Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.


We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.


Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.


Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Our vision is to be the best place for healthcare anywhere and the best place to work in healthcare.


We believe that every life deserves world class healthcare.


Job Summary
Salary: Competitive, Depending on Experience
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm
Location: 40 Grosvenor Place, London SW1X 7AW (hybrid working)
Contract:  Full-time, permanent


What are we looking for?
The Marketing manager is responsible for developing comprehensive marketing and communication strategies to drive brand awareness, volume and revenue growth for Cleveland Clinic London. We have been open for four years and are looking for someone to help lead our next stage of growth and deliver our advertising and partnership plans.


This includes ownership of planning and delivery to support the development of productive relationships with a range of external key stakeholders.


You will report to the Head of Business Development & Marketing and will partner with clinical and functional teams across the organisation (here in the UK and the US) on various projects.


What makes us different?
Cleveland Clinic London offers a brand-new high-acuity environment with the very latest equipment, where caregivers are encouraged to grow their expertise across multiple specialties, and in collaboration with expert clinicians. Our Mission, ‘Caring for life, researching for health, and educating those who serve’, assures our unwavering commitment to professional development.


What will your duties include?

- Manages 2 direct reports: the marketing lead, officer and interns as assigned and collaborates with our global marketing colleagues to drive departmental goals
- Leads on cross channel marketing tactics to drive brand awareness, volume and revenue growth (across payor types), in collaboration with business development, clinical teams and other key stakeholders.
- Leads and develop marketing campaigns across all channels including extensive digital activities (PPC 3rd party platforms), focussed around new clinical services and other key strategic growth projects
- Initiates public relations tactics with our global Department of Public and Media relations
- Provides appropriate regular reporting to the Head of Business Development & Marketing and respective leadership groups and committees.
- Proactively scans the healthcare market, and competitor/customer landscape for relevant marketing opportunities.
- Represents Cleveland Clinic at conferences where networking opportunities exist.
- Support the Head of Business Development & Marketing and collaborate with the wider commercial team on all key initiatives to drive growth for CCL.
- Support Head of Business Development & Marketing to ensure that marketing policies, systems, structures and approaches are fit for purpose and compliant.
- Works collaboratively with other colleagues in the Growth function.


What we need from you?

- Previous experience of working in healthcare services (private or NHS) essential
- Previous experience of managing marketing budgets and contracts is essential
- Experience using Microsoft Office Suite Products (Outlook, Word, Excel or PowerPoint), essential
- Experience of proactive marketing approaches including market reviews and mapping of competitor/ customer landscape for relevant marketing opportunities is essential
- Previous experience of line management is essential
- Previous experience of managing and reporting on digital marketing tactics, essential
- Previous experience of digital marketing is essential
- Previous experience of working with senior stakeholders highly desirable
- Previous experience of running cross-functional projects highly desirable


What can we offer you?
As a private hospital with no shareholders, we reinvest profits back into our organisation. This means we can offer tailored support and development for caregivers, alongside benefits such as:

- 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
- Auto-Enrolment of 5% pension - Cleveland Clinic contributes 10% through Salary Exchange
- Life Assurance, Private Medical & Dental Insurance and Eye Care contributions
- Discounted gym facilities
- 24/7 Holistic Employee Assistance Programme
- Workplace Nursery Scheme
- Season Ticket Loan
- Cycle to Work Scheme


Who we are?
Cleveland Clinic is one of the leading providers of specialised medical care in the world, providing clinical excellence and superior patient outcomes for almost 6 million patient visits per year across more than 200 locations. We employ over 80,000 caregivers worldwide and continue to drive innovation in healthcare.


With over 100 years of history, our “Patients First” philosophy is at the heart of everything that we do.


If you would like to know more, please email recruitment@ccf.org.
‎
Applicant shortlisting and interviews may take place whilst the advert is live, so it may close sooner than expected - please submit your application as soon as possible. Due to the volume of applications, we are not always able to provide individual feedback.


Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) Check
This role may be subject to the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (Exceptions) Order (as amended) and it will be necessary for a submission for Disclosure to be made to the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to check for any previous criminal convictions.


“Let’s deliver World Class care together!”
As an equal opportunities employer, we aspire to work together to promote a more inclusive work environment, which represents our commitment to celebrate diversity.

descriptionText:
+ Marketing Manager – Brand
+ £40,000 – £50,000 
+ Birmingham – hybrid working


Marketing Manager needed!


We’re delighted to have partnered with a brilliant Birmingham-based ecommerce business that has grown at a phenomenal pace – and they’re showing no signs of slowing down. Founder-led, the business has a hands-on, engaging and fast-paced culture, with a real focus on exceptional customer service, product development and putting the customer first.


Specialising in the heating, cooling and electrical sector, they offer a broad range of products across multiple ecommerce platforms and marketplaces. They know their market inside out and have built a successful business by understanding what their customers want and delivering quality products at competitive price points.


As the business has evolved, they’ve invested heavily in their digital and ecommerce presence. But with so much focus on performance and growth, they’ve recognised an opportunity to do more with their brand marketing.


And that’s where you come in....

At CloserStill, we strive to deliver the best. We’re on a mission to be the most dynamic B2B events and communities business in every market we serve, bringing people together to learn, connect and grow.

Operating across five regions, we power over 200 market-leading events, publications and brands across Business Technologies, Healthcare, Learning, HR & Education, and Future Transport & Infrastructure.

But what truly sets us apart is our people.

Our teams are diverse, driven, and united by a shared commitment to excellence. Rooted in our core values of ownership, empathy, teamwork, integrity, and determination, we empower every employee to grow, shape their own path and make a meaningful impact.

Joining CloserStill means being part of something bigger - not just building events, but creating opportunities, connections, and lasting value for the communities we serve.

IMRG is one of our brands, a leading eCommerce association helping retailers, brands, and technology providers navigate the industry. You'll be joining a team that runs market-leading data, events, insights, and an established community platform.

Who We Are Looking For

We're after someone who can do two things at once: think creatively about marketing and obsess over the numbers.

You'll drive lead generation and membership growth for IMRG, but you'll also own the marketing strategy, identifying new opportunities, testing what works, and shaping how the brand evolves as eCommerce changes.

- Find cross-sell opportunities across IMRG's product suite
- Think long-term sustainability, not one-off wins

- Make IMRG's expertise impossible to ignore

- Build year-round strategies that keep people connected through events, webinars, reports, and community initiatives

- Use insights to constantly optimise where you invest time and money

- Event experience is a bonus, not a requirement

Skills & Mindset



- Data-comfortable — you use numbers to make decisions, not gut feel

- Can juggle multiple campaigns and priorities without dropping anything

- Proven experience building and executing marketing plans that drive pipeline, revenue contribution, and measurable business outcomes.
- Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to align marketing strategy tightly to sales priorities and business growth goals.
- Experience working closely with sales teams and cross-functional revenue teams in a highly collaborative environment.
- Confident owning both acquisition and retention marketing activity, with a clear understanding of the full buyer and customer lifecycle.
- Able to operate across multiple channels and programme types, with sound judgement on how to build the right mix for market needs and commercial return.
- Comfortable using data to shape strategy, optimise performance, and communicate impact to senior stakeholders.

title: Marketing Manager - Lamborghini + Bentley
descriptionText:
About us: We are one of the top three automotive retailers in the UK, proudly representing 32 manufacturer brands, selling a huge range of new and used vehicles from over 150 dealerships across the UK and Ireland.

We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to recognising the valuable contribution each person makes. That’s why we continue to invest in a leading rewards and benefits package designed to support your career, wellbeing, and life outside of work.

Location: Belfast, Charles Hurst – on site

Salary: £38,000 - £40,000 per annum (depending on experience) + Benefits

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm

Reporting to: Head of Marketing, Charles Hurst

About The Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Manager to support two of the world's most prestigious automotive brands, Lamborghini and Bentley, reporting directly to the Head of Marketing for Charles Hurst.

As Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in driving brand awareness, customer engagement, enquiry generation and retention across both marques. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, manufacturer partners and internal stakeholders, you'll develop and deliver impactful marketing strategies that reflect the exclusivity, heritage and customer experience synonymous with luxury automotive retail.

This role requires a commercially minded and agile marketing professional who can balance creativity with performance, understand the differing requirements of multiple brands and products, and react quickly to changing business and market conditions. You'll be expected to take ownership of campaigns from planning through to delivery, measurement and optimisation, ensuring activity delivers against both brand and commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Customer Retention



- Develop and deliver innovative marketing initiatives to generate high-quality sales and aftersales enquiries.
- Create customer retention strategies that enhance loyalty and strengthen long-term relationships with existing clients.
- Support VIP customer acquisition and ownership events to drive engagement and brand affinity.

Brand & Manufacturer Partnership



- Act as the key day-to-day marketing contact for Lamborghini and Bentley manufacturer partners.
- Understand the individual requirements, customer profiles and commercial priorities of each brand, adapting marketing activity accordingly.
- Ensure all marketing activity adheres to OEM guidelines and brand standards.
- Build strong relationships with manufacturer representatives and maximise available marketing support and funding opportunities.

Marketing Strategy & Campaign Delivery



- Working with the Head of Marketing, create and manage annual and quarterly marketing plans for both brands, responding appropriately to changing business needs, stock requirements, product priorities and market conditions.
- Develop and deliver targeted multi-channel campaigns across digital, social media, CRM, events and traditional marketing channels.
- Take ownership of campaigns from concept and briefing through to implementation, optimisation and post-campaign analysis.
- Monitor luxury automotive market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviour to inform marketing strategy and campaign decisions.
- Work closely with compliance teams to ensure all communications meet FCA, ASA and manufacturer requirements.

Digital Marketing & Campaign Optimisation



- Demonstrate a strong understanding of digital campaign delivery, including campaign tagging, tracking, measurement and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance throughout the campaign lifecycle, using data and insight to optimise activity and improve results.
- Adjust campaigns, audiences, messaging, channel mix and investment in response to performance, market conditions and changing business requirements.
- Work effectively with internal digital specialists and agency partners across paid search, paid social, display, CRM and other performance channels.
- Ensure appropriate tracking and measurement is in place to demonstrate campaign effectiveness, enquiry generation and ROI.

Budget Management



- Manage annual and quarterly marketing budgets across both brands in conjunction with the Head of Marketing.
- Effectively allocate investment across channels, campaigns and products according to business priorities and anticipated return.
- Monitor spend and performance throughout the year, proactively recommending and implementing budget reallocations between channels or campaigns where required to maximise results.
- Maintain clear oversight of committed and actual spend, manufacturer funding and campaign performance.
- Demonstrate strong commercial judgement when balancing brand-building activity with lead generation and short-term business requirements.

Events & Customer Experience



- Plan and deliver exclusive customer events, vehicle launches, driving experiences and networking opportunities.
- Collaborate with dealership teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences that reflect the prestige of both brands.
- Support local sponsorship and partnership opportunities that align with brand positioning.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management



- Brief campaigns clearly and effectively to internal marketing teams and external agencies.
- Work closely with dealership management, sales teams, operational colleagues and manufacturer partners to understand business requirements and ensure successful campaign execution.
- Build strong intercompany relationships across Marketing, Sales, Operations and the wider business.
- Influence key stakeholders and provide marketing expertise and recommendations to support commercial objectives.

Performance & Reporting



- Establish clear KPIs to measure campaign effectiveness and return on investment.
- Analyse campaign performance, lead generation, customer behaviour and channel effectiveness, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Provide regular reporting and performance updates to the Head of Marketing, internal stakeholders and manufacturer partners.
- Use campaign insight and previous results to inform future marketing plans, budget allocation and channel strategy.

About You

We're looking for a passionate, commercially driven marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and understands the importance of delivering exceptional brand experiences while achieving measurable business results.

You will be comfortable managing multiple brands, products and priorities simultaneously, recognising that each may require a different marketing approach. You'll combine strong campaign management skills with a data-led mindset, using performance insight to make informed decisions and adjust activity when required.

Skills & Experience



- Proven marketing experience within a fast-paced, commercially focused environment.
- Experience working across multiple brands, products or business areas, with the ability to understand differing commercial requirements and adapt marketing activity appropriately.
- Demonstrable experience developing, managing and delivering successful multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept through to execution and measurement.
- Strong digital marketing experience, including campaign tagging, tracking, monitoring, reporting and optimisation.
- Ability to interpret campaign data and make proactive adjustments to targeting, messaging, channel mix and investment based on performance, market conditions and business requirements.
- Clear experience of managing annual and quarterly marketing budgets, including planning, forecasting, monitoring spend and allocating investment across brands, products and channels.
- Experience of performance-managing marketing investment across different channels, reallocating budget where appropriate to improve effectiveness and return on investment.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, CRM and customer journey management.
- Strong analytical skills with experience tracking campaign performance, lead generation and ROI.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Operations and the wider business.
- Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, brands, projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercially minded, proactive and comfortable responding quickly to changing priorities and business needs.
- Automotive, luxury retail or premium brand experience would be advantageous.

Core Benefits



- Competitive salaries with structured pay scales and progression as you grow within the business
- Generous annual leave that increases with your length of service
- Enhanced family leave, including 6 months’ full pay for maternity and adoption leave, and 2 weeks’ full pay for paternity leave
- Access to Techscheme for discounted technology purchases with flexible payments

Health & Wellbeing



- Eyecare vouchers to help cover vision care needs
- Smart Health – 24/7 access to GP services to support your mental and physical wellbeing
- Dental insurance for everyday dental care and unexpected treatments
- Optional critical illness cover for peace of mind during life's most challenging moments

Financial Wellbeing



- MyView PayNow – access a portion of your pay as you earn, with features to stream, save, and track your money through a user-friendly app
- Free will writing services to help plan for the future
- Flexible life assurance options and partner life assurance for added protection

Leisure & Lifestyle



- Discounted gym memberships to support an active lifestyle
- Travel insurance to help you explore with confidence
- Access to home and technology vouchers
- bYond card and a wide range of exclusive retail and lifestyle discounts

descriptionText:
Marketing Manager
Minka Dink London


ABOUT MINKA DINK LONDON
Minka Dink London is a fast-growing female fashion brand creating versatile, timeless pieces designed to be worn and loved season after season. We are at an exciting stage of growth, with our team expanding, our collections growing and our community continuing to reach new audiences. As the brand enters its next chapter, we are looking for a strategic and hands-on Marketing Manager to own our marketing function end to end and help shape how Minka Dink grows.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing brand at a pivotal stage, with real ownership over strategy and budget, and the chance to shape how Minka Dink is seen, experienced, and grown across every channel.


THE ROLE
The Marketing Manager will take full ownership of Minka Dink's marketing strategy and output day to day, across social, content, email, and paid. You will build and run the marketing calendar, oversee content and photoshoots, own our email marketing programme, assist on managing budgets and strategy for paid media alongside our agency, and keep a constant eye on what is actually working so we can do more of it. 


Our marketing needs are constantly evolving, from seasonal campaigns and collaborations to pop-ups and new product drops. We are looking for someone ambitious who thrives in a fast-paced, start-up environment, brings a constant stream of fresh ideas while being commercially minded about what drives results.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Marketing Strategy & Planning

- Own the marketing calendar end to end across social, content, email, and paid, planning themes, formats, and cadence around seasonal launches, product drops, and campaign moments
- Translate campaign concepts (collaborations, seasonal collections, sale periods) into a joined-up marketing plan across every channel
- Set and manage the marketing budget, allocating spend across channels based on performance and priorities


Content Strategy & Planning

- Oversee the social content calendar across all channels, working with the Content Creator and Social Media & Content Assistant to keep it on track
- Translate campaign concepts into concrete content plans and shot lists
- Keep a rolling view of what's performing and adjust the plan accordingly


Photoshoot Planning & Production

- Plan and oversee photoshoots (big and small), supported by the Social Media & Content Assistant and the Marketing & Content Assistant
- Coordinate content tracking and delivery across multiple creators contributing to the same campaign or moment


Campaign Marketing (Email & Site) & CRM

- Plan the email marketing calendar alongside the Head of Ecommerce, aligning campaigns and flows with the wider marketing and content calendar
- Write and brief email copy and creative in Minka Dink's tone of voice
- Brief the Ecommerce Assistant on building out emails in Klaviyo, based on campaign themes and creative direction
- Plan website banners around campaigns, launches, and key moments, working with the Head of Ecommerce and Ecommerce Assistant
- Brief and coordinate site changes that reflect campaign moments — homepage, collection pages, and key landing pages — so the site feels joined up with what's happening across social, email, and paid
- Track and optimise email performance (open rates, click-through, revenue attribution) and iterate accordingly


Paid Media & Ad Strategy

- Own ad strategy alongside our paid social agency, setting direction for what content and creative should perform across upper, mid and lower funnel
- Manage paid media budget and set targets, reporting on spend efficiency and return
- Brief ad creatives - writing clear, actionable briefs for both organic-style and paid-specific content so creators and the agency have what they need to deliver
- Keep a pulse on which organic content is performing well and feed that insight into what gets turned into paid creative


Reporting & Optimisation

- Track performance across all marketing channels - social, email, paid, and site. Report back on what's resonating and what's driving revenue
- Feed insight into the wider business strategy, connecting marketing performance to sales and growth targets
- Keep organised records of plans, briefs, budgets, and assets in project management tools and Google Drive


Influencer Management

- Set the overall influencer strategy — identifying influencers and content types that align with the Minka Dink aesthetic and audience
- Oversee outreach, gifting, and negotiation for influencer collaborations, carried out by the Content Creator and Social Media & Content Assistant
- Set briefs for campaign themes, key messaging, and content requirements so influencer output feels on-brand
- Review influencer performance and ROI, using insight to shape future partnerships and budget allocation


PR & Events Management

- Set the overall PR strategy - identifying press, journalist, and media opportunities that align with the Minka Dink brand and key campaign moments
- Oversee outreach and relationship-building with journalists and press contacts, carried out by the Content Creator and Social Media & Content Assistant
- Lead event strategy for press days, showroom events, and brand activations, briefing the team on execution
- Set briefs for key messaging and press materials so coverage feels on-brand and aligned with wider campaigns
- Review press coverage and event outcomes, using insight to shape future PR and event activity


Cross-functional Collaboration & Team Management

- Work closely with the Founder on marketing strategy and campaign concepts, taking ideas from initial concept through to execution
- Collaborate closely with the ecommerce team to ensure marketing, site content and conversion touchpoints — including PDPs, collection pages and UGC — feel connected and consistent
- Manage and support two direct reports — the Content Creator and Social Media & Content Assistant — setting clear priorities, providing direction and keeping output on track
- Brief and manage freelancers, external creators and other creative partners as required
- Support in-person brand activations, including pop-ups and events, overseeing on-the-ground content and marketing coverage


SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- 3-5 years of proven marketing experience, ideally spanning social, content, email, and paid within a fashion, lifestyle, or DTC ecommerce brand
- Bonus if you have experience working for a start-up/founder-led team
- A genuinely strong eye for aesthetic, "Minka Dink style" content
- Copywriting skills - able to write with a distinctive Minka Dink brand voice consistently across social, email, and ads
- Comfortable moving between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution
- Confident across Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest content formats, with an instinct for what performs on each and how the platforms differ
- Experience managing budget and reporting on marketing ROI/ROAS
- Experience managing or briefing creators, freelancers, or a small team
- Organised and self-directed - able to run a marketing calendar independently
- Comfortable working in project management tools and Google Drive for planning and asset management
- Ability to think strategically and commercially, as well as creatively


INFORMATION

- Full time, permanent role
- Reports to: Founder
- Start Date: ASAP
- Location: 4 days a week in our office in SW London (Fulham Broadway/Imperial Wharf)
- Generous annual product allowance
- 25 days holiday
- Salary dependent on role fit & experience
- You will have two direct reports - Social Media & Content Assistant and Marketing & Content Assistant 


APPLICATION
Please email your CV and cover letter to careers@minkadinklondon.com with the subject line ‘Marketing Manager’.

descriptionText:
Are you an ambitious brand marketer with a passion for food, drink and great guest experiences? Join All Bar One as our permanent Marketing Manager and help shape the brand, grow consumer demand and drive sales across our bars.

Part of Mitchells & Butlers’ City division, All Bar One is a premium bar brand built on warmth, effortless style and sociability. For over 30 years, our welcoming spaces in landmark locations across the UK have brought people together over beer, coffee, cocktails, wine and quality food.

You’ll report to the Head of Brand Marketing for our City division, work with the wider City Marketing team and lead an Assistant Marketing Manager. This mobile role offers flexibility to work from home, the office or our bars, with travel to London on average once a week. Travel requirements may vary according to business needs.

You’ll be well rewarded



- Mobile working: flexibility to work from home, the office or one of our bars.
- Company car or car allowance.
- Annual bonus scheme and private medical plan.
- 33% discount across our brands, plus a 20% friends and family discount for five people you nominate.
- Pension, 26 days’ paid holiday, high-street shopping discounts and free shares.
- Free employee helpline to support you with whatever life brings.

The opportunity

You’ll turn brand strategy and guest insight into annual marketing plans that build brand equity, attract guests and drive commercial growth. Working with operations, sales, suppliers and other internal teams, you’ll help deliver a consistent guest experience across food, drink and our bar environments.



- Develop and deliver annual marketing plans that support the brand’s short- and medium-term strategy, sales growth and market share.
- Create campaigns that strengthen brand positioning, engage target guests and drive visits and sales. Evaluate results to improve future activity.
- Use guest insight and market understanding to evolve the brand proposition and identify opportunities for growth.

- Work with suppliers and third-party partners to create compelling reasons to visit and activations that build awareness and maximise sales.
- Partner with the sales team to grow large-party bookings and celebrations.

- Manage the brand marketing budget, monitor spend and assess the effectiveness of marketing activity.

What We’d Like To See From You



- Strong brand marketing experience, with a track record of delivering campaigns that engage consumers and achieve commercial results.
- Experience of managing multiple projects at pace, with close attention to detail.

- Experience of managing marketing budgets and influencing internal stakeholders and external partners.

- A strategic, commercial and creative approach, with the initiative to turn ideas into action.

At M&B, we value the unique perspectives each person brings. Our culture of inclusion, respect and allyship helps people feel they belong and supports the teamwork behind great guest experiences.

title: Marketing Manager UK
descriptionText:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust! 
Trustpilot is at a very exciting stage in our journey, and we’d like you to join us at this pivotal moment as we enter a new period of growth with a renewed strategic direction. The Marketing Manager is a critical role in helping us achieve our ambitions and vision to create an independent currency of trust in our key markets. 
You will be a key member of the Regional Marketing team, and will help build:
Strategies that attract customers and drive revenue at scale, working closely with global Marketing teams.Omni-channel programs and campaigns and events targeting our prospects and working with our Commercial partners to optimise conversion.  Expertise in market nuances and local insight, being natives in the markets we represent. The full marketing mix in each market fulfilling the plans and ambitions for that market and a consistent brand narrative.  
This role will help develop our acquisition marketing strategy to deliver value and growth in our prospect marketing strategies across the UK. You will be responsible for leading impactful and commercially focused campaigns aimed at increasing brand awareness, engagement and lead generation across our key segments. You will lead our events strategy including strategy & execution of third-party sponsored events, roundtables and Trustpilot owned events. 
What you'll be doing:

- Own and deliver multi-channel demand generation campaigns with a strong focus on brand messaging and ROI - including email, events, digital and content.
- Own the UK events strategy across owned and third party events. This includes negotiating sponsorship packages, organising roundtable events, post event follow-up campaigns, and commercial alignment. 
- Work closely with local sales and partner functions to align on goals and maximize the effectiveness of campaigns.
- Write copy for web, paid digital, email and others, along with creating landing pages to support campaigns. 
- Take full responsibility for each of your campaigns; delivering on time and on budget, with clear ROI or other metrics.
- Analyse these programs and report on campaign performance.
- Coordinate with other marketing departments, including brand, content, comms and digital, to bring cohesion and consistency to every campaign. 
Who you are:

- Proven experience in a B2B marketing role with events & campaign experience 
- Ability to operate in a high-performance, commercial environment and strive to continuously learn and improve
- Proven experience of building and executing B2B campaigns in a SaaS business - with demonstrable strong ROI
- Continual focus on customer-centric, data-driven insights to drive decisions to improve business performance 
- A proactive hands-on approach, with the ability to work on both strategic and tactical levels
- Hands-on knowledge of a marketing automation platform, CRM systems and digital platforms. Ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce
- High energy level, with a bias for positivity, action and accountability
- Solid stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence others - regardless of seniority or department.
We are:
We are a really close-knit team, spanning London, New York , Copenhagen and Melbourne. We value teamwork very highly, and everyone is really happy to roll their sleeves up and help out whenever it’s needed. We are looking for someone like-minded to join our team.  We work from a central program plan, which everyone is able (and encouraged!) to feed into, but we also have the autonomy to suggest and deliver on our own campaigns that fit into these wider objectives. The breadth of responsibilities in the marketing team means that no one day is the same - perfect for restless marketers who are always looking for a challenge!
What's in it for you:

- A hybrid work set up (2 days a week required from our London office)
- Competitive compensation package + bonus
- 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment 
- Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
- Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
- Pension and life insurance
- Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7, Employee Assistance Plan
- Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
- Paid parental leave
- Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme
- Central office location complete with table tennis, a gaming corner, coffee bars and all the snacks and refreshments you can ask for
- Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials.
- Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more.
- Independent financial advice and free standard professional mortgage broker advice
- Talent acceleration programs: Fast-track your career with our tailored development programs designed to support growth at whatever stage of your career
  
About us
Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
Join us at the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

descriptionText:
At Frasers Group we’re rethinking retail. Through digital innovation and unique store experiences, we’re serving our consumers with the world’s best sports, premium and luxury brands globally. As a leader in the industry, we’re elevating the retail experience for our consumers through our collection of established brands, including Sports Direct, FLANNELS, USC, Frasers, and GAME.

Sports Directory is proud to be part of Frasers Group, and we are passionate about uniting Sports with Education. We recognise that education is more than textbooks and classrooms – it’s about building character, encouraging teamwork and nurturing physical and mental well-being.

Our mission is to support teachers and students alike to achieve their full potential supporting teachers to cultivate an environment where physical education is valued just as highly as academic achievement. Founded in 1993, Sports Directory is the number one supplier of Sports education equipment and are specialists in education.

Why join us?

Our vision - We are building the planet’s most admired and compelling brand ecosystem

Our purpose - We are elevating the lives of the many with access to the world’s best brands and experiences

At Frasers Group, We Fear Less And Do More. Our People Are Forward Thinkers Who Are Driven To Operate Outside Of Their Comfort Zone To Change The Future Of Retail, Embracing Challenges Along The Way. The Potential To Elevate Your Career Is Massive, The Experience Unrivalled. To Be Able To Make The Most Of It You Need To Live And Breathe Our Principles



- Own it and back yourself - Own the basics, own your role and own the result
- Think without limits - Think, think fast, think fearlessly
- Be relevant - Relevant to our people, our partners and the planet

Are you ready to join the Fearless?

Job Description

The Role:

Reporting to the Head of Commercial & Marketing, you will be responsible for turning business priorities into clear, engaging and measurable marketing activity.

You will develop strong relationships with leading organisations across sport and education, identifying opportunities for joint campaigns, useful content, events and initiatives that genuinely support schools. Partnerships are a vital part of our business and will play an important role in helping us grow, strengthen our offer and deliver greater value to schools.

You will create and manage an annual marketing plan built around the academic year, school purchasing patterns, product launches and wider business priorities.

You will work closely with the Marketing Executive, helping to shape and develop our marketing activity while collaborating with our Commercial, Sales, Customer Service and Design teams.

Key Responsibilities



- Create and deliver an annual marketing plan aligned with company objectives and the school calendar.
- Plan and manage targeted campaigns across email, website, social media, catalogues and print.
- Develop marketing activity that attracts new schools, strengthens existing customer relationships and encourages repeat purchases.
- Build strong relationships with partners across education and school sport, identifying opportunities for joint campaigns, resources, content and events.
- Lead the marketing of My School Rewards, ensuring its benefits are communicated clearly and consistently.
- Develop relevant and useful content for teachers, schools, trusts and other education professionals.
- Plan and deliver our presence at exhibitions and conferences.
- Use customer insight and campaign results to measure performance, identify improvements and shape future activity.
- Monitor competitor activity and market trends to identify new opportunities and audiences.
- Manage internal budgets for marketing activity and events, ensuring spending is planned, monitored and used effectively.
- Maintain a consistent brand, tone of voice and high standard across all customer communications.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who can bring ideas to life while keeping plans, deadlines and budgets firmly on track.

You Will Ideally Have



- Experience in a Marketing Manager or similar marketing role.
- Experience planning and delivering successful multi-channel campaigns.
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
- Excellent planning, project management and organisational skills.
- Experience developing external partnerships and managing multiple stakeholders.
- The confidence to work across departments and turn commercial priorities into effective marketing activity.
- A good understanding of customer segmentation, digital marketing and the customer journey.
- An analytical approach, with the ability to use performance data to make informed decisions.
- Experience managing or developing another member of a marketing team.
- A creative, proactive mindset and a willingness to test new ideas.

Desirable

Experience of working in, or closely with, schools, education or school sport would be a real advantage. An understanding of the challenges schools face, how they plan and purchase, and what teachers need from their suppliers would help you make an immediate impact in the role.

Additional Information

Along with your benefits package we also offer a wide range of perks for our colleagues:

Frasers Champion - Our employees are at the heart of our business and we ensure individuals are recognised every single month for their hard work. Frasers Champion is a peer nominated scheme where 8 winners will receive double their pay for a month where they have lived the Frasers Group values.

Retail Reconnect - In order to build the planets most admired and compelling brand ecosystem, all employees must understand our business, product and customers. Each financial year, head office employees will gain insights by spending one to two days in one of our stores or the warehouse. The goal is to learn how the work you do impacts our teams on the frontline, and to bring ideas back to the office which will improve how we work.

Fearless 1200 - Fearless 1200 is our way of recognising our growth. It’s bold, ambitious, and designed to reward colleagues across the business for living our values and delivering impact. Fearless 1200 links how we perform to how we're rewarded – check out the video link to find out more - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O0qmvJofMew

Employee Welfare

Frasers Fit - Our Everlast Gyms Team are on a mission to make our workforce the best, and fittest on the planet! We run free gym classes for employees as well as discounted memberships to our clubs. Frasers Fit is our wellbeing programme which aims to support and improve colleagues Physical, Financial & Mental wellbeing. The app is accessible for every employee and includes training, nutrition and lifestyle advice- all completely free.

Retail Trust - We know that its not just about physical health, mental wellness is equally important which is why all of our employees get free access and support from the Retail Trust charity. This includes a 24 hour wellbeing helpline, wellness hub, counselling and financial/legal support.

What’s next?

Our Recruitment Team will be reviewing applications and all candidates will receive a response, whether you are successful or unsuccessful. Shortlisted applicants may be asked to confirm a few key details before being booked in for a first stage interview with the Recruiter - this will be behaviourally focussed and centred around how you align with our Culture and Values. If successful we anticipate one or two further interview stages with the Hiring Manager/wider team which will be more technically focussed and could include a presentation/task so we can see your skills in action.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
About Alvarez & Marsal


Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.


The Team 


A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement (PEPI) in Europe. The PEPI team is a highly ambitious, fast growing team that helps organisations navigate complex business challenges, boost performance improvement, and maximize stakeholder value.
It's a team of operators, consultants, and industry experts focused on unlocking value within the investment portfolios of private equity and corporate clients throughout the investment lifecycle — from pre-deal diligence through to post-deal transformation.


How you will contribute


We are looking for a Marketing Manager to focus on strengthening brand positioning, driving market visibility, and executing integrated marketing initiatives that support growth. Working closely with the PEPI go to market leader and the European Managing Directors, the position combines strategic input with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high growth, matrixed professional services environment.


 Brand & Market Positioning

- Support the development and refinement of A&M PEPI’s brand and market positioning across EMEA
- Ensure consistent messaging aligned to core value propositions and target sectors
- Identify and support opportunities for our business to connect with key audiences
Campaigns & PR

- Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across key markets
- Support PR activity, including media outreach, announcements, and press coverage
Thought Leadership

- Collaborate with senior stakeholders to develop and promote thought leadership content
- Identify relevant topics aligned to market trends and client priorities
- Support the promotion of thought leadership content across web, social media, email marketing and earned media channels.
Content & Communications

- Develop and manage high-quality marketing content, including internal and external communications
- Ensure consistency of tone, messaging, and brand across all materials
- Coordinate integrated campaigns across digital marketing, PR, thought leadership, events, sponsorships and account-based marketing programs.
Events

- Plan and coordinate end-to-end delivery of events, including logistics, venues, suppliers, and timelines
- Manage event budgets, track costs, and ensure delivery within agreed parameters
- Support the planning and execution of client events, roundtables, sponsorships and market engagement activities across the EMEA region.
External Visibility

- Drive initiatives to enhance market presence, including events, speaking opportunities, and profile-raising activities
- Support leadership visibility across key channels
- Prepare executive-level updates and communications for senior leadership regarding campaign progress, market activity and strategic priorities.
Marketing Strategy

- Contribute to the development and execution of the EMEA marketing strategy
- Align marketing activity with broader commercial growth priorities
Digital & Social

- Manage digital and social media channels to increase engagement and reach

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. descriptionText:
About Us

Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency. Our mission is simple: we're simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow.

We Deliver Services Across



- Global payments and receivables
- Foreign Exchange (FX)
- Treasury management
- Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America. Backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide. Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we're building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

Your role

Sokin is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead pipeline-generating marketing activity across the UK and EU.

Events are a large part of this role - you'll own execution against our UK & EU tier 1 events - alongside broader growth marketing: campaigns, paid media, and full-funnel initiatives that turn brand visibility into demand and revenue. You'll work closely with sales, product, and the wider marketing team to make sure everything ties back to pipeline.

Role Responsibilities



- Lead and execute Sokin's events marketing strategy across the UK & EU - conferences, trade shows, panels, roundtables, dinners, networking events, and partner activations - to build brand visibility and drive pipeline. This is a large proportion of the role, with strong execution against UK & EU tier 1 events a priority.
- Turn major events into multi-channel campaigns rather than one-off moments - building pre-event awareness and outreach, on-site lead capture and content, and post-event nurture sequences across email, paid, and sales follow-up - to maximise the return on each flagship event.
- Identify priority markets, segments, and channels to maximise brand impact and demand/lead generation across the UK & EU.
- Develop marketing activities and campaigns that clearly differentiate Sokin's products and services in a competitive landscape.
- Define campaign KPIs and success measurement frameworks with a critical focus on ROI and revenue generation.
- Collaborate with sales teams to track, maintain, and optimise marketing's contribution to the sales pipeline.
- Lead the production of campaign assets, ensuring brand consistency and high-quality output across formats (digital, print, social, events).
- With the internal performance team, launch paid advertising campaigns, manage budgets, and optimise performance, using the performance team as an expert resource.
- Act as a key liaison between product, customer success, sales, and marketing teams to ensure campaign relevance.
- Test new initiatives and bring new ideas to the table.
- Work closely with the wider marketing team, shaping and executing plans together. What success looks like in 12 months
- Strong, well-executed presence at UK & EU tier 1 and smaller events, each run as a multi-channel campaign rather than a standalone event.
- A clear view of marketing's contribution to pipeline, tracked and reported against agreed KPIs.
- Full-funnel campaigns live across the region, with measurable ROI and revenue impact.
- A tested pipeline of new marketing initiatives feeding into the following year's plan.

Qualifications



- 5-6+ years' experience in growth, demand generation, or events marketing, ideally in fintech or B2B SaaS.
- Proven track record of running large-scale events and turning them into multi-channel campaigns.
- Experience setting and reporting against marketing KPIs, with a strong focus on ROI and pipeline contribution.
- Experience running full-funnel, outbound campaigns, including paid media.
- Comfortable managing budgets across multiple channels and initiatives.
- Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once.
- Experience working closely with sales, product, and leadership teams.
- Willingness to travel for events as needed.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Brand Marketing Manager | Mission-Led D2C Scale-Up 🧡


How do you market a product nobody really wants to need?
Your customer probably isn't thinking about this category until something happens.
Maybe Mum has had a fall. Dad's getting older but fiercely values his independence. Perhaps they live miles away, and the constant "Are they okay?" is starting to sit permanently in the back of their mind.
What they're really looking for isn't a product.
It's reassurance. Independence. Peace of mind.


Propel is partnering with a fast-growing, private equity-backed UK business helping older and vulnerable people live safely and independently, while giving the people who love them one less thing to worry about.
And now, they want to build a brand that reflects just how important that is.


This is a brilliant opportunity for a Brand Manager who wants more than maintaining an established playbook. There's a live brand refresh to land, a new product line coming to market and significant investment going into national brand awareness.
You'll have the opportunity to genuinely shape what this brand becomes.


What you'll be doing:

- Taking a live brand refresh from strategy through to full roll-out
- Getting properly under the skin of the customer: what they're worried about, what reassures them and what ultimately makes them act
- Looking critically at the website journey, finding friction and testing ways to improve conversion
- Making sure every customer touchpoint feels consistent, recognisable and unmistakably on brand
- Taking the brand into new channels, including paid and organic social, with door drop and TV advertising on the roadmap
- Managing project and design budgets and becoming the go-to person for getting brilliant brand work out into the world
- Working with an established in-house team and strong agency roster, so your job is to set the direction and make things happen, not do everything yourself


We're looking for someone who:

- Has experience in a Brand Manager or similar role, ideally within D2C, subscription, consumer or another fast-moving environment
- Has delivered integrated brand campaigns across multiple channels
- Understands that great brand marketing starts with understanding the human being on the other side of it
- Can balance emotional storytelling with commercial thinking
- Has sharp instincts for messaging, tone of voice and what will genuinely resonate with an audience
- Is comfortable working across digital, CRM, sales and customer teams
- Spots opportunities and problems without needing somebody else to point them out
- Wants the scope to grow into a bigger brand leadership role as the business scales


Why this one is interesting:
Because there's something meaningful to build.
The foundations are there. The investment is there. The customer need is very real. But there's still huge untapped potential in how the brand shows up, how it talks about what it does and how many people know it exists.
You'll have visibility, influence and the freedom to challenge things. You'll work closely with senior leadership, have excellent agency support around you and join at the point where brand is becoming a serious growth priority for the business.
And importantly, you'll be marketing something that makes a tangible difference to people's lives.


Practical details:
📍 Norwich, hybrid
💵 Up to £50,000, dependent on experience
Plus private medical cover, matched pension and enhanced holiday.


If you've ever looked at a brand and thought, "there's so much more we could do with this", this might be the one. Especially if you like the idea of building a brand people remember before the moment they really need it!

Oxfordshire | Onsite | Up to £60,000 DOE | Early Friday Finish


We’re working with a specialist business operating within the scientific and engineering technology sector, looking for a Marketing Manager to join its team.


This is a hands on role within a highly technical environment, suited to someone who enjoys getting underneath complex products and understanding how they can be positioned effectively in the market.


The business works internationally across scientific, research and industrial markets, so we’re particularly interested in people who have experience marketing technical products and working closely with engineering, scientific or product teams.


What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll take ownership of marketing activity across both strategy and hands on delivery.
You’ll be:

- Developing and delivering short and longer term marketing plans.
- Planning and delivering product launches.
- Creating technical marketing content, including white papers, application notes, guides and product material.
- Working closely with engineers and technical specialists to understand products and applications.
- Turning complex technical information into clear commercial messaging.
- Managing website content, SEO and user experience.
- Delivering digital campaigns, newsletters and lead generation activity.
- Planning and delivering exhibitions and conferences.
- Supporting sales teams with product information and marketing collateral.
- Developing customer case studies and testimonials.
- Conducting competitor and market analysis.
- Reviewing marketing performance, KPIs and ROI.
- Managing marketing budgets.
- Managing and mentoring another member of the marketing team.


About You
You’ll ideally have experience within technical marketing, product marketing or a closely related role within an engineering, scientific or technical environment.


Product launch experience will be particularly important. We’re looking for someone who has been involved in taking technical products to market, rather than purely delivering general marketing campaigns.


You’ll also need to be comfortable working with technical people, asking the right questions and translating complex information into marketing that customers can understand.


Your background could include:

- Scientific or technical products.
- Engineering or manufacturing.
- Scientific instrumentation.
- Physics or other science led technology.
- Electronics.
- Measurement or analytical equipment.
- Laboratory equipment.
- Other complex physical technology products


You’ll ideally also have experience across areas such as website and CMS management, SEO, digital marketing, CRM, exhibitions, marketing budgets and technical content.


Experience managing or mentoring someone within marketing would also be useful.

Experience with some of the following would be useful:

- Product marketing and go to market strategy.
- International markets.
- Technical content creation.
- Sales enablement.
- Competitor and market analysis.
- Adobe Creative Cloud.
- Working directly with engineers, scientists or technical specialists.


The Environment
This is a specialist technical business where marketing works closely with both commercial and technical teams.


It should suit someone who wants to understand what they’re marketing, get close to the products and have genuine ownership over how those products are positioned and taken to market.
There’s a good balance between strategic responsibility and remaining hands on with delivery.

Salary: Up to £60,000 DOE + company bonus

The wider package includes private healthcare, pension, annual leave that increases with service and flexibility around working hours.


There’s also an early finish every Friday, giving you a slightly longer weekend each week.

title: Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA
descriptionText:
The Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA, serves as the voice of marketing in the EMEA region. You will partner closely with regional sales teams, execute localized activation plans and events, tailor content for regional relevance and feed key market and competitive insights back into the business. While our global marketing team builds campaigns, content, branding and paid programs, this role is all about accountability, orchestration, regional execution and local impact. You will own the regional marketing budget, track performance, optimize local programs and build strong alignment with the EMEA sales organization.

What you’ll do:



- Translate global marketing campaigns into regionally relevant programmes by localising content (including translation if needed), adapting messaging for market or regulatory differences and running regional activations. 
- Plan, execute and own all regional marketing activities including local face-to-face events, sponsorships of industry conferences, regional webinars, co-marketing partnerships and third-party events. 
- Own and manage the EMEA marketing budget by estimating costs, managing spend, tracking ROI and performance, reporting results and recommending ongoing optimizations. 
- Act as the key liaison between the global marketing team and the EMEA sales organisation to ensure sales understand target markets, personas and campaign materials; gather feedback from sales; and ensure marketing-to-sales hand-off is smooth and measurable. 
- Monitor the regional competitive landscape and market trends to identify emerging opportunities, local nuances, and regulatory changes, feeding actionable insights back into the global marketing team to shape future strategy and content. 
- Build and execute regional marketing plans aligned with global strategy by setting regional goals, defining timelines and metrics and adjusting based on local market conditions and performance. 
- Manage regional vendors, partners and agencies by coordinating logistics for events, negotiating sponsorship deals, overseeing execution and managing translation and localisation services. 
- Ensure brand consistency and governance across all regional initiatives by aligning every activity with global brand guidelines, messaging and marketing frameworks. 
- Track, measure and communicate performance of all regional marketing initiatives by reporting on pipeline contribution, event ROI, marketing-influenced leads and other key metrics to both regional sales leadership and the global marketing team. 
- Develop and strengthen regional relationships and partnerships by identifying opportunities for co-marketing with local ecosystems such as industry associations, influencers and channel or partner networks. 

What we’re looking for:



- Minimum of three (3) years of B2B SaaS marketing experience in a fast-growing scale-up environment (ideally with exposure to regional/field marketing or regional campaign activation). 
- Experience working in EMEA markets including event planning/execution, sponsorships, localization/translation of marketing content. 
- Experience in B2B SaaS event marketing, both owned events and third-party industry events (speaking panels, trade shows, webinars) in an EMEA context.
