title: Global Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Who We Are

Almac Group is a global leader in advancing human health. We provide a range of expert services across the drug development lifecycle to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, supporting them in finding treatments for patients.

Location: Craigavon

Hours: 37.5 hrs per week

Business Unit: Almac Sciences

Open To: Internal and External Applicants

Ref No.: HRJOB11882

The Opportunity

Almac Sciences provides a broad range of scientific services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology organisations across the drug development lifecycle. Our capabilities include small molecule active pharmaceutical ingredient development and manufacturing, peptide services, analytical services and a range of related scientific solutions.

We are delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an experienced Global Marketing Manager to join Almac Sciences at our Craigavon headquarters.

Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, you will lead the development and delivery of commercially focused global marketing plans that support business growth, customer engagement and sales effectiveness. Working closely with Business Development, senior Business Leaders, technical specialists, Group Marketing and external agencies, you will help strengthen market awareness of Almac Sciences and clearly communicate the value of our scientific expertise to customers around the world.

This is a highly collaborative and commercially focused role. You will translate complex scientific capabilities into clear and compelling customer propositions, create targeted campaigns, support lead generation and opportunity conversion, and provide Business Development teams with the insight and materials they need to engage customers effectively.

You will also have responsibility for managing and developing a Marketing Associate, providing structured coaching, guidance and opportunities to build their confidence, marketing expertise and commercial understanding.

Key responsibilities will include:



- Develop, own and deliver the Almac Sciences global marketing plan, ensuring activity is aligned with business priorities and growth opportunities
- Build a strong understanding of our services, customer segments, target markets, competitors and the factors influencing pharmaceutical and biotechnology outsourcing decisions
- Lead the Almac Sciences brand strategy and create consistent, customer-focused messaging across services, territories and marketing channels
- Translate complex scientific and technical information into clear value propositions, campaigns and practical sales enablement resources
- Work with technical specialists and commercial leaders to position and launch new or expanded services
- Produce and maintain high-quality marketing content, including articles, case studies, fact sheets, infographics, presentations, videos, webinars, blogs and campaign toolkits
- Coordinate digital marketing and inside sales activity to support lead generation, account targeting and customer prospecting
- Oversee website activity, paid search advertising, LinkedIn promotions and targeted customer outreach campaigns
- Support the planning and delivery of trade shows, conferences and other industry events
- Use Salesforce, HubSpot and other available data to measure campaign performance, lead quality, opportunity conversion, event return on investment and pipeline value influenced
- Research customer needs, buying behaviours, market developments and competitor positioning to identify potential growth opportunities
- Translate market intelligence into practical recommendations and actions for Business Development teams
- Manage marketing budgets, campaign schedules and third-party agencies
- Collaborate with Corporate Marketing to maintain a consistent approach across the Almac Group brand
- Manage, coach and support the Marketing Associate, helping them develop their marketing, commercial and industry knowledge

Joining Almac means becoming part of a fast-paced, growing organisation within a highly regulated industry. We offer a supportive and collaborative working environment, with excellent opportunities for learning, development and long-term career progression across the Almac Group.

Our approach is simple: we support, develop and reward our people, build fulfilling careers and together we advance human health. More information can be found here: Life at Almac

What You Need To Be Successful

We are looking for an experienced and commercially focused marketing professional who can build trusted relationships across technical, commercial and senior leadership teams. You will be confident managing multiple priorities, turning complex scientific information into engaging customer communications and using marketing insight to support measurable business growth.

Essential criteria include:



- Degree or equivalent qualification
- Significant previous experience in a Marketing or Business Development role
- Significant business-to-business marketing experience
- Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of customer needs, buying behaviours and how marketing activity can support sales growth
- Demonstrable experience of working with multiple senior Business Leaders across different disciplines, locations or time zones
- Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a variety of audiences
- Ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, customer-focused value propositions and sales enablement materials
- Experience of managing multiple campaigns, projects and cross-functional activities
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer, campaign and market data and recommend practical actions
- Experience of problem-solving, negotiation and managing competing stakeholder requirements
- Budget and risk management experience
- Experience using customer relationship management platforms, such as Salesforce or HubSpot, to analyse and report on marketing performance
- A collaborative leadership style with a strong commitment to teamwork, coaching and development

Desirable criteria include:



- A life science degree or equivalent qualification
- A master’s degree or equivalent qualification
- Previous experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, contract development and manufacturing, or contract research environment
- Previous marketing management experience with supervisory or team leadership responsibility
- Experience creating sales enablement materials, lead generation campaigns or account-based marketing activity that supported pipeline growth or opportunity conversion
- Experience within small molecule, peptide or analytical services
- A technical or scientific background within a life science, chemistry or analytical environment

If you are a strategic and hands-on marketing professional who is passionate about connecting scientific expertise with customer needs and commercial opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Applicants must have eligibility to work in the UK/IE with no restrictions OR possess a valid work permit that will allow you to take up full-time employment in the UK/IE.

Further information

For further information on the essential and desirable criteria required for this role, please review the Job Description attached to the online job posting.

This position reports to the Vice President of Business Development and has direct responsibility for the Almac Sciences Marketing Associate.

A fantastic salary and benefits package is available, including annual bonus, generous holiday allowance, healthcare reimbursement scheme and a rewarding role where your work contributes to the advancement of human health.

How To Apply

Apply online and tailor your CV to outline how you meet the role criteria. Please upload your CV in PDF format where possible.

Closing Date

We will no longer be accepting applications after 5pm on Sunday 11th October 2026.

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES PLEASE NOTE:

Almac will only accept applications from agencies/business partners that have been invited to work on this role by our Talent Acquisition team. Speculative candidate CVs received or submitted directly to Hiring Managers will be considered unsolicited and no fee will be payable. Thank you for your cooperation.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Job description:


At SEPHORA UK, beauty isn’t just what we sell - it’s who we are. It’s the freedom to express yourself, the thrill of discovering something new, and the power of belonging to a community that celebrates every identity. From our beginnings in France to becoming part of the LVMH family, we’ve always pushed boundaries through creativity, innovation, and inclusivity.
 
Today, as we continue our exciting expansion across the UK, we’re looking for passionate, driven individuals to help shape the future of prestige beauty in one of the world’s most dynamic retail markets. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love bringing ideas to life through impactful campaigns, this is your moment.
 
The Opportunity
 
As our Brand Marketing Manager, you’ll play a central role in accelerating the growth of SEPHORA UK’s surge and priority brands, including our exclusive Only at SEPHORA portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Brand Marketing Manager, you’ll translate shared ambitions into compelling omnichannel marketing plans that build brand visibility, engage our customers and deliver commercial growth.
 
You’ll become a trusted strategic partner to your brands, leading launches and ongoing marketing programmes from planning through to performance review. Working across Marketing, Commercial, Digital, Media and Global teams, as well as external brand and agency partners, you’ll bring teams together to deliver seamless campaigns and unlock new opportunities for success at SEPHORA UK.
 
What you’ll be doing…
 
 
- Build trusted partnerships with assigned surge and priority brands, aligning marketing activity with shared commercial objectives. 
- Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of 360-degree omnichannel launches, tailored to each brand’s identity and ambitions. 
- Act as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional taskforces and keeping activity on track. 
- Partner with wider Marketing teams to identify opportunities that strengthen launches and support sustained brand growth. 
- Manage campaign assets, timelines and approvals, ensuring every activation meets SEPHORA and partner brand guidelines. 
- Present launch strategies, marketing plans and progress updates to senior leadership and the wider business. 
- Track campaign performance, sales, traffic, sell-through and promotional return on investment to identify opportunities for optimisation. 
- Create clear post-campaign reports and strategic recommendations for brand partners, internal leadership and Global teams. 
- Collaborate with Digital and Media teams to optimise paid search, paid social, affiliate activity and brand visibility. 
- Support annual and global marketing priorities, including the planning and coordination of First at SEPHORA launches. 
- Own brand incubation, co-op and local marketing budgets, allocating investment to maximise impact and commercial return. 
- Manage external agency relationships across media, events and production, ensuring activity is delivered on time, on brand and within budget. 
 
What you’ll bring…
 
You’ll be a commercially minded and highly collaborative marketer who knows how to turn strong partnerships into impactful campaigns. Strategic and creative in your thinking, you’ll combine excellent relationship management with the organisation, attention to detail and influencing skills needed to bring multiple teams together and deliver ambitious plans.
 
 
- Strong experience in brand marketing, account management or retail marketing, ideally gained within beauty, luxury, FMCG or another consumer-focused environment. 
- Experience building and managing successful relationships with external brand partners and internal stakeholders. 
- A proven ability to lead integrated, omnichannel campaigns from initial concept through to launch and performance review. 
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate complex campaigns, competing priorities and multiple contributors. 
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence across functions, countries and levels of seniority. 
- Commercial and analytical capability, with experience using sales, campaign and digital marketing performance to inform decisions. 
- Experience managing marketing budgets and using insights to improve investment and return. 
- A strong understanding of digital and retail marketing channels, including paid search, paid social and affiliate marketing. 
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to create clear plans, presentations and performance reports. 
- A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related subject would be beneficial, alongside a genuine interest in the beauty industry and its evolving trends. 
 
Beautiful Benefits at SEPHORA UK
 
When you join SEPHORA, you’re joining a team that we truly value and our benefits reflect that. Here’s what you can look forward to:
 
 
- Private Healthcare, Life Assurance and Private Pension from day one. 
- Competitive pay that grows with you, including annual salary reviews. 
- A generous employee discount across the world’s best beauty brands. 
- A paid day off on your birthday. 
- Access to a wellbeing and perks platform. 
- LVMH Heart Fund support. 
- Generous holiday allowance, with the option to buy more. 
- And more… 
 
Together, we belong to something beautiful.
 
SEPHORA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace for all. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, or other employment practices. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.
 
We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role, so applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the start of employment and will be asked to provide relevant evidence.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
The Marketing Manager has overall responsibility for the UK marketing function, leading the
planning and coordination of activity across brand, product, trade, digital, ecommerce and paid
media channels. Acting as the central point of leadership for the marketing team, they set direction, align priorities and ensure marketing activity is connected, on brand, delivered on time and supports both commercial objectives and broader brand ambitions.


This person directly manages and develops the Digital Marketing Assistant, Trade Marketing &
Product Executive and Paid Media Marketing Executive, acting as the conductor of the function to
bring together people, plans and priorities. They provide clear leadership, create effective ways of
working and ensure the team is equipped and accountable for high-quality delivery.


The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking, commercial awareness, organisation,
communication and leadership, with responsibility for shaping the annual marketing strategy and
calendar, overseeing integrated campaigns and product launches, managing budgets and agencies, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and using performance insight to improve effectiveness.


Key Responsibilities
Marketing Leadership & Team Management



- Lead the UK marketing function, setting clear direction, priorities and standards across the team.
- Directly manage, coach and develop the Digital Marketing Assistant, Trade Marketing & Product Executive and Paid Media Marketing Executive, ensuring each role is clear, supported and contributing effectively to the wider function.
- Establish effective ways of working that improve forward planning, coordination, visibility and accountability across the marketing team.
- Act as the main internal point of contact for marketing, giving the senior leadership team clear visibility of plans, priorities, progress, risks and results.
- Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency, strengthen collaboration and increase the overall impact of the marketing function.


Strategic Planning, Brand & Product Marketing



- Own the UK marketing strategy and annual marketing calendar, translating business
- objectives, product priorities and global brand direction into clear, commercially relevant plans.
- Lead the planning of seasonal campaigns, launch support and key brand moments, ensuring activity is prioritised where it will have the greatest impact
- Oversee brand positioning, narratives, messaging, packaging input and brand guidelines to maintain a strong, recognisable and consistent identity.
- Identify gaps, clashes, dependencies or risks early and take action to keep plans realistic, well supported and on track.
- Oversee the planning and delivery of trade shows, showroom activity and key trade events, ensuring they are fully integrated into the wider marketing plan.


Campaign, Media & Content Oversight



- Oversee the development and delivery of campaigns across paid media, organic social, PR,
- influencer, retail, ecommerce, trade and print channels.
- Ensure campaign activity is insight-led, connected across channels and designed to support brand awareness, product sell-through, digital growth and wider commercial objectives.
- Set clear briefs and provide strategic direction for creative production, including TVCs, digital assets, influencer content, point-of-sale materials and other brand collateral.
- Review campaign plans and materials at key stages, providing constructive feedback and ensuring work is strategically strong, on brand and ready for execution.
- Oversee paid and organic social activity and ensure media plans are cost-effective, appropriately targeted and aligned with agreed KPIs.


Trade, Digital & Ecommerce Oversight



- Oversee marketing support across retail, ecommerce and trade channels, ensuring activity is
- customer-relevant, commercially supportive and delivered to a high standard.
- Work closely with Sales on launches, retailer activity, sell-in presentations, promotional plans and key trading periods to maximise visibility and product sell-through.
- Ensure websites, social media, online content and ecommerce support are delivered in line with the wider marketing plan.
- Oversee the readiness of product assets, enhanced content, launch materials, trade tools and customer-facing marketing materials for retail and ecommerce partners.


Budget, Performance & Market Insight



- Own and monitor the overall marketing budget, forecasting spends and ensuring investment is carefully managed against agreed priorities.
- Oversee campaign and channel reporting, giving the business clear visibility of results, learnings and recommendations.
- Use relevant measures to assess effectiveness and guide optimisation.
- Put clear reporting processes in place across campaigns, product launches, budgets and monthly performance updates.
- Monitor consumer behaviour, competitor activity, market trends and emerging opportunities, using insight to shape future plans and support decision-making.


Cross-Functional Coordination



- Work closely with Product, Sales, Finance, Operations and global marketing teams to ensure marketing supports wider business goals.
- Maintain clear and consistent communication with CTF and CTA so UK priorities, product updates, samples, launches and trade activity are aligned and understood.
- Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure the marketing team has the information, decisions, inputs and support needed to deliver effectively.
- Present marketing plans, priorities, performance and recommendations confidently to senior stakeholders.


Experience and Skills Required:



- At least 10 years' marketing experience, including 5 to 6 years proven experience in a marketing management role with direct responsibility for managing and developing a team.
- A strong track record of setting marketing direction and leading multi-channel activity across
- brand, product, trade, digital, ecommerce and paid media.
- Experience managing the full campaign lifecycle, from strategy and briefing through delivery, optimisation, analysis and reporting.
- Strong consumer goods and commercial marketing experience.
- Experience within toys or another fast-paced, seasonal category is preferred but not essential.
- Proven experience of managing substantial budgets, external agencies, suppliers and complex campaign planning processes.
- Strong understanding of marketing performance measures and the ability to turn data, market insight and team feedback into clear actions and recommendations.
- Excellent leadership, project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and changing demands.
- A confident communicator and presenter who can bring people together, build trust, influence stakeholders and keep plans moving.
- Able to combine strategic thinking with practical decision-making, creative judgement and strong attention to detail.
- Comfortable overseeing a broad marketing remit without needing to be the day-to-day executor of every channel.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
You're our Marketing Manager. You'll work alongside the Director of Marketing across everything we do to market the Velstar brand, from hero campaigns, events, and awards to our website, social, search, and email. It's a broad role with real variety and a chance to shape how we show up in the market.

As a two-person team you share responsibilities rather than silo them. You bring particular expertise in HubSpot and lead nurturing, helping turn great marketing into pipeline, and you play a big part in planning and delivering our events.

You own your projects from brief to results with support from across the agency. We're looking for someone who thinks commercially, takes ownership, and is ready to put in the work.

What Your Role Looks Like

CRM and pipeline



- Own HubSpot, including data quality, lifecycle stages, lists, lead scoring, and campaign tracking.
- Build and improve nurture journeys, email flows, and newsletters that turn contacts into sales conversations.
- Agree the handover of marketing qualified leads with Sales, ensuring warm leads are followed up quickly.
- Report on pipeline and revenue generated or influenced by marketing, and use it to decide where time and budget go.

Campaigns and events



- Deliver our flagship hero campaigns end to end, including eBooks, virtual events, and the in-person event that closes each campaign.
- Plan client, prospect, and partner events and trade shows with the Director of Marketing, owning the journey from invite to follow-up.
- Build joint marketing activity with technology partners.

PR, awards and content



- Support our PR and media relationships, and run our awards programme with our freelance award entry specialist.
- Write and commission articles, blogs, and case studies, and manage organic social, primarily on LinkedIn.
- Co-lead The Commerce Confidential, our invite-only network for senior ecommerce leaders, and support the Velstar podcast.

Digital, brand and creative



- Support PPC and SEO for the Velstar brand, and build pages on our website and in HubSpot.
- Brief the design team, produce quick-turnaround assets in Canva, and look after reviews, Google Business Profiles, the Master Deck, and our shared GDrive.

Stakeholder management



- Work collaboratively with Sales, Account Management, Creative and Design, web development, partners, press, and freelancers.

What We Need From You

Essential Skills, Knowledge & Experience



- Solid experience across B2B marketing, ideally in an agency or services business.
- Hands-on experience owning a CRM, ideally HubSpot, including workflows, lead scoring, and pipeline reporting.
- A track record of building lead nurture programmes that turn contacts into pipeline.
- Experience planning and delivering events as part of integrated campaigns.
- Strong writing skills and an eye for brand consistency.
- Comfortable working across multiple channels simultaneously and prioritising by commercial impact.
- Confident briefing designers and freelancers, and managing stakeholders and suppliers.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience



- HubSpot certifications, or experience setting up or rebuilding a HubSpot instance.
- Experience in PR, media relations, or awards entries.
- Experience with PPC, SEO, Google Analytics, a CMS, or Canva.

title: UK Marketing Manager - Speedo
descriptionText:
We’re Pentland Brands: a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.


As UK Marketing Manager for Speedo, you will lead the marketing function in one of our key EMEA markets. You’ll lead integrated marketing, experiential community activations, and wholesale partnerships, championing cross-functional collaboration to deliver best‑in‑class consumer experiences. You will support the brand’s presence and performance in the UK, by translating global strategy into locally resonant campaigns that drive consideration, engagement, and commercial success.


This role is pivotal in shaping Speedo’s market leadership and requires a strategic thinker, a strong collaborator, and a bold brand champion.


This role has a start date of the 1st February 2027. 


What you’ll be doing:


Strategy & Integrated Marketing

- Support the Head of EMEA Marketing in developing and delivering “Glocal” strategies that align global direction with UK market needs, driving cultural relevance for Speedo and the broader swim category.
- Lead the UK integrated marketing plan, adapting global strategies into impactful UK activations across retail, digital, PR, experiential and community channels. Define KPIs, measure performance, and provide strategic insights and optimisations to senior leadership.
- Partner cross‑functionally with Sales, Product, Creative, Sports Marketing, Merchandising, E‑commerce and Global Brand teams to deliver cohesive, effective 360° campaigns.


Community, PR & Experiential

- Lead UK experiential and community activations from concept through to execution in partnership with Social and Community teams and external PR agencies, delivering disruptive and culturally relevant brand moments. Analyse activations using KPIs such as EMV, share of search and engagement.
- Maintain a deep understanding of the UK media and creative landscape to inform partnerships, cultural opportunities and best‑in‑class experiences.
- Manage PR agency relationships, shaping earned media strategy, reviewing talent/creator proposals, and ensuring UK relevance and KPI delivery.
- Partner with Sports Marketing and Social and Community teams to create experiential, engaging activations that drive cultural relevance for our swim consumers, inclusive of our partnership with AGB Federation and team Speedo athletes.


Retail Marketing

- Evolve how we work with wholesale retail partners to deliver both brand and commercial success through activations that are truly consumer-minded and grounded in category leadership.
- Lead UK retail marketing execution, including go‑to‑market planning, visual merchandising, in‑store storytelling, seasonal campaigns and digital retail content.
- Build strong relationships with key retail partners to enhance brand visibility, improve shopper experience and drive sell‑through.
- Support of seasonal go to market trade launches with our Partner Marketing team, including management of our two UK showrooms.


Insights & Consumer Understanding

- Partner with Insights and cross‑functional teams to lead analysis of consumer behaviour, shopper data, category trends and competitor activity.
- Act as the UK consumer advocate, embedding insights into brand planning, retail execution and campaign strategy to elevate the full shopper experience.


Reporting, Budget & Content Management

- Monitor campaign and retail performance across KPIs such as sales uplift, footfall, digital engagement and ROI. Deliver structured reporting and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Provide direction on content needs across PR, social and retail, ensuring seamless brand storytelling and alignment between creative and community teams.
- Own and manage the UK retail marketing budget, ensuring efficient investment, strong ROI and alignment with commercial plans and product launches.


What you’ll bring:

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
- Experience in marketing, ideally within sports, apparel, or consumer goods.
- Proven track record of contributing to marketing teams and delivering impactful campaigns. Ideally experience working with, or for key retail partners.
- Visual merchandising experience is a bonus.
- Strong strategic thinking and ability to translate global brand vision into local execution.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Data-driven mindset with experience in campaign analysis and performance optimisation.
- A genuine passion for marketing and the Speedo brand, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make an impact in a dynamic, international environment


Why Speedo?
Speedo is one of the world’s most iconic swimwear brands, built on a heritage of innovation, performance and a lifelong love of swimming.


From elite competition to everyday fitness, leisure and learning, Speedo creates product for every type of swimmer. It is a brand trusted in the water because it understands what matters: fit, movement, comfort, durability, confidence and performance.


Joining Speedo means becoming part of a team that cares deeply about helping people feel at home in the water, whether they are chasing a personal best, building confidence, training regularly or discovering the joy of swimming for the first time.


Perks & Benefits
We offer a competitive salary, discretionary bonus, hybrid working, flexible start and finish times, generous holiday allowance, product discounts, sample sales, enhanced family-friendly policies, healthcare support, gym and fitness discounts, cycle to work scheme and electric car scheme.


You can find full details of our benefits and perks on our UK Benefits page.


The Interview Process
We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:



- Talent Team Intro Call - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
- Experience Interview - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
- Final Interview - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Marketing Manager to join our award-winning team on a permanent basis. You'll own Arke's own marketing, with three priorities: generating new business leads, building our brand and positioning, and raising our profile through PR, provider partnerships, thought leadership and awards.
You'll work closely with our Paid Media and SEO leads to make sure Arke's own marketing follows the best practice we deliver for clients, and keeps improving quarter on quarter. You'll run lead management in HubSpot and outbound LinkedIn and email campaigns in Lemlist, and you'll be accountable for the pipeline that marketing creates.


Responsibilities:


Lead Generation:


- Build upon and run Arke's existing lead generation strategy, with clear targets for marketing qualified leads, sales qualified leads and pipeline value agreed with the senior management team.
- Own HubSpot as our system for lead management: lead capture, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, nurture workflows, and a clean hand-off to the new business team.
- Plan and run LinkedIn and email outreach in Lemlist, including audience and target account lists, sequence copy, personalisation, A/B testing and deliverability.
- Create and promote lead magnets and conversion content, such as guides, audits, case studies and landing pages, that turn website and social traffic into enquiries.
- Plan, promote and run Arke-hosted webinars and events that generate new business leads and keep existing clients engaged.
- Maintain Arke's profiles on agency listing and review platforms with current case studies, awards and client testimonials to improve rankings and enquiries.


Brand & Positioning:


- Own Arke's brand and positioning, making sure our messaging, proposition and visual identity are consistent across the website, social channels, sales materials, pitches and events.
- Refine and document our value proposition, service messaging and target audiences, working with leadership so the positioning reflects where the business is heading.
- Run Arke's own social channels, particularly LinkedIn, and support senior leaders to build their personal profiles and share thought leadership.
- Manage the creation of SEO- and UX-focused content for the Arke website that builds visibility and attracts qualified leads.
- Represent Arke at industry events as a brand ambassador.


PR, awards and industry profile:



- Plan and deliver a PR programme that secures coverage in trade and business press through press releases, opinion pieces, commentary and project stories, positioning Arke as an authority in digital marketing.
- Build and maintain relationships with journalists, editors and podcast hosts in our sector.
- Plan and run the awards strategy: identifying the right awards across our services, writing submissions and making the most of wins and shortlists.
- Develop partnerships with industry bodies (for example DAN and IPA), securing opportunities for awards, accreditations, speaking slots, events and joint initiatives.


Working with Paid Media and SEO


- Work with the Paid Media lead to plan, brief and review Arke's own paid campaigns, making sure targeting, creative, tracking and budgets follow best practice.
- Work with the SEO lead on Arke's organic strategy, including technical priorities, content plans and search visibility.
- Run a regular review with both leads to share results, agree next tests and make sure each channel is improving on the last period in line with agreed KPIs.
- Keep up with changes in platforms, search and outreach tools, and bring new ideas and approaches to the team.


Reporting & Performance


- Set up and maintain reporting in HubSpot that tracks leads, conversion rates, pipeline and revenue by source and campaign.
- Report monthly to the senior management team on marketing performance and return on investment, with clear recommendations.
- Manage the marketing budget and any external suppliers or freelancers.


What Success Looks like


- A steady, measurable flow of qualified leads and pipeline that the new business team can rely on.
- HubSpot as a trusted single source of truth for leads, with clear attribution by channel.
- Outreach sequences in Lemlist with strong reply and meeting rates.
- Regular press coverage, award wins and speaking opportunities that raise Arke's profile.
- A clear, consistent brand and proposition that the whole team can explain.


Skills and Experience


- At least 4 years in B2B marketing, ideally within an agency or professional services business.
- A track record of generating leads and pipeline, with results you can point to.
- Hands-on experience with HubSpot (lead management, workflows, reporting) and an outreach platform such as Lemlist.
- Experience of PR and awards, including writing press releases and award submissions.
- Excellent technical and story-telling writing skills, which brings personality to the brand and a strong eye for brand consistency.
- A solid understanding of paid media and SEO, enough to challenge and collaborate with specialists.
- Comfortable with data, and able to turn numbers into clear decisions.


Who you are:



- You’re real: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse ways of working. We are accepting: of new ideas, new partnerships, and new ways of doing things.
- You're curious: We believe in the power of curiosity, always hungry to know more, to challenge known truths and to uncover new trends, innovations and approaches. We never want to do the “same old”, we push boundaries and bring excitement to all we do. 
- You're bold: We encourage creative thinking and conviction in your delivery. We embrace differences and use this as our USP to show our innovative approach to often similar challenges.


What we’ll give you:



- Annual Leave: 25 days of paid holiday, in addition to public holidays.
- Special Days Off: An extra day off to celebrate your birthday.
- Remote Work: The flexibility to work from home on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
- Loyalty Holidays: An additional day of holiday for each year of service, as a token of our appreciation for your dedication.
- Volunteering Leave: Two extra days of paid leave annually to support volunteering activities of your choice.
- Pension Scheme: A comprehensive pension plan to support your future.
- Profit Sharing: Eligibility for participation in the company's profit-sharing scheme, allowing you to share in our success.
- Benefits Options: A choice between the Pirkx benefits scheme, Vitality health insurance, a gym membership, or a health and wellness package with About Balance, tailored to support your well-being.
- Flexible Working: Flexi-time and Time Off in Lieu (TOIL) to help you balance work and personal commitments.
- Employee Events: Seasonal events arranged by our Culture Committee
- Friday Perks: Early finishes on Fridays, accompanied by social drinks to kick off the weekend right.


This package is designed to not only reward your hard work and commitment but also to support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.

Regional Marketing Manager, APAC & Middle East

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Head of Regional Marketing

Travel: Up to 30%

Overview

Camlin Energy is seeking a strategic and commercially driven Regional Marketing Manager to lead marketing activity across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.

This role will be responsible for developing regional growth programmes that increase market presence, generate pipeline, support strategic accounts and strengthen customer engagement across a diverse range of geographies and cultures.

Regional Growth Marketing

- Deliver local marketing programmes while maintaining alignment with global brand and marketing strategy

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager
Location: London | Hybrid working


Our client is an established premium brand with an international presence and a strong focus on protecting and developing its market identity. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a substantial marketing remit, working closely with senior leadership while influencing how the brand is presented across global markets. You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, managing agencies, budgets, campaigns and brand communications across digital, print, PR, events and retail channels. With responsibility for a small marketing team and significant exposure across the wider organisation, you’ll have the opportunity to shape activity that supports both commercial performance and long-term brand desirability.


The Marketing Manager will play a central role in translating the global marketing strategy into effective campaigns and communications across multiple markets.

- Lead the delivery of integrated global marketing activity across digital, advertising, PR, events and retail.
- Own and optimise the marketing budget, ensuring investment delivers measurable commercial value.

Apply today to take ownership of a high-impact global marketing remit with an established premium brand committed to equality of opportunity for all employees and job applicants.

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

As the Marketing Manager for PSA UK, you will lead all key marketing initiatives for our UK Receiving Center and broader PSA presence in the United Kingdom. Your mission is to drive adoption of PSA services, accelerate market growth, and build strong brand awareness across the UK and wider International collector community.

You will be a jack-of-all-trades marketer, managing the overall marketing strategy and execution across all major touchpoints — including social, digital, paid, email, events & shows, partnerships, and community engagement. Your primary focus will be driving meaningful growth and accelerating the territory.

You will report to the Head of Marketing, Europe, and work from our London Receiving Center.

This role requires you to be onsite in the office 4 days per week.

- Develop and execute marketing strategies and plans for the UK Receiving Center and the overall PSA presence in the UK
- Manage all marketing channels for PSA in the UK with a strong focus on social and digital
- Measure, evaluate, and report on the performance of marketing initiatives
- Maintain and execute a marketing calendar, including but not limited to:

- Social media, including content creation, community management and analytics
- Website and App updates
- Events and card shows
- Partnerships
- Promotions and organic/paid campaigns
- Use the full marketing toolkit to drive meaningful growth in the UK market
- Work closely with the US and European marketing teams to localize global marketing initiatives for the UK audience
- Build and maintain strong relationships with local community partners, hobby shops, event organizers, and like-minded brands
- Support the setup and optimization of MarTech tools such as CRM systems and CMS platforms

- Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience in marketing, brand, or growth roles
- Experienced in managing social media channels such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and live-streaming platforms
- Hands-on approach creating and designing content for social media, including scheduling, copy, graphics and community management
- Strong project management skills with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset
- Comfortable owning both strategy and end-to-end execution of marketing programs
- High analytical skills, with the ability to track performance and extract insights
- Experienced in managing social media channels such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and live-streaming platforms
- Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
- Strong presentation and stakeholder communication skills
- Knowledge of the trading card or collectibles space is a strong plus
- Must be authorized to work in the United Kingdom
- Fluent in English; fluency in additional languages is a plus

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Are you a creative, commercially minded marketer who loves using insight to understand audiences, grow engagement and deliver measurable results?


Would you love to use those skills for a brilliant local cause, where your work can make a genuine difference to patients, families and NHS staff across Nottingham?


Charity People is delighted to be partnering with Nottingham Hospitals Charity to find their new Marketing Manager.


Salary: c. £35,000 depending on experience
Location: Nottingham, with hybrid and flexible working
Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week. 0.8 FTE may be considered
Benefits include 27 days’ annual leave plus UK bank holidays, a contributory pension scheme, and the option to join the Westfield Health Cash Plan after the qualifying period. You’ll also benefit from excellent learning and development opportunities through the charity’s CPD programme, supporting your ongoing professional development and wellbeing.


Nottingham Hospitals Charity has raised £65 million over the past 20 years to support Nottingham’s NHS hospitals, funding improvements to patient care, facilities, medical equipment and staff wellbeing.


Around one million people pass through Nottingham’s hospitals every year and the money raised stays local. Now, the Charity has real ambition to build on that impact, reach more people and grow its supporter base.


The opportunity
This is a brilliant opportunity for a marketer who wants the freedom to shape, build and deliver.
The Charity already has real strength in storytelling, PR and local communications. Now, they’re looking for someone who can bring a different dimension to the team, using audience insight and data to develop marketing activity that grows supporter numbers, engagement and fundraising income.


Working closely with the Head of Supporter Growth and Marketing and fundraising colleagues, you’ll:



- Shape and deliver the Charity’s marketing plan
- Develop supporter acquisition activity and improve audience segmentation
- Make better use of CRM data and insight to inform campaigns
- Lead email marketing and support brand and awareness campaigns
- Work with agency partners and colleagues to create more joined up supporter journeys
- Measure what’s working and use those insights to improve future activity
This is a role where creativity really matters, but so do the results.


Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for a confident, creative and curious all-round marketer who enjoys both thinking and doing. You might already work in the charity sector, but you absolutely don’t have to. We’d love to hear from people with strong marketing experience from commercial, consumer, membership, retail, healthcare or other sectors who are excited about bringing their skills into a purpose driven organisation.


You’ll ideally bring:

- Track record of marketing experience
- Experience delivering successful campaigns across multiple channels
- A strong understanding of audiences, segmentation and acquisition
- Confidence using data and insight to shape marketing activity
- Evidence of delivering measurable growth, engagement, sales or income
- Experience using CRM systems to improve marketing effectiveness
- Strong project management skills
- Confidence working with colleagues, senior stakeholders and external agencies
- Excellent communication and copywriting skills
- Creativity, curiosity and the confidence to try new things


Why this role?
You’ll be joining at a point where there is real appetite for change and an opportunity to make your mark.


You’ll have the freedom to bring fresh thinking to supporter acquisition, develop better audience insight and help shape a marketing function that makes a measurable difference to fundraising.
And you’ll be doing it for an organisation where the impact is tangible, local and meaningful.
Interested?


If this sounds like it could be your kind of role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your CV to Ellen Drummond at Charity People in the first instance.


Closing date: 9am on Wednesday 21st October
First stage interviews: w/c 2nd November, online
Second stage interviews: w/c 9th November, in person

title: Growth Marketing Manager - UK & Benelux
descriptionText:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Our Team And What We’ll Accomplish Together

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to drive demand generation and pipeline growth in the UK and Benelux markets, and collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams.

This role is focused on executing region-specific strategies to generate marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and nurture them through the funnel to sales-qualified leads (SQLs) and beyond. You will play a key role in shaping and executing campaigns that accelerate pipeline velocity, leveraging events, broker and partner engagement, and targeted digital marketing tactics.

You'll also collaborate with our global marketing team on top-of-funnel awareness campaigns (social media, paid media, content marketing), working with our regionally based ABM specialist and Revenue Growth Manager to ensure seamless lead handoff from acquisition to conversion.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Growth & Lead Nurturing




- Develop and execute UK and Benelux-specific growth marketing strategies to drive MQLs and pipeline growth.
- Own middle and lower-funnel marketing, implementing nurture programs that progress leads from MQL to SQL through multi-touch campaigns.
- Design and optimize lead nurturing flows, leveraging email marketing, content, and personalized outreach to improve conversion rates.
- Develop and implement a segmented marketing approach, identifying high-value prospect groups and tailoring engagement to their specific needs throughout the funnel.
- Collaborate with sales teams to refine lead scoring models and improve MQL-to-SQL conversion.


Regional Events & Partner Engagement




- Plan, execute, and optimize regional events, including industry conferences, partner engagements and hosted activation, to drive brand awareness and lead generation.
- Build and manage relationships with partners and key stakeholders, developing co-marketing initiatives that amplify reach and impact. 
- Develop an integrated event marketing approach that ensures participation translates into measurable business impact and pipeline contribution


Campaign Execution & Collaboration

descriptionText:
At Phillip Jeffries, we believe the most beautiful spaces begin with meaningful connections. Since our start in a family garage in 1976, we have grown into a global luxury wallcovering brand trusted by the world’s top designers and architects. Today, our curated collections and dedication to exceptional service set the standard in the industry. That kind of reputation is built by passionate people who know how to sell not just a product, but a story.

Phillip Jeffries is seeking a creative and strategic Marketing Manager to support the continued growth of our international business across the UK, France, Italy, Spain, and broader European markets. Based in our London office, this role follows a hybrid schedule of 3–4 days per week on-site and reports directly to the Managing Director, PJ International.

Working closely with our Global Marketing team and international leaders, the Marketing Manager will drive regional marketing initiatives, public relations, content creation, events, and brand activations that strengthen awareness and engagement across key international markets. The ideal candidate is a skilled storyteller, relationship builder, and project manager with a passion for luxury brands, design, and creating exceptional brand experiences.

What You’ll Do

Brand Storytelling & Communications



- Adapt global campaigns and content to engage audiences across the UK and Europe.
- Ensure all communications reflect the Phillip Jeffries brand while resonating locally.
- Identify opportunities to connect our brand to design trends, industry conversations, and cultural moments.
- Partner with Global Marketing to bring the Phillip Jeffries story to life throughout the international design community.

Public Relations & Media Relations

title: Marketing Manager (Commercial)
descriptionText:
Marketing Manager, Commercial Property

Manchester, five days in the office with sensible flexibility, regular UK travel

Salary, £37,000 to £45,000 DOE

MCR Property Group is growing its commercial property portfolio and investing in the buildings, workspaces and teams behind it. Recent activity includes the acquisition of 4M at Manchester Airport and Headrow House in Leeds, with further growth planned across offices, flexible workspace, industrial and mixed use assets.

We are now launching a new dedicated national commercial property brand, supported by a fresh dedicated marketing team focused entirely on the sector.

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to join that team and support the Head of Marketing, Commercial Property in building the brand, launching assets, generating demand and supporting leasing across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role with the opportunity to join at the beginning, help shape how the new brand goes to market and play a direct part in building the marketing operation behind it.

The objective is simple: attract the right occupiers, generate more qualified enquiries and viewings, support agents and leasing teams, and help reduce the time that space sits empty.

The role

You will help manage the day to day marketing of our commercial portfolio, understanding what is available, who it is suitable for, what competing buildings are offering and how each asset should be positioned.

You will turn that understanding into campaigns across property portals, paid media, search, social, email, direct marketing, PR and agent communications.

You will support the launch of our new national commercial brand across websites, campaigns, signage, property marketing, occupier communications and new acquisitions.

You will also help establish the new dedicated commercial marketing team, working alongside the Head of Marketing as the function develops and grows.

You will have access to MCR Property Group's established in house studio, CRM team, digital specialists and wider marketing management resource, giving the new commercial team the capability to move quickly and deliver high quality work internally.

What you will be responsible for



-  Managing day to day marketing plans across a portfolio of commercial properties
-  Supporting the launch and growth of the new national commercial property brand
-  Helping build the marketing processes, standards and ways of working for the new dedicated commercial team
-  Delivering campaigns designed to generate qualified enquiries and property viewings
-  Managing property listings, websites and landing pages, ensuring content, availability, imagery and enquiry routes are accurate and effective
-  Supporting acquisition launches, refurbishment campaigns and asset repositioning
-  Briefing photography, video, CGI, Matterport and other property content
-  Working with the in house studio on brochures, presentations, signage, hoardings, digital creative and agent materials
-  Working with the CRM team to improve lead capture, tracking, follow up and reporting
-  Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry levels, viewing activity and lead quality
-  Supporting paid search, paid social, email marketing and digital acquisition activity
-  Coordinating agent campaigns, events, property updates and occupier communications
-  Supporting PR around acquisitions, lettings, refurbishments and portfolio growth
-  Managing external suppliers where required
-  Supporting marketing budgets and ensuring spend is directed towards activity that produces results

Commercial focus

This is a marketing role that sits close to leasing.

We want someone who is interested in what happens after a campaign goes live.

Did it generate enquiries, were they the right enquiries, did they become viewings, did the viewings progress, what did the agents say, what should we change?

You will regularly review enquiry levels, viewing activity, conversion, occupancy, campaign performance, agent feedback and marketing spend.

You do not need to be a surveyor, but you should want to understand the commercial side of property and the impact marketing has on leasing.

Every empty unit has a cost, your role is to help create demand around it.

About You

You will have strong marketing experience and be ready to take greater ownership of campaigns, assets and performance.

Your background may be in commercial property, real estate, workspace, placemaking, hospitality or another sector where marketing is used to generate demand for physical space.

You will be organised, commercially minded and confident managing multiple projects at once.

You will understand digital marketing, campaign management, content, CRM and lead generation.

You will have strong written communication skills and be comfortable briefing creative teams, photographers, agencies and suppliers.

You will be confident working with senior stakeholders and external agents, and comfortable looking at performance data and making decisions from it.

Most importantly, you will care about the outcome of the work, not simply whether the campaign was delivered.

What success looks like

Success will mean a strong launch for the new national commercial brand, more qualified enquiries, more property viewings, stronger digital conversion, better asset launches, improved agent engagement, clearer CRM data, better marketing materials and more efficient spend.

It will also mean helping establish a dedicated commercial marketing team that can scale with the portfolio and support the next stage of growth.

Working pattern

The role is based in Manchester and is primarily office based, five days a week, with sensible flexibility where required.

Regular travel across the UK portfolio is part of the role. You will visit properties, meet agents, work with site teams and understand local markets first hand.

Commercial property is a physical product, and the best marketing comes from understanding the buildings properly.

Why join



-  This is an opportunity to join at the start of something new. 
-  A new dedicated national commercial property brand. 
-  A fresh specialist marketing team. 
-  A growing portfolio. 
-  A dedicated paid media budget 
-  And the backing of an established in house creative, digital and CRM capability. 
-  You will work directly with the Head of Marketing, Commercial Property and senior commercial teams, with genuine ownership of campaigns, assets and performance. 
-  As the portfolio and team grow, there will be clear opportunities to take on more responsibility and help shape how the function develops.

title: Channel Marketing Manager - Commercial
descriptionText:
Department: Marketing

Location: London

Description

Job Title: Channel Marketing Manager - Commercial

Salary: £50,000- £55,000 DOE

Location: Hybrid (1-2 days per week in London office)

At Pod, we're helping businesses make the transition to electric vehicles through smart, scalable charging solutions. As our Channel Marketing Manager, Commercial, you'll play a key role in driving growth across our Workplace, Depot and Home Fleet propositions.

You'll own the marketing strategy and execution for these commercial channels, creating compelling go-to-market plans that support both new business acquisition and customer growth. Working closely with Sales, Product and the wider Marketing team, you'll deliver campaigns that strengthen customer relationships, increase engagement, generate demand, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.

You'll also lead the development of customer-focused content, from case studies to thought leadership, helping position Pod as a trusted partner in the EV transition. Reporting to the Head of Partnerships & Commercial Marketing, you'll have significant ownership and the opportunity to shape how we take our commercial propositions to market.

Here's what our Head of Partnerships & Commercial Marketing had to say:

"This role sits at the heart of one of Pod's biggest growth opportunities. You'll have the chance to shape how we take our Workplace, Depot and Home Fleet propositions to market, with real ownership over strategy, campaigns, content and commercial performance. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining creativity with data, building strong relationships across teams, and turning customer insight into marketing that drives results. If you're excited by the challenge of scaling a fast-growing business while helping accelerate the transition to cleaner transport, you'll find plenty of opportunity to make an impact here."

‎What You'll Do:

Develop Go-to-Market Plans

You'll lead go-to-market planning for our Workplace, Depot and Home Fleet propositions, working closely with the B2B Acquisition Manager to create marketing programmes that support commercial objectives, accelerate growth and maximise market opportunities.

Drive Retention and Account Growth

You'll develop and deliver campaigns that strengthen relationships with existing customers, increase engagement, and identify opportunities to expand adoption of Pod's commercial propositions. You'll create programmes that support both customer retention and revenue growth.

Lead Content Strategy and Development

You'll shape the content strategy for our commercial propositions, creating briefs and working with internal and external stakeholders to develop impactful case studies, customer stories, thought leadership and sales content that supports lead generation and brand credibility.

Enable Sales Success

You'll work closely with Sales to understand customer needs and market opportunities, creating the tools, content and resources that help teams effectively position and sell Pod's solutions.

Deliver Events and Industry Engagement

You'll plan and execute events, webinars, exhibitions and industry engagement activities that raise awareness of Pod's commercial propositions, generate demand and support business development goals.

Support Account-Based Marketing Programmes

Working in partnership with the B2B Acquisition Manager, you'll deliver targeted account-based marketing initiatives for key commercial accounts, building stronger relationships and generating opportunities within strategically important customers.

Measure Performance and Optimise Results

You'll establish clear marketing KPIs and reporting frameworks, analysing campaign, content and event performance to identify opportunities for improvement and maximise return on investment.

Bring Market Insight into Strategy

You'll stay close to customer needs, market trends and competitor activity across workplace charging, depot charging and home fleet solutions, using insights to strengthen proposition positioning and marketing effectiveness.

Manage Budget and Investment

You'll own the commercial marketing budget, allocating resources effectively across campaigns, content and events, and continually optimising investment based on performance and commercial impact.

What You'll Bring: 

Proven B2B Marketing Experience

You'll have strong experience in commercial or B2B marketing, with a track record of delivering customer acquisition, retention and account growth programmes that contribute directly to business performance.

Strong Multi-Channel Marketing Expertise

You'll be experienced across account-based marketing, content marketing, events, digital campaigns and lifecycle marketing, with the ability to prioritise effectively across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.

Content Development Experience

You'll have experience developing case studies, thought leadership and customer-focused content that supports lead generation, sales engagement and brand positioning.

Campaign Development and Execution

You'll be confident building and delivering campaigns from strategy through to execution, measurement and optimisation, balancing creativity with commercial outcomes.

Outstanding Stakeholder Management

You'll be a strong communicator who can build trusted relationships across Sales, Marketing, Product and leadership teams, presenting recommendations and results with confidence.

Data-Driven Decision Making

You'll be comfortable working with performance data and marketing analytics, using insights to optimise campaign effectiveness and demonstrate contribution to pipeline, retention and revenue growth.

Budget Management Experience

You'll have experience managing marketing budgets, making informed investment decisions and balancing competing priorities to deliver the strongest commercial return.

Collaborative Working Style

You'll enjoy working cross-functionally and building alignment across teams to ensure marketing activity supports wider business objectives.

Marketing Technology Knowledge

You'll have experience using marketing automation platforms, ideally HubSpot, and understand how marketing technology can support campaign delivery, reporting and lead generation.

Bonus Points If You Have



- Experience within EV charging, clean energy, enterprise B2B, workplace services or fleet-related sectors
- Experience working within a scale-up or high-growth business environment
- Knowledge of B2B lifecycle marketing and customer retention strategies
- Experience supporting account-based marketing programmes
- Passion for sustainability and the transition to cleaner energy.

What's In It For You?

This is an opportunity to play a central role in one of Pod's most important growth areas. You'll have the freedom to shape how we market our commercial propositions, work closely with Sales and Product teams, and see the direct impact of your work on customer growth and revenue. If you're passionate about creating marketing programmes that deliver measurable commercial results and excited by the opportunity to help businesses transition to electric vehicles, we'd love to hear from you.

Pod Perks & Benefits



- Access for you and up to 5 family/friends to the 'UnMind' wellbeing platform
- Podpoint Charger
- Discounted energy tariff (Pod Power or EDF Employee Programme)
- Flexible hybrid working model 
- Work abroad for up to 20 days per year
- Family & friend discount scheme
- 25 days holiday (plus Bank Holidays)
- Very generous parental and family leave
- Pension scheme with a 4.5% matched contribution
- Eyecare scheme
- Life insurance covering up to 4x your annual salary
- Virtual GP provided by HealthHero 
- Employee Assistance Program
- Free Mortgage Advice 
- Discounted Gym Memberships
- Cycle2Work Scheme

Good luck and we look forward to speaking with you soon!

title: Integrated Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.
Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.
With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.
The job 
We're looking for an ambitious, creative, and growth-driven Integrated Campaign Manager to join Flo's Brand team to lead our commercial push into Perimenopause — building category leadership and driving growth as we scale this segment against a competitive landscape.
This is an exciting opportunity to help drive Flo's growth into a major new category through culturally resonant, insight-led campaigns that establish us as the trusted leader in perimenopause. You'll play a key role in shaping how Flo competes and wins in this space — translating category strategy into tangible, high-performing commercial work.
Your Experience
Must have:

- 7+ years' experience planning and executing multi-channel campaigns for consumer brands or apps, from ideation through launch and performance review.
- Experience launching or scaling a commercial product/category push in a competitive market, with a sharp read on cultural moments worth activating around.
- Strong cross-functional experience (Creative, Product Marketing, Growth, Social Growth, PR & UA), confidently managing creative production, internal/external teams, and multiple stakeholders.
- Analytical mindset — track record of measuring campaign performance and managing budgets for efficient, high-impact execution.
- Strong understanding of women's health audiences, ideally with exposure to the perimenopause/menopause category and its competitive landscape
Nice to have:

- Experience marketing to 35+ women or to life-stage-specific audiences (e.g.new parents, midlife consumers), either within or outside of health/wellness.
- Background in categories with a high credibility or trust bar (e.g. healthtech, femtech, finance, insurance).
- Experience in the US market specifically.
You'll be responsible for:

- Plan and execute integrated campaigns that drive Flo's brand equity & commercial growth in the perimenopause category — from positioning and creative development through launch, asset production, and performance review.
- Lead cross-functional collaboration across Brand, PR/Comms, Creative, Product Marketing, Influencers, and Organic Social to ensure every campaign lands with consistency and reach.
- Own the campaign calendar, prioritizing high-impact cultural and category moments (e.g. Menopause Awareness Month) and competitive timing.
- Identify new channel and partnership opportunities to build reach and credibility in the category — e.g. brand partnerships, category-specific media, podcasts.
- Manage campaign budgets and prove commercial impact, working closely with Analytics to track installs and revenue and prioritize investment in what drives measurable results.
 
How we work
We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.
You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it. 
What you'll get
We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

- Competitive salary and annual reviews
- Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme
- Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave
- Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents
- Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support
- In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office
- 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary
- Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks
Diversity, equity and inclusion
Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.
