title: Marketing Manager - International B2B
descriptionText:
Team: International Growth - International B2B

Location: London, UK (Hybrid position, in office 2 days per week)

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About The Job

We are seeking a strategic, highly autonomous Marketing Manager, International B2B, who loves building scalable systems, navigating open-ended briefs, and driving expansion across international B2B dining and hospitality markets. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end content strategy, execution, and optimisation of growth hacking projects, prospecting initiatives, and customer engagement campaigns. By obsessing over iteration speed, multi-channel attribution, and AI-enabled workflows, you will connect lead tracking data across all channels to eliminate inefficiencies and accelerate acquisition velocity. Working from our London office in a hybrid capacity, you will collaborate teams and channel owners, brand marketers, and diverse global cultures to elevate team performance.

Responsibilities



- Design, build, and scale high-impact growth hacking systems and marketing campaigns to accelerate B2B customer acquisition and expansion across international markets.
- Plan and produce B2B content campaigns e.g. research, case studies, gated assets, that speak to restaurant and hospitality decision-makers and convert into qualified pipeline, working with SEO teams where useful but owning the storytelling angle end to end.
- Own and optimise the end-to-end content strategy, email and website creation, and lead gen campaigns to maximise audience engagement and pipeline conversion.
- Deep understanding of full-funnel data, campaign tracking, and how all systems integrate with the sales CRM.
- Maintain robust end-to-end B2B lead tracking reporting and multi-channel attribution frameworks to accurately connect touchpoints across the entire buyer journey, including content-sourced leads.
- Leverage AI tools and predictive analytics to enhance audience segmentation, campaign personalisation, and operational efficiency across marketing workflows.
- Lead experimentation roadmaps, executing rapid A/B and multivariate tests to continually improve iteration speed, conversion rates, ROI, and customer lifetime value.

Minimum Qualifications



- 8+ years of relevant experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, or performance marketing within a B2B environment.
- Demonstrated ability to connect the dots on multi-channel B2B attribution, full-funnel lead tracking, and campaign performance measurement.
- Experience producing B2B content (research, case studies, gated assets) with a clear line from content to lead generation, not just brand awareness.
- Proven track record as a proactive builder who thrives with ambiguous briefs and excels at solving complex operational inefficiencies.
- Strong understanding of full-funnel data, lead tracking, and attribution frameworks.
- Practical experience applying AI tools or automation to streamline marketing workflows, campaign execution, and data analysis.
- Hands-on experience building landing pages and web assets with strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and Wordpress, as well as building email campaigns.
- Proficiency in managing core B2B marketing systems, including Salesforce and Marketo.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience driving international B2B growth and collaborating effectively across diverse cross-cultural markets.
- Strong writing/editing instincts, with experience briefing designers or working with content/SEO/brand teams to ship polished assets fast.
- Hands-on experience implementing multi-touch attribution models that tracks pipeline reporting and funnel analysis.
- Demonstrated success in prospecting campaign design and customer lifecycle retention modeling.
- Experience evaluating and integrating emerging AI marketing technologies, copilots, or marketing automation platforms.
- Passion for restaurants, hospitality, and dining culture.

Benefits And Perks



- 5 weeks paid vacation
- Private health & dental insurance
- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
- Company-paid subscription to Headspace
- Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
- Paid parental leave
- Time off for your birthday
- Paid volunteer time
- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars
- Leadership development
- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
- Travel Discounts
- Employee Resource Groups
- Income protection and life assurance
- Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
- Pension plan contributions
- Discounted gym membership
- Bike2Work
- Season ticket loan
- Social events & Thursday happy hours
- Free lunch 2 days per week
The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
E3 Recruitment is recruiting a Marketing Manager for an established business operating within the commercial vehicle sector, including HGVs, tankers and specialist vehicle applications based locally to Brighouse.
This is an opportunity to take full ownership of marketing strategy and delivery, with the scope to introduce new ideas, strengthen the brand and make a measurable contribution to business growth.
Working closely with senior leadership, sales and operations, you will drive campaigns that generate quality enquiries, support vehicle sales and build lasting customer relationships. You will also lead an in-house marketing executive, combining strategic direction with hands-on delivery.

The opportunity


You will shape how the business reaches its customers, promotes its vehicle offering and converts interest into sales opportunities. The role would suit a commercially minded marketer who enjoys ownership, brings creative ideas and can demonstrate the impact of their work.
Your responsibilities will include:

- Developing and delivering an end-to-end marketing strategy that directly supports sales objectives, generates quality leads and contributes to revenue growth.
- Managing the marketing budget, prioritising activity that delivers strong returns.
- Increasing lead volume and quality through SEO, PPC, paid social and targeted campaigns.
- Promoting vehicle stock across commercial vehicle marketplaces and relevant industry platforms.
- Managing engaging content and campaigns across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
- Developing CRM campaigns to nurture enquiries, encourage repeat business and improve customer retention.
- Improving website content, visibility and conversion through the CMS.
- Identifying new routes to market, partnerships and customer acquisition opportunities.
- Identifying and implementing AI tools and automation to improve lead generation, lead nurturing, customer engagement, campaign performance and marketing efficiency.
- Coordinating creative content, PR, exhibitions and industry events.
- Setting clear KPIs and reporting on marketing's contribution to enquiries, sales and revenue.
- Leading and developing the marketing executive while maintaining a consistent brand across all channels.

About you


You will bring at least five years' experience at marketing manager level, gained in-house or within an agency, alongside a track record of delivering measurable results.
A background or passion in commercial vehicles, HGVs, tankers, automotive, plant, machinery or a related industry would be preffered . 
You should be comfortable understanding technical products and turning their features into clear, compelling customer benefits.
You will also offer:

- Strong experience across SEO, PPC, social media, content and CRM marketing.
- Proven experience developing and delivering a marketing strategy that supports sales, with responsibility for budgets and measurable commercial results.
- Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.
- Experience using website CMS platforms, ideally WordPress.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn performance data into practical improvements.
- Excellent copywriting, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Confidence using AI tools, with a practical understanding of how to apply AI and automation within a marketing strategy to improve sales opportunities and business performance.
- An understanding of GDPR and responsible customer data use.
- The ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on delivery in a busy SME environment.
Experience in B2B marketing, PR, trade shows, Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, and tools such as Lead Forensics would be advantageous. A relevant marketing qualification is desirable, although proven experience and commercial results are equally valued.

Why consider this role?


This position offers ownership, visibility and the opportunity to influence business growth. You will have scope to challenge existing approaches, test new ideas and build a marketing function that makes a clear commercial impact.
To find out more, apply with your CV or contact Andrew Pilling at E3 Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Role Overview


Inova DC is a growing data centre infrastructure business focused on reliable, scalable, and forward-looking solutions across data centre environments, AI/ML infrastructure, liquid cooling, and bespoke system solutions, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and customer collaboration. The Marketing Manager will lead the company’s marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, generate qualified demand, and support commercial growth across priority markets. 


Job Description


The Marketing Manager will be responsible for building and executing Inova DC’s end-to-end marketing function. This role is suited to a commercially minded B2B marketer who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery across digital marketing, content, campaigns, events, product positioning, and sales enablement.


Working closely with leadership, sales, product, and external partners, the Marketing Manager will help translate Inova DC’s technical capabilities into clear market messaging that resonates with data centre operators, consultants, integrators, enterprise customers, and AI infrastructure stakeholders. The role will also ensure that Inova DC’s sustainability-led brand and innovation story are consistently reflected across all channels. 


Key Responsibilities


Develop and deliver Inova DC’s marketing strategy in line with business growth goals.
Own brand positioning, messaging, and value proposition across the company’s product and service portfolio.
Plan and execute integrated B2B marketing campaigns to generate leads and build pipeline.
Manage website content, SEO, email marketing, LinkedIn activity, and digital campaign performance.
Create high-quality marketing content including brochures, case studies, presentations, thought leadership articles, product sheets, and customer success stories.
Support go-to-market activity for new solutions, launches, partnerships, and market initiatives.
Work closely with sales to produce compelling sales enablement materials and improve lead conversion.
Coordinate Inova DC’s presence at industry events, exhibitions, conferences, and networking opportunities.
Build PR, media, and industry visibility for the business through announcements, interviews, and speaking opportunities.
Manage external agencies, designers, copywriters, and digital partners where required.
Track, analyse, and report on marketing performance, campaign ROI, lead quality, and brand engagement.
Help shape internal marketing processes, reporting, and best practice as the company scales.
Core Objectives


Increase awareness of Inova DC in the data centre and AI infrastructure market.
Generate qualified inbound and outbound-supported leads for the commercial team.
Strengthen product marketing for liquid cooling, CDU solutions, and broader data centre offerings.
Build a consistent and credible brand presence across digital, event, and partner channels.
Support revenue growth through measurable, insight-led marketing activity.
Candidate Profile


Proven experience in a marketing manager or senior B2B marketing role.
Strong background in technology, infrastructure, industrial, engineering, or data centre-related sectors.
Excellent understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and content strategy.
Ability to simplify complex technical solutions into clear customer-focused messaging.
Experience supporting sales teams with lead generation and commercial marketing assets.
Strong copywriting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Confident using CRM and marketing tools to track campaign effectiveness and pipeline contribution.
Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-growth environment.
Experience with trade events, industry marketing, and partner-led campaigns is desirable.
Preferred Experience


Marketing within data centres, cooling, critical infrastructure, AI/HPC, or enterprise technology.
Exposure to liquid cooling, modular infrastructure, or technical equipment-based solutions.
Familiarity with account-based marketing, thought leadership campaigns, and product marketing.
Experience building or formalizing a marketing function in a scaling business.
Success Measures


Growth in qualified leads and marketing-influenced pipeline.
Improved brand visibility and engagement across target audiences.
Stronger sales enablement and conversion support.
Successful delivery of campaigns, launches, and events.
Clear reporting on ROI, performance, and market impact

Operating with a high degree of cultural intelligence and executional precision, you will be responsible for building and executing the APAC go-to-market plan to drive ticket sales and event attendance across a region spanning multiple time zones, languages and fan cultures. You will balance global strategy with highly localised execution, adapting global frameworks into locally resonant campaigns, activating the right performance marketing mix for each distinct market and keeping every regional stakeholder perfectly aligned and working from the same master plan.



- Own the APAC GTM Plan: You build, maintain and own the central APAC go-to-market plan, the single source of truth for all regional marketing activity, audience targeting, channel strategy and ticket sales targets. You are fully accountable for keeping this plan current, commercially grounded and ensuring every internal and external stakeholder works seamlessly from it.
- Performance Marketing & Channel Mix: You plan and execute paid and performance marketing activity across the entire APAC region. You are responsible for selecting, deploying and continuously optimising the right mix of digital and traditional channels tailored to the unique media landscape of each specific market.
- Drive Ticket Sales & Commercial Conversion: You execute targeted promotional plans that turn brand awareness into hard ticket purchases. You bring a sharp focus to markets where Formula E is still establishing its fan base, ensuring every local activation works harder to build audiences and fill the grandstands.
- Promoter Alignment & Agency Management: You serve as the primary link between central ticketing and local race promoters, effortlessly navigating different commercial structures, languages and cultural expectations. Furthermore, you manage regional agency relationships across creative, media and activation, setting clear ambitions, holding partners to strict performance standards and stepping in quickly with solutions if a partnership falters.
- Data & Insights Mastery: You closely monitor sales velocity and conversion rates across all regional channels. You dive deep into data to extract the "why" behind the numbers, feeding those insights back into the core strategy to constantly sharpen your approach.

What we're looking for in you:



- The APAC Market Specialist: You possess a deep, nuanced understanding of the cultural, commercial and media landscapes across APAC markets. You know how to confidently navigate these varied ecosystems to make an international brand feel locally relevant.
- The Performance Marketing Expert: You bring hands-on experience running sophisticated paid media and multi-channel marketing campaigns. You maintain a clear, unwavering line of sight between marketing spend and tangible customer acquisition or ticket sales outcomes.
- The Global Communicator: You are an outstanding communicator who can seamlessly translate a global brand vision into local relevance. You have the organisational skills to collaborate and manage relationships effectively across significant time zone differences and language barriers.
- The Analytical Thinker: You are entirely comfortable working inside data dashboards, with a proven ability to translate complex data sets and sales metrics into a clear, actionable story of "what's next" for campaign performance.

- Flexible Bank Holidays

This is a hybrid role and you'll be required to do 3 days a week in our Hammersmith London office.

At Formula E, we are building a culture where every voice matters, every perspective accelerates progress, and every individual is empowered to rise, contribute boldly, and shape a better world - together. We believe in attracting and retaining diverse talent to strengthen our global vision with a variety of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.

Our mission is clear. The message is simple. Whoever you are. However you live. Whatever you believe. Formula E. For the Future. For Everyone.

We’ll see you at the starting line!

title: Retail Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
About Fussy

Hey good smelling! We’re Fussy…about everything in our mission to banish single-use plastic from your bathroom. We’ve delivered five years of exceptional growth, including building significant distribution in Tesco, Sainsbury’s, Waitrose, Ocado, Boots, Superdrug and Holland & Barrett.

To help drive further growth in retail, both in existing and new channels, we’re now looking for a Shopper Marketing Manager to join our Brand team. You’ll be leading the charge on how Fussy shows up across every retail touchpoint, making sure the brand looks brilliant and engages shoppers as well on every retail shelf as it does on Fussy.com.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a purpose-driven scale-up through a significant period of growth. 💪🌍

What You’ll Do 💼



- Building the annual retail marketing calendar, aligned to range reviews and launches, promotional plans and other retailer & brand activity
- Generating ideas to build excitement around new launches and key moments, working with the Creative team to turn them into stand out in store and .com activations
- Understanding each retailer’s shopper profile in order to tailor plans across promotions, POS, sampling, gifting and other in-store activation
- Supporting the Retail team’s JBP conversations to help secure marketing investment and additional visibility
- Ensuring the brand planning process brings an equal Retail and DTC mindset
- Being the main Brand team contact for the Retail team
- Leading development of all retail marketing toolkits and materials
- Supporting and attending Trade and Retailer Head office events
- Briefing and optimising onsite search, display and email within retailer ecosystems
- Ensuring product content is optimised on retailer.com pages

Who You Are 🤓

Skills

Great comes in lots of different forms, and we’re really open to seeing candidates from a range of backgrounds. Given the nature of this role and what we’ll ask of you, we do believe that the following skills are needed to be able to deliver to a high standard:



- A minimum of 5 years’ experience in FMCG shopper, retail or trade marketing, ideally within beauty or personal care and working with grocery and health & beauty retailers
- A brand guardian with a retail mindset, able to protect what makes Fussy distinctive while adapting the brand to drive impact on a retailer shelf or online listing
- A creative thinker who knows what gets noticed on shelf, full of ideas for activations that engage retailers and shoppers, drive footfall and make Fussy stand out in store
- Experience briefing and optimising onsite search, display, email and product content within retailer ecosystems
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- An effective collaborator, experienced in working cross-functionally with brand, marketing, creative and commercial teams

What we offer 🤝



- A chance to play a part in banishing single-use plastic from the bathroom
- A salary of £45-55k depending on experience
- Hybrid working with Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays in our London (Shoreditch) office
- 33 days annual leave including flexible bank holidays + a day off for your birthday – we encourage you to take time off to switch off, rest and recharge.
- Our WellHub membership with a range of fitness & wellbeing options - we care about our team’s wellness, from physical to mental health
- Share options after probation, so that you can benefit from our growth

To help us manage the high volume of applications we receive, we use AI-assisted screening as one part of our process — always applied thoughtfully and fairly. But rest assured, technology never has the final say: every candidate who moves forward is met with genuine human attention, care and connection, every step of the way.

Who We Are 💪🌍

Fussy are on a mission to banish single-use plastic from the bathroom by designing simple, effective and convenient personal care products that are backed by science not buzzwords. Our first product, a refillable deodorant is now the UK’s top rated natural deodorant and has blessed the armpits of everyone from Holly Willoughby to some very known Dragons’. We have put in place the foundations of a world-class team of employees and advisors and this is a super exciting time to join as we are now looking to accelerate our growth into new products and territories. We as a brand have the responsibility, consumers have the power and it’s only together we can do this. Power to your pits!

- Build and nurture strong partnerships with key third-party aggregators (Uber Eats, Just Eat, Deliveroo) and internal stakeholders, unlocking new opportunities through collaboration, joint planning, and strategic alignment.
- Identify, test, and scale innovative ideas that enhance the customer experience and deliver measurable commercial growth across digital channels.
- Support international markets and franchise partners by sharing best practices, frameworks, and tools that enable consistent, high-impact execution and long-term success.

- Deep knowledge of ecommerce and digital trends, with the ability to turn data and insights into clear, commercially impactful actions.
- Strong commercial acumen and confidence working with P&L, combined with excellent analytical, trade reporting, and problem-solving skills.
- Highly effective communicator with the ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, as well as manage external partner relationships.

So, why Costa? 
We didn’t become a global coffee brand by sitting back. When you work here, you join a community that values passion, progression, and integrity—with some brilliant perks to sweeten the deal. - Private medical cover thanks to our Private Healthcare scheme
- And that’s not all. Explore even more of our perks here: https://bit.ly/costaperks

Right now, our Support Centre teams work flexibly, blending home working with in-person time whenever it matters most – whether that’s a team moment, a creative session, or simply coming together to share ideas.


We’re excited to be moving into a new home for our brand in St Albans in January 2027 – an inspiring space from which our Support Centre teams will work three days a week to connect and collaborate in-person to bring our bold ambition to life.

descriptionText:
Define How Capably Shows Up in the Market

As Marketing Manager at Capably, you’ll define how we tell our story to the market. You’ll shape our positioning, sharpen our messaging, and lead the programs that build awareness, credibility, and demand as we scale.

This is not a brand-only role. You’ll sit at the centre of narrative, execution, and growth—turning product insight, customer outcomes, and market opportunity into content, campaigns, and initiatives that move the business forward. From thought leadership and website messaging to events and launch materials, your work will help determine how Capably is understood by customers, partners, and the broader market. Capably is actively investing more in content and thought leadership, particularly to strengthen positioning in the US market.

Build and Scale Marketing That Drives Momentum

We believe strong marketing is not about noise—it’s about clarity, consistency, and commercial impact. You’ll develop and run marketing initiatives that help Capably reach the right audiences, communicate a differentiated story, and generate momentum across the funnel.

You’ll work closely with leadership, design, sales, and product to translate company priorities into effective campaigns and assets. That includes developing content, refining messaging, supporting events, improving the website, and helping create the materials that make Capably easier to understand and easier to buy. Recent internal priorities already include a website release, whitepaper review, a 10-week marketing program, founder content, and event preparation, all of which reflect the shape of this role.



- Own and evolve Capably’s marketing strategy across brand, content, campaigns, and go-to-market execution
- Develop clear messaging and positioning that communicates Capably’s value to the right audiences
- Lead thought leadership, content, and narrative development across channels
- Partner with design to ship high-quality marketing assets, website updates, and campaign materials
- Support events, outbound initiatives, and market-facing programs that build awareness and pipeline
- Work cross-functionally with sales, product, and leadership to ensure marketing aligns with business priorities

Your work will help Capably build a stronger market presence, create more consistent demand, and turn company momentum into a repeatable marketing engine. Internal discussions also show active investment in educational content, blog visuals, one-pagers, and broader website development, which gives this role a broad surface area across both strategy and execution.

Success in this role means combining strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You’ll need to move quickly, write clearly, manage multiple workstreams, and keep quality high while the company evolves fast. The right person will know how to build a narrative, prioritise ruthlessly, and turn incomplete inputs into polished output.

By staying close to the market and close to the company’s priorities, you’ll help Capably build a marketing function that is not just creative but highly effective. Your ability to translate what we are building into stories and campaigns that resonate will be essential to our next phase of growth.

What You Bring



- Strong experience in B2B marketing, content marketing, product marketing, or growth marketing
- Ability to develop clear positioning and turn complex products into compelling messaging
- Strong writing and communication skills across content, campaigns, and customer-facing materials
- Experience managing cross-functional marketing initiatives from concept through execution
- Good judgment on brand, narrative, and what actually resonates with the market
- Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment with high ownership and ambiguity
- Experience with enterprise software, AI, SaaS, or category creation is a strong plus

Your work will help Capably become not just a company with a strong product, but one with a strong market voice. If you’re excited to build narrative, drive execution, and help shape how an ambitious AI company grows, we’d love to hear from you.

Working closely with the CMO, you'll play a key role in shaping how the group's concepts come to life, delivering creative campaigns and experiences that increase awareness, engage guests and support commercial performance.

The Role


You'll be responsible for:

- Developing and delivering annual marketing plans across multiple restaurants and venues
- Creating integrated campaigns across digital, social, PR, print and in-venue channels
- Supporting new restaurant openings, concept launches and seasonal campaigns
- Developing positioning, storytelling, tone of voice and creative direction

descriptionText:
Job role:  Channel Marketing Manager

Hours:  Monday to Friday, 09:00 - 17:00 (35 hours per week)

Happy to talk flexible working

Hill Dickinson are proud to be named as a Top Ten Employer for Working Families 2025 for the second year running and so, we are happy to consider flexible working opportunities to help you balance your work and home life.

Team:  Marketing and Business Development

Location: Liverpool or Manchester

Role Overview

Introduction to the role:

The Channel Marketing Manager will lead the development of the firm's key marketing and comms channels, ensuring they work together to deliver a consistent experience for internal and external audiences. The role will have responsibility for overseeing the website, intranet, and social media channels with three direct reports.

The successful candidate will bring leadership, organisational, and stakeholder management skills, using data, insight, and best practice to optimise channel performance, enhance the firm's digital presence, and support wider marketing, communications, and business objectives.

Introduction To The Team

You will be part of the Marketing and Communications team and will report directly to the Head of Marketing and Communications. All members of the wider BD&M team are expected to support the work of the wider business development plans and other parts of the firm as needed.

Key Responsibilities



- Lead the firm's website, intranet, and social media channels, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
- Manage and support channel specialists, fostering collaboration and a joined-up approach to channel delivery.
- Develop and implement channel strategies to drive engagement, visibility, and user experience.
- Work closely with stakeholders across the business to identify and deliver channel improvements and prioritise workstreams.
- Monitor and report on channel performance, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Support firm-wide campaigns, initiatives, and business development activity. 
- Ensure all channel activity complies with brand, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
- Manage relationships with external suppliers and platform providers where required.
- Identify opportunities to improve channel effectiveness, adopting best practice and emerging trends.

What Are We Looking For

Important criteria: 



- Proven experience managing and developing digital channels within a professional services environment, preferably a law firm.
- Demonstrable passion for improving channel performance, identifying opportunities, and driving innovation through new ideas and approaches.
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously, with excellent organisational and planning skills.
- Previous line management experience.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working effectively across a range of business functions and seniority levels.
- Experience developing and delivering social media strategies that drive engagement.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

It would be beneficial for you to have some of the following: 



- Experience working with Umbraco CMS.
- Experience managing or supporting a SharePoint-based intranet environment.
- Experience overseeing website content, governance, and user experience improvements.

Qualifications

This is a high impact role for a strategic marketer with a proven ability to translate insight into compelling positioning that drives pursuit success. Reporting to the Head of Pursuit Marketing, Europe and India , the role will lead positioning campaigns for our most critical pursuits, working closely with capture, pursuit and marketing and communications communities to win what matters. - Manage allocated pursuit or campaign budgets and report performance to internal stakeholders.

- Marketing management experience in a professional services environment.  
- Experience managing bids and marketing campaigns, ideally within pursuit or capture environments.

- Strong strategic thinker, able to articulate strategy clearly and compellingly.

- Experience in developing and delivering integrated multi-channel tactics including conferences, client events, awards, social media, thought leadership and editorial activities.

descriptionText:
Marketing Manager, EFL UK
Location: Hybrid/London
Type of Contract: Permanent, Full Time
Salary: Competitive


About Oxford International


Oxford International Education Group is a renowned institution dedicated to providing exceptional educational experiences to international students. With a global presence and a commitment to academic excellence, we strive to empower students to achieve their full potential and thrive in a dynamic, interconnected world. We are proud of our culture and have recently been officially certified as a Great Place to Work ©!


Job Purpose


The Marketing Manager, EFL UK role is an exciting and dynamic position that oversees all marketing and communications for the UK English Language division. This includes marketing of our Adult English, Junior, and Year-Round Group programmes in the UK and collaborating closely with colleagues in North America and Australia.


Reporting to the Director of Marketing, Global EFL and Career Colleges, the Marketing Manager will work closely with the UK sales and operations teams, school staff, and other marketing colleagues on various cross-functional and cross-regional projects and tasks. The Marketing Manager will support B2B sales and develop strategies to drive organic sales through website and social media activities. They will be the subject matter / product expert for English Language, Junior, and Year-Round Group programmes in the UK, understanding and supporting sales requirements, staying on top of market dynamics, the competitor landscape, varied audiences, and marketing best practices.


Main Duties and Responsibilities


The Marketing Manager, EFL UK role requires high levels of collaboration with diverse stakeholders and someone who is confident, able to support and constructive challenge and develop fruitful relations, as well as being a strategic planner, creative and able and willing to be hands on and deliver high quality outputs on time. The role requires regular local travel to our Adult English schools (London, Brighton, Oxford, Edinburgh) and Junior & Year-Round Group centres.


The ideal candidate will be an experienced marketer with confidence and resilience who thrives in fast-paced environments and who can leverage their technical, creative and strategic skills to help meet and exceed business & brand targets (student recruitment, agent engagement, student experience & engagement). They will have experience with developing compelling marketing messaging, designing marketing collateral, planning and executing on social media content and calendars, and developing strong relationships with various stakeholders. They will be comfortable developing and improving processes and confident in delivering high-quality work with a focus on meeting deadlines. They will be a member of the global marketing team, supported by existing marketing systems, processes and skillsets.


Sales enablement and support


Collaborate with the sales teams, regional managers, operations team and school staff to support overall division and programme targets, including:


Sales Enablement – Be the owner of the product truth and deliver the Adult English, Juniors, and Year-Round Group sales enablement activities and marketing materials, ensuring effective communications and accurate and up-to-date content:



- Lead the annual design, development, print production and delivery of digital and sales toolkits for the UK schools and programmes
- Create new collateral as requests come in throughout the year, managing deadlines effectively and creating content items and/or partnering with the central design team for support
- Ensure collateral, merchandise and toolkits are high-quality, on brand and adapted to specific audiences
- Content development - Regularly produce content that promotes student success and interesting events happening across the division
- Events & webinars – Support events, conferences, and webinars, ensure ongoing enhancements by tracking key performance metrics


Email marketing - Create and execute quality email marketing campaigns to nurture and convert prospective agents and students


Content marketing – Together with the North America and Australian marketing colleagues and the social media team, develop a social media content calendar and monthly agent newsletters highlighting key selling points of owned UK products.



- Create a library of student/alumni testimonials and staff profiles to be utilised in marcomms
- SEO strategy and blog content development
- Develop and deliver integrated marketing communication plans for key projects; monitoring and reporting on effectiveness/ ROI
- Ensure engaging and consistent communications across all touch points with stakeholders and work on ways to improve the briefing and approvals process


New product, partner, and course launches



- In collaboration with the New Launches Marketing Manager, sales, and operations teams, support launch of new partners and products
- Develop and own multi-channel launch strategies and plans to support business goals


Website and social media


Manage the English language, Juniors and Year-Round Groups online presence, strengthening our positioning against competitors through clear and consistent communications and journeys that maximise lead generation, conversion and advocacy:



- Update and evolve English Language and Juniors website with enhanced user experience and SEO-enabling content
- Keep up to date with SEO, AEO, GEO, and social media algorithmic changes, analyse implications for the business and make recommendations for positive impact
- Regularly report on digital marketing metrics on the website and social channels to improve reach, engagement and followers
- In collaboration with the central social media team, sales, marketing colleagues, and operations, create digital content to highlight programmes and showcase student experience - quirky stories, infographics, trends, photos, and videos
- Collaborate with the school staff and lead on social media content plan and themes – clear processes for collecting and curating relevant and inspiring content that reflects the vibrant community in our colleges, as well as promoting our unique value proposition and different programmes


Brand management and positioning


In collaboration with the Director of Marketing, Global EFL and Career Colleges, own the English Language and Juniors brands:



- Brand identity, consistency and value proposition evolution for improved relevance
- Clear messaging hierarchy
- Differentiated positioning: stand out from competition with students, agents and partners
- Ensure brand consistency and quality across all UK Adult English, Juniors, and Year-Round Group materials and messaging
- Develop product level benefits & KSPs messaging that drive interest, applications and bookings


Cross-functional teamwork and collaboration


Collaborate with sales, operations, and school staff to promote UK programmes to students, parents and agents, executing marketing initiatives to deliver commercial results.



- Lead on delivering comms collateral, events, web & social content
- Collaborate with colleagues to provide a joined-up service to sales, students, and agents
- Build and establish effective networks with key internal and external stakeholders and nurture relationships through structured engagement
- Ensure budget is effectively utilised for greater ROI and negotiate competitive and flexible deals with suppliers


Person Specifications


Legal status



- Eligibility to live and work in the UK
- Undergo an Enhanced DBS disclosure check or overseas equivalent


Qualifications



- Educated to degree level


Experience and knowledge



- Significant experience working in a marketing role
- Designing and producing marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, presentations
- Developing clear and structured briefs for design, web design, or videography projects
- Running photography and videography shoots
- Editing photography and videography for social media and sales use cases
- Working with Canva and Adobe suite of products (PDF, Premier Pro, etc.)
- Developing and managing multiple social media content calendars (Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn)
- Creating engaging marketing collateral including flyers, presentation decks, graphics, etc.
- Managing social media channels and developing and executing on engaging social media content
- Planning and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns, from strategy and concept to delivery and reporting
- Writing SEO-driven content, such as web pages, blogs, social media captions, etc.
- Experience working in the English Language and international education market (Desirable)
- Experience with AI marketing tool (Desirable)
- Experience with photo and video production and visual storytelling (Desirable)
- Experience with HubSpot and WordPress (Desirable)
- Experience with a Project Management tool, such as Monday.com (Desirable)


Skills and Abilities



- Can write compelling and engaging content with SEO best practices in mind
- Can design engaging marketing collateral for varied uses (print, digital)
- Can create social media graphics and content that are aligned with strategic business goals and brand
- Can create promotional videos, social media videos, and long-form videos in Canva
- Can manage multiple priorities and projects while still achieving deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Able to prioritize and respond effectively to new requests at short notice
- Can build strong relationships with colleagues with the ability to motivate, influence, persuade, and negotiate across varying levels of seniority
- Can travel to head office, Adult English Schools, and Junior & Year-Round Group centres during key periods throughout the year, especially during high season in the Spring and Summer months


Personal qualities



- Collaborative and communicative with stakeholders and colleagues
- Friendly and outgoing, able to easily interact and collaborative with colleagues, students, agents, and other professional networks
- Strong interpersonal, networking, and stakeholder management skills
- Very organized with a strong focus on meeting and achieving deadlines
- Focuses on delivering high-quality outputs
- Takes an interest in learning and growing skills (a lifelong learner)
- Maintains a solution-focused mindset, finding new paths to achieve the desired outcome
- Takes initiative to plan and own marketing for EFL UK products
- Takes a strategic and multi-channel approach to activities, finding ways to connect the dots and increase positive performance
- Innovative marketer and a creative problem solver
- Has a dynamic attitude with the willing to test, learn, and fail in order to improve
- Flexible and able to adapt to changing priorities
- Tactful, respectful, and has the ability to deal with confidential and sensitive information
- Willingness to work during the evenings and on weekends when required (i.e. special events, high season, etc.)

Brand & Campaigns Marketing Manager


Exclusive opportunity to join a growing telecoms business as Brand & Campaigns Marketing Manager, taking ownership of brand development and integrated campaign delivery across consumer and business markets.


This is a broad, commercially focused role combining brand strategy with hands-on campaign execution. You will lead multi-channel campaigns, above-the-line activity, organic social and hyper-local marketing, ensuring brand investment drives awareness, engagement and measurable customer growth.


Hybrid working – 3 days in Oxfordshire office, 2 from home

- Lead the development and evolution of the brand, positioning, messaging and creative frameworks.
- Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across consumer and business audiences.
- Manage campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, ensuring consistent messaging and strong commercial outcomes.
- Develop and deliver hyper-local and community marketing programmes tailored to different geographic markets.
- Lead above-the-line activity across channels including TV, radio, OOH, sponsorship and local media.
- Own organic social media and content strategy, including channel planning and editorial calendars.
- Manage creative, media and production agencies, ensuring high-quality delivery and effective use of budget.
- Work closely with performance, digital, lifecycle and B2B marketing teams to connect brand activity with customer acquisition and engagement.
- Partner with insight and analytics teams to measure brand health, campaign effectiveness, ROI and customer penetration.
- Embed a structured test-and-learn approach across campaigns, creative, media and local marketing activity.
- Support PR, sponsorships, proposition launches and major external communications.


Skills & Experience

- Strong experience in brand management, integrated marketing or marketing communications, ideally within telecoms.
- Proven experience developing and delivering integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Strong understanding of brand strategy, creative development and campaign planning.
- Experience managing above-the-line media campaigns and external agency partners.
- Experience of regional, community or hyper-local marketing would be advantageous.
- Strong understanding of organic social media and content strategy.
- Commercially focused, with experience using campaign and customer data to optimise marketing performance.
- Able to combine strategic brand thinking with hands-on campaign delivery in a fast-paced environment.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About The Team & Role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Robinhood International & Crypto team’s mission is to democratize finance for all by making investing simple, safe, and accessible. We’re a collaborative group of marketers, product thinkers, and strategists working together to drive adoption and engagement expansion markets.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you’ll play a key role in how we connect with customers and drive growth for Robinhood in expansion markets. In this role, you’ll lead go-to-market strategy for new products and features and help shape the product growth strategy for our brokerage and crypto offering in a highly regulated and fast-moving environment. We’re looking for a consumer product marketer who can build and execute strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and growth, partnering closely with cross-functional teams across product, creative, research, legal, compliance, and more!

This role is based in our UK office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do



- Own product marketing for Robinhood in expansion markets, leading positioning and go-to-market strategy for new products and features, as well as evergreen initiatives that drive adoption and engagement.
- Partner with product, lifecycle, performance, creative, social, events, communications, legal, and compliance to define and deliver strategic growth initiatives.
- Serve as a strategic advisor to product teams, helping inform roadmaps and product improvements based on user insights, market feedback, and regional learnings.
- Develop differentiated narratives and messaging informed by user insights, testing, and a deep understanding of the target audience
- Craft marketing plans and creative direction that drive relevance, adoption, and sustained engagement for Robinhood.
- Define success metrics and track impact in partnership with product and data science teams, ensuring alignment with legal and compliance requirements.

- 7+ years experience in product marketing (or adjacent consumer growth/product roles) in tech.
- Strong growth marketing leadership, including shaping positioning, messaging, and integrated launch plans across channels.
- Ability to break down complex concepts so they’re simple, clear, and human.
- Strong relationship-building skills and ability to lead cross-functionally through influence.
- Data-informed decision making, including familiarity with experimentation and performance measurement.
- Fluency across key marketing channels (e.g., lifecycle, performance, in-product, and social) and how to sequence them for impact.
- Comfort operating in regulated consumer products and partnering closely with legal and compliance teams.
- Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a bias toward action.

What We Offer



- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
- Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership.
- Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.
- Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
- Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
- Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.

descriptionText:

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

We’re looking for a B2B marketing all-rounder, with a particular love of product marketing.

"Join a fast-paced, collaborative marketing team where you'll lead high-impact campaigns, influence strategic priorities, and help drive the success of some of Rightmove's biggest growth opportunities for our partners." - Colleen, Hiring Manager

We're a B2B specialist team within the wider marketing team. title: B2B Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
Generate qualified demand, strengthen our Business Services brand, and enable sustainable revenue growth through targeted, insight-led B2B marketing.

We are entering an exciting phase of growth within the Business Services market, expanding our portfolio of connectivity, communications and managed service solutions for SMEs, public sector organisations, and strategic customers across rural Britain.

You will lead the development and delivery of our Business Services marketing strategy, creating integrated campaigns that generate qualified demand, strengthen market awareness, and enable the Business Services team to achieve its growth ambitions.

Working closely with the Business Commercial Strategy & Propositions Manager, Business Services leadership, Commercial Insight & Intelligence, PR and the wider Marketing team, the role will translate commercial strategy into targeted go-to-market programmes, thought leadership and customer engagement that generate measurable pipeline growth and strengthen our reputation as a trusted business connectivity and communications partner.

You will combine strategic marketing capability with strong commercial thinking, developing a modern B2B marketing function that balances brand building, demand generation, thought leadership, and sales enablement.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Services Marketing Strategy

Build and deliver an integrated Business Services marketing strategy that supports our commercial objectives and long-term growth ambitions.

Develop annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned to revenue targets, commercial priorities, and evolving market opportunities, ensuring marketing investment delivers measurable commercial outcomes.

Generate Qualified Demand

Work closely with the Business Services team to define lead qualification criteria, optimise lead management processes, and continually improve conversion from marketing-generated opportunities into revenue.

Lead demand generation programmes that deliver a consistent pipeline of high-quality sales opportunities across our target business markets.

Develop integrated campaigns spanning digital marketing, content marketing, webinars, events, direct marketing, account-based marketing, partnerships, and thought leadership.

Go to Market & Proposition Marketing

Partner closely with the Business Commercial Strategy & Propositions Manager to successfully launch new products, services, and commercial solutions.

Develop compelling proposition messaging, customer value propositions and go-to-market strategies that clearly articulate our competitive differentiation.

Account & Sector Campaigns:

Develop targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programmes focused on priority customers, strategic accounts, and high-value opportunities.

Create sector-specific marketing campaigns for key industries including agriculture, hospitality, professional services etc.

Use customer insight, market intelligence and commercial data to personalise marketing activity, strengthen engagement and improve the effectiveness of Business Services marketing.

Sales Enablement

Act as the strategic marketing partner to the Business Services team, ensuring Marketing and Sales operate as one integrated commercial function.

Develop sales enablement materials including proposition guides, competitive battlecards, customer presentations, sales playbooks, proposal content, and digital assets that enable the sales team to communicate Gigaclear’s value proposition with confidence.

Market Development & Thought Leadership

Position us as a recognised thought leader in business connectivity, digital transformation, and rural enterprise, strengthening our reputation as a trusted technology partner rather than simply a broadband provider.

Working closely with Corporate Communications and PR, develop a thought leadership programme that builds awareness, credibility, and engagement across our target business sectors.

Customer Lifetime Value & Advocacy

Develop programmes that strengthen relationships with existing Business Services customers and increase Customer Lifetime Value.

Create customer communication programmes supporting onboarding, product adoption, upsell / x-sell opportunities, customer retention, and advocacy.

Embed Test & Learn Methodology

Develop a culture of experimentation across Business Services marketing.

Working alongside Commercial Insight & Intelligence, design structured testing across messaging, content, campaign formats, account-based marketing, thought leadership, customer journeys, and lead generation activity.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

You will have significant experience in B2B marketing, demand generation or commercial marketing within telecommunications, technology, managed services, SaaS or other business-to-business environments.

You will bring a strong understanding of demand generation, account-based marketing, proposition marketing, content marketing, thought leadership, and sales enablement, together with experience supporting consultative sales teams.

Experience of CRM platforms, marketing automation, digital marketing, partner marketing, PR collaboration, and campaign analytics will be highly advantageous, together with experience working closely with Sales, Product Management and Commercial Strategy teams.

Gigaclear is a leading alternative operator of rural full fibre broadband networks in the UK. Offering customers a truly world class product, we are developing our fibre-to-the-premises broadband (FTTP / FTTH) infrastructure to some of the most difficult to reach areas of the UK, empowering those communities with broadband to rival any city.

Our Mission - Empowering communities with brilliant broadband

Our Vision - Connected Communities

Our Values - Own it, Find the Right Way, Work Together, Win Together

title: Marketing Manager (DACH)
descriptionText:
The finance function is broken.

Finance teams at fast-growing, multi-entity companies are outgrowing their single-entity ledgers and facing a familiar crossroads: bolt on more tools, or go full corporate ERP. Neither option is good. The Frankenstack breaks. The ERP weighs you down with implementation fees and consultants. There has to be a better, more AI native way.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

Why DACH, why now.

To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

What You'll Be Doing.



- Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig. 
- Owning the full DACH events calendar. Finhack hackathons, third-party sponsorships, roundtables. From concept to follow-up, you run it. 
- Managing the regional budget, knowing where to spend and where to hold back. 
- Working with our brand team on everything from regional messaging and localisation to experiential campaigns that cut through in a market full of noise. 
- Bringing on-the-ground market data back to your VP Marketing and Growth Lead to sharpen paid activity, targeting, and messaging across the region. 
- Driving regional pipeline, working across events, campaigns, and community to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the sales team. 
- Partnering with RevOps to keep pipeline clean, prospects moving, and nothing falling through the cracks between marketing and sales. 
- Enabling the sales team with the collateral, messaging, and market context they need to win in DACH. 
- Building community, not just pipeline. You'll build relationships with press, analysts, and partners, but the bigger goal is an ecosystem of likeminded changemakers around a product that's transforming the finance function. 

What we think you'll need.*



- Meaningful experience in field or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally one that was building out international presence from a non-DACH HQ. 
- Native-level German fluency. You can write the copy, run the room, and build the relationships. 
- A real track record running field marketing and events from start to finish.. 
- The ability to work across Sales, RevOps, and brand without losing momentum or creating friction. You know how to get things done in a cross-functional team. 
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, not just comfort with it. We're an AI-native company and use AI across everything we build and do. Just as Light helps finance teams do their best work, we expect our people to use AI to do theirs. 
- To be based in London, with frequent travel. 
- But really, what do we know? If the crux of the role sounds right but you don't tick every box, reach out anyway and make your case. 

The good stuff.

🏢 In-office culture, with a high talent-density team.

💸 Competitive salary.

🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays in your country of employment.

🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.

🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.

🥳 Company off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Campaign Manager - Slim Chickens
descriptionText:
BRG are a forward-thinking family of brilliantly diverse restaurant brands across the UK and Internationally.

We're passionate about food and hospitality and constantly looking for new ways to innovate, grow our brands and create memorable experiences for our guests.

Slim Chickens is one of the UK's fastest-growing chicken brands, built around our famous fresh, hand-breaded chicken tenders, distinctive Southern hospitality, and an unrivalled choice of sauces.

As we continue to grow the brand across the UK, we're building a marketing team with the ambition, pace and commercial focus to match.

We're looking for a Campaigns Manager who can turn our brand strategy and commercial priorities into brilliant campaigns that drive guests through our doors, build frequency and strengthen the Slim Chickens brand.

The Role

Reporting to the Marketing Director, the Campaign Manager will take ownership of the planning, development and end-to-end delivery of the Slim Chickens UK campaign calendar.

This is a commercially focused marketing role responsible for turning brand strategy, guest insight and trading priorities into integrated campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Working cross-functionally across Marketing, Operations, Food, Digital, Commercial and Finance, you'll lead campaigns from the initial insight and brief through creative development, launch, restaurant execution and post-campaign evaluation.

You'll be expected to combine strong brand thinking with commercial judgement: understanding both what will make guests choose Slim Chickens and what will drive performance for the business.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Planning



-  Own and manage the annual and quarterly Slim Chickens marketing campaign calendar, aligned to brand strategy, trading priorities and commercial objectives.
-  Translate business objectives, guest insight and market opportunities into clear campaign strategies and activation plans.
-  Identify opportunities across the calendar to drive guest acquisition, frequency, average spend and brand consideration.
-  Develop clear campaign objectives, KPIs, audiences and measurement frameworks before activity goes live.
-  Work with the Marketing Director to evolve the longer-term marketing and campaign strategy for the brand.

End-to-End Campaign Leadership



-  Lead the development and delivery of integrated, multi-channel campaigns from initial concept through to execution and evaluation.
-  Write clear, inspiring, and commercially grounded briefs for creative, media, digital, CRM, social, PR, and restaurant activation.
-  Own campaign critical paths, ensuring activity is delivered on time, on budget and to a consistently high standard.
-  Ensure campaigns connect effectively across paid, owned, earned, digital and in-restaurant guest touchpoints.
-  Act as the central marketing lead for major brand campaigns, ensuring stakeholders have clarity on objectives, responsibilities, timings, and deliverables.

Commercial & Trading Focus



-  A commercially focused marketer with a proven track record of delivering campaigns that drive a commercial return
-  Work closely with Commercial, Finance and Operations to ensure campaigns are commercially robust and operationally deliverable.
-  Understand restaurant and trading performance and use this insight to identify marketing opportunities and priorities.
-  Build clear commercial rationale and business cases for major campaign investment.
-  Balance long-term brand building with short-term sales activation, ensuring activity contributes to both brand health and commercial performance.
-  Identify opportunities to respond quickly to changes in guest behaviour, competitor activity, and trading performance.

Insight & Performance



-  Use guest data, CRM insight, research, market trends, and competitor intelligence to inform campaign development.
-  Establish clear success measures for campaigns and ensure performance is tracked against agreed KPIs.
-  Lead post-campaign reviews, bringing together commercial, guest, and channel performance to understand effectiveness.
-  Turn campaign results into clear recommendations and apply learnings to future activity.
-  Champion a test-and-learn approach across the marketing calendar.

Cross-Functional Leadership



-  Build strong relationships across Operations, Food, Commercial, Finance, Digital and other support functions.
-  Lead cross-functional campaign meetings and ensure stakeholders remain aligned throughout campaign development and delivery.
-  Represent the guest and the brand within commercial and operational conversations.
-  Influence senior and operational stakeholders to ensure campaigns are executed brilliantly across the restaurant estate.
-  Ensure restaurant teams have the information, tools and assets required to deliver campaigns successfully.

Creative & Brand



-  Champion the Slim Chickens brand and ensure all campaign activity is distinctive, relevant, and consistent with our positioning.
-  Work closely with internal creative resource and external partners to develop compelling campaign ideas and assets.
-  Challenge creative work constructively to ensure it answers the brief and delivers against both guest and commercial objectives.
-  Ensure campaign thinking translates effectively across different channels without losing the core idea.

Budget & Partner Management



-  Manage agreed campaign budgets and ensure investment is allocated effectively.
-  Tracks spend against budget and ensure strong financial control across campaign activity.
-  Manage relevant agency, supplier, and partner relationships, setting clear expectations and holding partners accountable for delivery.
-  Identify opportunities to improve effectiveness and value from marketing investment.

About You

You'll be an experienced marketer who is equally comfortable discussing brand, creative and guest behaviour as you are sales, ROI, and commercial performance.

You'll be able to take a business challenge, turn it into a clear marketing brief and lead multiple teams and partners through to brilliant execution.

You'll Ideally Bring



-  5-7+ years of experience of commercial marketing at a similar level
-  5+ years' experience in marketing, campaign management, brand marketing, or a related role, ideally within hospitality, retail, leisure, FMCG or another fast-paced consumer brand.
-  Demonstrable experience of leading significant integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through to execution and evaluation.
-  Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of how marketing activity influences sales, frequency, footfall, and guest behaviour.
-  Experience using customer, market, and performance insight to shape marketing decisions.
-  Strong project and campaign management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously.
-  Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence colleagues across different functions and levels of seniority.
-  Experience managing creative and/or media agencies and external partners.
-  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create compelling briefs and present recommendations.
-  A highly organised approach with exceptional attention to detail.
-  The ability to operate at pace, make decisions and take accountability for delivery.
-  A collaborative leadership style combined with the confidence to challenge where necessary.
-  A genuine passion for hospitality, food, culture, and building brands guests want to be part of.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Job Profile Description

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

Our vision is to create a world-class business development and marketing capability for Kainos, fuelled by a diverse range of highly talented and motivated professionals working collaboratively and innovatively to ensure we continue our growth trajectory.

We do this via an open and supportive environment where colleagues can share information, learn from one another, and excel in their own career. With consistent ways of working aligned to industry best practice, we build sustainable and predictable sales pipelines for our market-leading offerings.

What You’ll Do

As a GTM Activation Marketing Manager, working within the Campaign Activation team and reporting to the VP of Campaign Activation, you will develop and own the GTM activation strategy, campaign plans and integrated activation approach that fully align with commercial priorities and sales plans to support growth and ambitions for the Workday Product Business Unit.

You will act as the bridge between campaign strategy and execution, translating commercial priorities into high-impact, multi-channel campaigns and ensuring they are effectively activated, orchestrated, and optimised across the full buyer journey. You will also be responsible for translating strategic product and campaign messaging into effective activation across campaign touchpoints, ensuring consistent and compelling messaging throughout the buyer journey.

Working in close partnership with Sales & SDRs, Product Marketing, Alliances, Sales Enablement, and wider marketing teams (Marketing Operations, Content, Brand, Events), you will ensure strong alignment from campaign launch through to follow-up, delivering against agreed goals including pipeline generation, progression, and conversion.

You will use your extensive experience and commercial knowledge to maximise the impact of marketing on the business. You will foster strong relationships with key internal stakeholders and external partners, acting as a trusted advisor.

Key Responsibilities



- Owning and implementing campaign activation strategy, plans and budgets – you will develop, own and implement integrated campaign plans aligned to commercial priorities for the Workday Product BU. You will define target audiences, messaging, and channel approach, ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, prioritised and set up for successful execution, balancing commercial priorities, audience strategy, and resource considerations across concurrent campaigns. You will own campaign budgets and ensure activity is delivered on time and within budget. 
- Owning, creating and activating campaigns and content – you will manage the end-to-end delivery of integrated, multi-channel campaigns to drive defined objectives including brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline acceleration. You will lead cross-functional campaign orchestration across specialist functions to ensure campaigns are executed effectively across channels and aligned to objectives. Working from core messaging frameworks provided by Product Marketing, your team will apply and adapt campaign messaging across channels and touchpoints including emails, landing pages, webinar communications, nurture flows, and campaign CTAs to support campaign objectives and audience engagement. 
- Sales alignment, enablement and pipeline conversion – you will work closely with Sales and SDR teams to ensure the successful launch, activation, and follow-up of campaigns, driving strong lead management and conversion. You will partner with Sales Enablement on key campaigns to ensure sales teams are equipped with the right messaging, content, and tools to engage prospects and progress opportunities. 
- Reporting, accountability and ROI – you will own overall campaign effectiveness and ROI, reporting on performance across campaigns and activities for the Workday Product BU. You will partner with Marketing Operations and use insights and data to optimise performance and continuously improve campaign effectiveness. 
- Strategic alliances with Partners – you will work closely with Alliances and Partner Marketing to identify co-marketing opportunities to enhance campaign reach and impact. You will use market insight to identify new opportunities to drive commercial benefit. 
- Working as a team with a focus on collaboration and stakeholder management – you will proactively collaborate as part of the Campaign Activation team and the wider marketing function to deliver against overall OKRs. You will act as a central point of coordination, building strong relationships with stakeholders and acting as a trusted advisor. You will also provide leadership and guidance across campaign activity, helping drive consistency and best practice across GTM activation. 

Minimum (essential) Requirements



- Substantial experience in marketing, including at a strategic/management level, with clear evidence of success in prior roles 
- Experience in B2B campaign activation and delivery, with a strong track record of executing integrated, multi-channel campaigns
