title: Marketing Manager
descriptionText:
The opportunity:
We are looking for a commercially driven Marketing Manager to lead an integrated growth function spanning ecommerce, customer acquisition, retention, brand, content, and product launches. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can set the strategy, convert it into a disciplined trading plan and remain close enough to the channels to improve performance directly.
You will bring together Shopify, app, CRM, paid media, affiliates, creators, organic social, content, education, B2B activity and launches. You will use reliable commercial data to decide where budget and effort should go, lead the team clearly and ensure campaigns are supported by stock, margin, operational and customer-service readiness.
The role in one sentence: A commercially accountable, hands-on marketing leader who unifies ecommerce, acquisition, retention, content and launches and turns them into profitable, measurable growth.


About the Company
Global Beauty Products Limited is revolutionising the beauty industry through our premium Beautiful Brows & Lashes collection. We are a UK manufacturer and supplier of professional brow, lash and cosmetic products, serving beauty professionals, consumers, distributors and OEM/private-label customers in the UK and internationally.


📍 Location: Head Office - Liverpool, with travel where required to, launches and events.


Are You Ready to Shape the Future of the Brow & Lash Industry?
We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven Marketing Manager to lead our integrated marketing function. This is not a narrow brand or communications role. It is an opportunity to influence how customers discover, buy, use and remain loyal to our products while taking direct ownership of e-commerce, acquisition, retention, content and product launches.


If you combine strategic leadership with hands-on ecommerce and channel expertise, understand the commercial realities behind growth and want to help shape a distinctive professional beauty brand, this role was made for you.


🎯 What You'll Be Doing
Commercial Strategy & Leadership (20%)
Build and own the annual and quarterly marketing plan across professional, consumer, ecommerce, wholesale and distributor channels.
Translate company objectives into clear channel priorities, campaign calendars, budgets, ownership and delivery dates.
Balance customer acquisition, retention, brand development, promotions and launches according to revenue, margin and operational capacity.


Ecommerce, App & Customer Conversion (20%)
Own marketing performance across Shopify and the app, improving traffic quality, conversion, average order value and repeat purchase.
Build a disciplined trading calendar covering campaigns, launches, landing pages, merchandising, bundles, offers and onsite journeys.
Use customer, product and channel data to identify conversion barriers, commercial opportunities and meaningful tests.


CRM, Retention & Customer Lifecycle (15%)
Lead email and SMS across acquisition, onboarding, education, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back, loyalty and launches.
Develop segmentation and automated lifecycle journeys using behaviour, purchase history, professional status and customer value.
Use repeat-purchase, cohort and customer lifetime value analysis to prioritise activity and demonstrate its effect.


Paid Media, Affiliates & Partnerships (15%)
Set the paid-media plan with clear objectives, audiences, creative requirements, budgets and commercial guardrails.
Manage agencies and specialists using CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution and incrementality rather than platform-reported revenue alone.
Develop affiliate, educator, creator and brand partnerships while controlling codes, commissions, attribution, partner quality and margin.


Brand, Content & Social (15%)
Set a coherent content strategy for professional and consumer audiences across education, product proof, social, ecommerce and retention.
Lead the content calendar and creative briefing process so copy, imagery, video and claims are accurate, distinctive and commercially useful.
Direct shoots and produces efficiently, turning core assets into channel-specific content without unnecessary duplication.


Product Launches & Cross-Functional Delivery (10%)
Lead go-to-market plans covering proposition, audience, education, content, ecommerce, CRM, paid media, PR, affiliates and trade activity.
Work with Product Development, Regulatory, Production, Warehouse, Sales and Customer Support so campaigns reflect approved claims, stock and operational readiness.
Use launch performance and customer feedback to improve replenishment, communications and the next launch cycle.


Team, Budget & Performance (5%)
Lead and develop the marketing team with clear priorities, responsibilities, deadlines and constructive performance management.
Maintain a reliable dashboard covering revenue, margin, conversion, AOV, CAC, ROAS, MER, retention, CRM contribution, app performance and channel trends.
Control budgets, agencies and purchase commitments, reallocating resources when evidence shows a stronger commercial use.


✅ What We're Looking For
Essential
Proven experience leading an integrated marketing function or broad marketing remit within beauty, cosmetics, ecommerce, consumer products or another product-led business.
Commercial ownership across ecommerce, acquisition, retention, campaigns and product launches, with evidence of measurable business results.
Hands-on knowledge of Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform, CRM/lifecycle marketing, paid social/search, affiliates, organic social and content production.
Experience managing budgets, agencies or specialist partners and making channel-investment decisions using commercial performance data.
Experience leading and developing people, setting priorities and coordinating delivery across several channels and departments.
Ability to explain performance through revenue, gross margin, contribution, conversion, AOV, CAC, ROAS, MER, retention and customer lifetime value.
Clear communication, strong commercial judgement, disciplined organisation and the confidence to challenge weak assumptions.
Willingness to work predominantly from our Liverpool head office and travel where required.


Desirable
Professional beauty, salon, cosmetics, education-led selling or experience serving both B2B and direct-to-consumer customers.
App marketing, loyalty, subscription or another high-repeat-purchase customer model.
International distribution, retail, wholesale, trade shows or product education.
Experience using Klaviyo, HubSpot, AWIN, GA4 or comparable ecommerce and marketing platforms.
Experience supporting frequent product launches in a regulated or technically led product environment.


🌟 What Makes This Role Different
This is not a one-dimensional marketing position. You'll be:
✨ A Commercial Growth Leader - connecting marketing to profitable revenue, margin, retention and customer value.
✨ An Ecommerce & CRM Operator - improving Shopify, app, lifecycle journeys and conversion.
✨ A Brand Builder - shaping how Beautiful Brows & Lashes competes across professional and consumer markets.
✨ A Launch Leader - aligning proposition, content, stock, operations and customer communications.
✨ A Team Leader - creating clear priorities, accountability and an evidence-led working rhythm.


🎁 What We Offer
A competitive salary, dependent on experience.
A comprehensive benefits package supporting financial, personal and professional well-being.
Continuous professional development across ecommerce, customer growth and professional beauty.
The chance to lead marketing for an established UK manufacturer and international beauty brand.
A collaborative environment with direct access to product development, manufacturing and senior decisions.
Real scope to shape the function, develop the team and influence future growth.


📩 How to Apply
Ready to make your mark? Click “Apply Now” and submit your CV with a brief cover letter telling us:
Why does this role and our professional beauty market excite you?
What commercial marketing result best demonstrates your personal contribution?
How do you balance strategic leadership with hands-on channel ownership?


We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply promptly.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities.


Preferred Skills
Applicants must evidence current e-commerce, CRM, acquisition, content and launch ownership with measurable results. Because of anticipated interest, we may not respond to every applicant individually.


Pay Range and Compensation Package
Salary and compensation will reflect experience and will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Growth Marketing Manager UKF
descriptionText:
Corpay is currently looking to hire Growth Marketing Manager UK Vehicle Payments (UKVP) within our International Vehicle Payments line of business. This position falls under our European Centre of Marketing Excellence division and is located in Swindon UK.
As Growth Marketing Manager, you will lead the planning and execution of strategic sales and marketing activities to deliver our growth targets. You will own the end-to-end marketing plan in your line of business, namely our most important and successful brand, Allstar. You will be responsible for driving brand awareness and new customer acquisition, across the full marketing mix, with a focus on integrated and omnichannel marketing. Taking an “outside in / customer first” approach, you’ll be leading the marketing for Allstar, a Corpay brand, partnering closely with sales, and being responsible for supporting the growth in a fast-paced, proactive, and positive environment.
You will report directly to the VP of Marketing UKVP and regularly collaborate with the wider UKF marketing team and Allstar Sales leaders.


How We Work
As a Growth Marketing Manager, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

- Assigned workspace in Swindon, UK
- Company-issued equipment
- Formal, hands-on training and support from a global Marketing team.


Role Responsibilities
Your responsibilities of the role will include:

- Defining the overarching marketing plans in alignment with business objectives and growth targets.
- Identifying priority markets, segments, and channels to maximise brand impact and demand / lead generation.
- Developing marketing activities and campaigns that clearly differentiate Allstar products and services in competitive landscapes.
- Setting annual and quarterly marketing goals, KPIs, and performance benchmarks.
- Defining campaign KPIs and success measurement frameworks with a critical focus on ROI and revenue generation.
- Management of prospect segmentation to support targeted marketing campaigns.
- Collaborate with sales teams to track, maintain, and optimise marketing’s contribution to the sales pipeline.
- Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of full funnel, outbound marketing campaigns.
- Ensure all campaigns, creative, and channel plans align with the strategic vision.
- Coordinate cross-functional input from sales, product, and leadership teams.
- Lead the production of campaign assets, ensuring brand consistency and high-quality output.
- Managing the creative process from initial briefing through to final delivery across all formats (digital, print, social, events).
- Coordinate the efforts of internal marketing teams to ensure campaign alignment and brand consistency.
- Manage relationships with wider marketing teams and agencies, optimizing use of internal and external teams' resources.
- Work with the Brand & PR teams to ensure they develop relevant press releases, secure media opportunities, and manage corporate communications.
- Oversee paid advertising campaigns, budgets, and performance optimization, using the internal digital team as your expert resource.
- Use our Marketing Automation team to conduct nurture journeys, and triggered campaign execution.
- Partnering with the data team to support the procurement and onboarding of purchased data to expand prospect reach, and execute new data enhancement projects, improving completeness, accuracy, and targeting precision.
- Brief Data and Salesforce teams to ensure smooth execution of data-driven marketing initiatives, CRM integrations, and accurate pipeline reporting.
- Ownership and management of your allocated marketing budget, ensuring optimal allocation across channels and campaigns.
- Serve as a key liaison between product, customer success, sales, and marketing teams to ensure campaign relevance.
- Provide insights from marketing activities to inform product development and market positioning.
- Owning campaign performance reporting and insights and produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on marketing performance.
- Test new initiatives and bring new ideas to the table.
- Work effectively with other team members within Marketing; you’ll be part of a wider team of marketing professionals who will also be part of shaping and executing your plans.


Qualification & Skills

- 5+ years’ experience in a similar senior role within B2B marketing.
- Proven track record in leading B2B marketing that delivers business impact and growth.
- Proven track record in planning, leading and executing sales focused marketing, in a data-driven, multi-channel, multi-touch environment.
- Experience leading and delivering demand generation focused programmes through longstanding, continuously optimized, multi-channel marketing.
- Excellent knowledge and experience of all direct channels, including digital & non-digital.
- A good understanding, and competent user of Marketing Automation, CRM (Salesforce or similar tools), Digital media including SEO, Paid and social.
- Deep understanding and experience of lead generation, lead warming and nurturing techniques
- Promotion and use of brand within the communications mix.
- Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A commercial, outcome focused, KPI and data-driven mindset.
- Strategic and creative approach with a thorough understanding of the prospect and customer journey and the trigger points in the buying lifecycle.
- Ability to build strong sales and GTM relationships across the organization.
- Personal resilience.
- Customer centric approach.
- Excellent interpersonal skills, cross-collaborator, and stakeholder management.
- Lots of motivation and a proactive approach. The ability to get the job done!


Benefits & Perks

- 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Option to buy or sell up to 5 days of annual leave annually through the benefits enrolment window
- Pension scheme with a minimum 3% employee contribution and up to 5% employer contribution from Corpay
- Private Medical Insurance through Vitality with no excess payable by employees; Corpay covers the standard £250 excess charge
- Life Insurance
- Access to the Gratitudes benefits platform, offering flexible discounts, supermarket savings of 4–5%, and a range of exclusive employee offers
- Free access to LinkedIn Learning, with thousands of courses to support ongoing professional and personal development 


About Corpay
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.

Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Marketing Manager to own and drive a portfolio of marketing projects, from scoping through launch and results tracking. This role collaborates closely with our Marketing, Content, and Product teams to identify opportunities, run initiatives end-to-end, and turn insights into measurable results.

The best candidates for this position combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, are comfortable managing several projects at once, and know how to turn a messy problem into a clear plan.

What you will do:



- Own and drive multiple marketing projects end-to-end, from scoping to launch to results tracking.
- Analyze market and audience feedback, turning insights into actionable marketing initiatives.
- Develop and execute content and community strategies in collaboration with internal teams and external agencies.
- Establish and grow brand presence across social media, online communities, and other digital channels.
- Build guidelines and playbooks to support consistent brand messaging across channels.
- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex, cross-functional issues.
- Track project performance and report on key metrics to leadership.
- Identify and act on opportunities to improve brand visibility and audience engagement.
- Set up and manage engagement processes for key audience segments (students, graduates, alumni, etc.).
- Scout, test, and scale new channels and platforms to reach and grow our audience.

You're a strong, hands-on marketing generalist who loves building things yourself, not just managing others, with:

- Strong background working with consumer-facing brands.
- Excellent English communication skills for global audience engagement.
- Analytical mindset with ability to measure and optimize project and campaign metrics.
- Experience across several marketing disciplines: content, social media, and community.
- Strategic thinking combined with tactical execution capabilities.
- Hands-on experience with AI in at least one area — building products, funnels, designs, copywriting workflows, or agents.

- Experience in education technology or similar consumer services.
- Content creation and digital marketing skills.
- Crisis communication experience.

- Base compensation of $3000/month plus annual bonus.
- Fully remote collaboration.
- High autonomy to explore, test, and improve marketing processes.
- Work alongside an experienced, global marketing team.
- Room to grow your scope as projects prove out.

In this role, you will develop and oversee comprehensive marketing strategies designed to increase CommonAI brand awareness, acquire new members, and optimise engagement.

The ideal candidate blends creative vision with analytical rigour, demonstrating proven expertise across digital marketing, content strategy, campaign execution, and performance tracking. You will collaborate closely with community and partnerships teams to align marketing initiatives with overall business goals.

- Plan, execute, and optimise multi-channel promotional campaigns
- Manage the annual marketing budget, allocating resources efficiently across channels to achieve maximum return on investment (ROI)

- Collaborate cross-functionally with members, partnerships and community teams to align messaging and pipeline generation strategies and launch new promotional campaigns
